```python
result = (
    df_storefronts_detail
    .filter(F.col("basket_state_hits").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "pay_mode",
        F.size("basket_state_hits").alias("n_keys"),
```

```sql
WITH cleaned_moves AS (
    -- Filter stock_moves
    SELECT
        id,
        warehouse_id,
        sku_id,
        move_type,
        qty,
        moved_at,
        operator,
        unit_price,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', moved_at) AS days_since_moved_at,
        DATE_FORMAT(moved_at, 'MMM yyyy') AS moved_at_label,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', operator, move_type) AS operator_move_type_label
    FROM stock_moves
    WHERE operator IN ('op_bee', 'op_eve', 'op_chan')
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ABS(unit_price - 293.2) AS unit_price_distance,
        LOWER(TRIM(operator_move_type_label)) AS operator_move_type_label_clean,
        unit_price + qty AS unit_price_plus_qty
    FROM cleaned_moves
),
joined_sku AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.warehouse_id,
        s.sku_id,
        s.move_type,
        s.qty,
        s.operator,
        s.unit_price,
        s.moved_at_label,
        s.operator_move_type_label_clean,
        s.unit_price_plus_qty,
        sk.unit_cost AS sku_unit_cost
    FROM tagged s
    JOIN skus sk ON sk.id = s.sku_id AND UPPER(TRIM(sk.sku_code)) LIKE 'A%'
    WHERE sk.unit_cost < 302.5
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach stock_moves metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_moves st WHERE st.sku_id = s.sku_id) AS move_count,
        (SELECT MAX(st.moved_at) FROM stock_moves st WHERE st.sku_id = s.sku_id) AS last_moved_at,
        (SELECT SUM(st.unit_price) FROM stock_moves st WHERE st.sku_id = s.sku_id) AS total_move_unit_price
    FROM joined_sku s
)
SELECT
    id,
    sku_id,
    move_type,
    qty,
    operator,
    unit_price,
    moved_at_label,
    unit_price_plus_qty,
    last_moved_at,
    total_move_unit_price,
    DATE_FORMAT(last_moved_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS last_moved_at_label
FROM profiled
ORDER BY operator
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned_moves = (
    df_stock_moves
    .filter(F.col("operator").isin("op_bee", "op_eve", "op_chan"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "warehouse_id",
        "sku_id",
        "move_type",
        "qty",
        "moved_at",
        "operator",
        "unit_price",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("moved_at")).alias("days_since_moved_at"),
        F.date_format(F.col("moved_at"), "MMM yyyy").alias("moved_at_label"),
        F.concat_ws(": ", F.col("operator"), F.col("move_type")).alias("operator_move_type_label"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    cleaned_moves
    .select(
        "*",
        F.abs(F.col("unit_price") - 293.2).alias("unit_price_distance"),
        F.lower(F.trim(F.col("operator_move_type_label"))).alias("operator_move_type_label_clean"),
        (F.col("unit_price") + F.col("qty")).alias("unit_price_plus_qty"),
    )
)

joined_sku = (
    tagged.alias("s")
    .join(df_skus.alias("sk"), (F.col("sk.id") == F.col("s.sku_id")) & (F.upper(F.trim(F.col("sk.sku_code"))).like("A%")), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("sk.unit_cost") < 302.5)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.warehouse_id",
        "s.sku_id",
        "s.move_type",
        "s.qty",
        "s.operator",
        "s.unit_price",
        "s.moved_at_label",
        "s.operator_move_type_label_clean",
        "s.unit_price_plus_qty",
        F.col("sk.unit_cost").alias("sku_unit_cost"),
    )
)

move_stats = (
    df_stock_moves
    .groupBy("sku_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("move_count"),
        F.max("moved_at").alias("last_moved_at"),
        F.sum("unit_price").alias("total_move_unit_price"),
    )
)

profiled = (
    joined_sku.alias("s")
    .join(move_stats.alias("st"), F.col("st.sku_id") == F.col("s.sku_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("st.move_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("move_count"),
        "st.last_moved_at",
        "st.total_move_unit_price",
    )
)

result = (
    profiled
    .select(
        "id",
        "sku_id",
        "move_type",
        "qty",
        "operator",
        "unit_price",
        "moved_at_label",
        "unit_price_plus_qty",
        "last_moved_at",
        "total_move_unit_price",
        F.date_format(F.col("last_moved_at"), "yyyy-MM").alias("last_moved_at_label"),
    )
    .orderBy("operator")
)
```

```sql
WITH recent AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        opened_at,
        closed_at,
        channel,
        csat,
        tags
    FROM tickets
    WHERE channel = 'chat'
),
event_stats AS (
    -- Per-ticket ticket_events metrics
    SELECT
        ticket_id,
        MIN(event_at) AS first_event_at,
        MIN(event_at) AS first_event_at_2,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN actor = 'customer' THEN 1 END) AS event_actor_count
    FROM ticket_events
    GROUP BY ticket_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach ticket_events metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        t.first_event_at,
        t.first_event_at_2,
        COALESCE(t.event_actor_count, 0) AS event_actor_count
    FROM recent s
    LEFT JOIN event_stats t ON t.ticket_id = s.id
),
with_details AS (
    -- Join support_agents
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.requester_id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.closed_at,
        s.channel,
        s.tags,
        s.first_event_at,
        s.first_event_at_2,
        s.event_actor_count,
        su.team AS agent_team,
        su.tier AS agent_tier,
        su.agent_name
    FROM summarized_rows s
    LEFT JOIN support_agents su ON su.id = s.agent_id
),
flattened AS (
    -- One row per tag
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.requester_id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.closed_at,
        s.channel,
        s.first_event_at,
        s.first_event_at_2,
        s.event_actor_count,
        s.agent_team,
        s.agent_tier,
        s.agent_name,
        t.tag
    FROM with_details s
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(s.tags) t AS tag
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    agent_team,
    tag,
    agent_tier,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(agent_name)) AS agent_name_list
FROM flattened
GROUP BY CUBE(agent_team, tag, agent_tier)
ORDER BY agent_team NULLS LAST, tag NULLS LAST, agent_tier NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent = (
    df_tickets
    .filter(F.col("channel") == "chat")
    .select(

        "csat",

event_stats = (

    .agg(
        F.min("event_at").alias("first_event_at"),

    )
)

summarized_rows = (
    recent.alias("s")
    .join(event_stats.alias("t"), F.col("t.ticket_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "t.first_event_at",
        "t.first_event_at_2",
        F.coalesce(F.col("t.event_actor_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("event_actor_count"),
    )

with_details = (
    summarized_rows.alias("s")
    .join(df_support_agents.alias("su"), F.col("su.id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "left")

        "s.closed_at",
        "s.channel",
        "s.tags",
        "s.first_event_at",
        "s.first_event_at_2",
        "s.event_actor_count",
        F.col("su.team").alias("agent_team"),
        F.col("su.tier").alias("agent_tier"),

        "first_event_at",
        "first_event_at_2",
        "event_actor_count",
        "agent_team",
        "agent_tier",
        "agent_name",
        F.explode("tags").alias("tag"),
    )
)

result = (
    flattened
    .cube("agent_team", "tag", "agent_tier")

    .orderBy(
        F.col("agent_team").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("tag").asc_nulls_last(),
```

```sql
WITH scoped_enrollments AS (
    -- Filter enrollments
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        grade_status,
        enrolled_at
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE grade_status = 'INCOMPLETE'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(score) OVER w_student_id_term AS student_id_term_sum_score,
        ROUND(AVG(score) OVER (PARTITION BY course_id, student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS score_avg_2_prior,
        NTH_VALUE(enrolled_at, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY course_id, student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_enrolled_at,
        ROUND(score / NULLIF(SUM(score) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status), 0), 4) AS score_share_of_grade_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_term_grade_status_by_score AS seq_no,
        LEAD(enrolled_at) OVER w_student_id_by_enrolled_at AS next_enrolled_at,
        LAST_VALUE(score) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY term, grade_status ORDER BY score DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_score,
        ROUND(score / NULLIF(SUM(score) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id, term), 0), 4) AS score_share_of_student_id_term,
        NTH_VALUE(score, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status, term ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_score,
        ROUND(AVG(score) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status, term ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS score_avg_7,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at NULLS LAST, id) AS enrolled_at_rank,
        ROUND(AVG(score) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id, term), 2) AS student_id_term_avg_score
    FROM scoped_enrollments
    WINDOW w_student_id_term AS (PARTITION BY student_id, term), w_term_grade_status_by_score AS (PARTITION BY term, grade_status ORDER BY score DESC, id), w_student_id_by_enrolled_at AS (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at NULLS LAST, id)
),
per_group AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        term,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(term)) AS term_list,
        ROUND(SUM(score) / NULLIF(SUM(score_share_of_student_id_term), 0), 3) AS score_to_score_share_of_student_id_term_ratio,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS first_enrolled_at
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY term
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(first_enrolled_at, 3) OVER (ORDER BY score_to_score_share_of_student_id_term_ratio, term) AS next3_first_enrolled_at,
        NTH_VALUE(first_enrolled_at, 2) OVER (ORDER BY score_to_score_share_of_student_id_term_ratio, term ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_first_enrolled_at
    FROM per_group
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    term,
    term_list,
    score_to_score_share_of_student_id_term_ratio,
    first_enrolled_at,
    next3_first_enrolled_at,
    second_first_enrolled_at,
    LENGTH(TRIM(term)) AS term_len,
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', second_first_enrolled_at) AS second_first_enrolled_at_hour
FROM ranked
ORDER BY next3_first_enrolled_at DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_enrollments = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("grade_status") == "INCOMPLETE")
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
    )
)

w_student_id_term = Window.partitionBy("student_id", "term")
w_term_grade_status_by_score = Window.partitionBy("term", "grade_status").orderBy(F.col("score").desc(), "id")
w_student_id_by_enrolled_at = Window.partitionBy("student_id").orderBy(F.col("enrolled_at").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
with_windows = (
    scoped_enrollments
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("score").over(w_student_id_term).alias("student_id_term_sum_score"),
        F.round(F.avg("score").over(Window.partitionBy("course_id", "student_id").orderBy(F.col("enrolled_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)), 2).alias("score_avg_2_prior"),
        F.nth_value("enrolled_at", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("course_id", "student_id").orderBy(F.col("enrolled_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_enrolled_at"),
        F.round(F.col("score") / F.nullif(F.sum("score").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("score_share_of_grade_status"),
        F.row_number().over(w_term_grade_status_by_score).alias("seq_no"),
        F.lead("enrolled_at").over(w_student_id_by_enrolled_at).alias("next_enrolled_at"),
        F.last("score", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("term", "grade_status").orderBy(F.col("score").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_score"),
        F.round(F.col("score") / F.nullif(F.sum("score").over(Window.partitionBy("student_id", "term")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("score_share_of_student_id_term"),
        F.nth_value("score", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status", "term").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_score"),
        F.round(F.avg("score").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status", "term").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("score_avg_7"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("student_id").orderBy(F.col("enrolled_at").asc_nulls_last(), "id")).alias("enrolled_at_rank"),
        F.round(F.avg("score").over(Window.partitionBy("student_id", "term")), 2).alias("student_id_term_avg_score"),
    )
)

per_group = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy("term")
    .agg(
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("term")).alias("term_list"),
        F.round(F.sum("score") / F.nullif(F.sum("score_share_of_student_id_term"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("score_to_score_share_of_student_id_term_ratio"),
        F.min("enrolled_at").alias("first_enrolled_at"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    per_group
    .withColumn("next3_first_enrolled_at", F.lead("first_enrolled_at", 3).over(Window.orderBy("score_to_score_share_of_student_id_term_ratio", "term")))
    .withColumn("second_first_enrolled_at", F.nth_value("first_enrolled_at", 2).over(Window.orderBy("score_to_score_share_of_student_id_term_ratio", "term").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)))
)

result = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "term",
        "term_list",
        "score_to_score_share_of_student_id_term_ratio",
        "first_enrolled_at",
        "next3_first_enrolled_at",
        "second_first_enrolled_at",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("term"))).alias("term_len"),
        F.date_trunc("hour", F.col("second_first_enrolled_at")).alias("second_first_enrolled_at_hour"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("next3_first_enrolled_at").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```sql
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Scope the students rows
    SELECT
        id,
        student_name,
        major,
        enrolled_on,
        gpa,
        COALESCE(major, 'UNKNOWN') AS major_or_unknown,
        CONCAT(cohort, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS cohort_ref,
        CONCAT(cohort, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS cohort_ref_2
    FROM students
    WHERE is_international = FALSE
      AND cohort = 'C2023'
),
scored AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        MONTH(enrolled_on) AS enrolled_on_month,
        COALESCE(major, 'UNKNOWN') AS major_or_unknown_2,
        ABS(gpa - 3.2) AS gpa_distance
    FROM filtered
),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(enrolled_on) OVER (PARTITION BY major_or_unknown, enrolled_on_month ORDER BY gpa DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_enrolled_on,
        SUM(gpa_distance) OVER (PARTITION BY major, major_or_unknown) AS major_major_or_unknown_sum_gpa_distance,
        MIN(gpa) OVER w_major_major_or_unknown AS major_major_or_unknown_min_gpa
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_major_major_or_unknown AS (PARTITION BY major, major_or_unknown)
)
SELECT
    id,
    student_name,
    major,
    enrolled_on,
    cohort_ref,
    cohort_ref_2,
    enrolled_on_month,
    gpa_distance,
    last_enrolled_on,
    major_major_or_unknown_sum_gpa_distance,
    major_major_or_unknown_min_gpa,
    CONCAT(major, '#', CAST(enrolled_on_month AS STRING)) AS major_ref,
    LOWER(TRIM(cohort_ref)) AS cohort_ref_clean
FROM metrics
```

```sql
        COALESCE(stddev_review_stars, 0.0) AS stddev_review_stars_filled
    FROM summary
)
SELECT
    is_flash_sale,
    stddev_review_stars,
    total_review_stars,
    total_review_stars_per_stddev_review_stars,
    stddev_review_stars_filled,
    CASE WHEN total_review_stars >= 26 THEN 'large' WHEN total_review_stars >= 13 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS total_review_stars_tier
```

```python
scoped_basket_lines = (
    df_basket_lines
```

```sql
SELECT

    COALESCE(a.est_avg_kwh, 0) AS est_avg_kwh,
    COALESCE(b.bad_count, 0) AS bad_count,
    COALESCE(b.bad_avg_kwh, 0) AS bad_avg_kwh,
    COALESCE(a.est_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.bad_count, 0) AS est_count_minus_bad_count
FROM est_by_site a
FULL OUTER JOIN bad_by_site b
  ON a.site_id = b.site_id
ORDER BY site_id
```

```sql
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY quality ORDER BY read_at DESC, id) AS read_at_rank

),
screened AS (

    SELECT *
    FROM metrics
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_tbl_violins
    .filter((F.col("site_id") <= 6) & (F.col("voltage") < 241.9))
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.concat(F.col("quality"), F.lit("#"), F.col("site_id").cast("string")).alias("quality_ref"),
        F.initcap(F.trim(F.col("quality"))).alias("lo_quality_clean"),
        F.abs(F.col("kwh") - 86.0).alias("kwh_distance"),
    )
)

w_site_id_quality = Window.partitionBy("site_id", "quality")
w_quality_by_read_at_ties = Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc())
metrics = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        "quality_ref",
        "lo_quality_clean",
        "kwh_distance",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_site_id_quality).alias("rows_in_site_id_quality"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id")), 3).alias("read_at_cume_dist"),

    )

    .crossJoin(metrics.agg(F.max("rows_in_site_id_quality").alias("overall_max_rows_in_site_id_quality")))
    .filter(F.col("rows_in_site_id_quality") < F.col("overall_max_rows_in_site_id_quality"))
    .drop("overall_max_rows_in_site_id_quality")
)

result = (
    screened
    .select(
        "id",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "lo_quality_clean",
        "kwh_distance",
        "rows_in_site_id_quality",
        "read_at_cume_dist",
        "second_kwh",
        "running_count",
        "read_at_percent_rank",
        "read_at_rank",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("quality")), 1, 3).alias("quality_prefix"),
```

```sql
),
per_group AS (
```

```python
in_window = (
    df_dim_drills.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_dim_drills.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.agent_id") == F.col("a.agent_id"))
        & (F.col("b.indigo_cutter") < F.col("a.indigo_cutter"))
        & (F.col("b.indigo_cutter") >= F.col("a.indigo_cutter") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.agent_id", "a.indigo_cutter")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_1d"),
        F.sum("b.requester_id").alias("prior_requester_id_1d"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    in_window.alias("s")
    .join(df_indigo_cartons.alias("su"), F.col("su.id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.agent_id",
        "s.indigo_cutter",

        "s.prior_requester_id_1d",

        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("agent_name")), 1, 2).alias("delta_schooner"),

result = (

    .rollup("max_prior_rows_1d", "agent_id")

        F.round(F.avg("stddev_prior_rows_1d"), 2).alias("avg_stddev_prior_rows_1d"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.sum("max_prior_rows_1d").alias("total_max_prior_rows_1d"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

covered = (
    df_tankers.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_tankers.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.agent_id") == F.col("a.agent_id"))
        & (F.col("b.opened_at") < F.col("a.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("b.opened_at") >= F.col("a.opened_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.agent_id", "a.opened_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_1d"),
        F.sum("b.csat").alias("prior_csat_1d"),
    )
)

with_trends = (
    covered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("opened_at", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id").orderBy(F.col("opened_at").desc(), "id")).alias("next2_opened_at"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id").orderBy("prior_rows_1d")), 3).alias("prior_rows_1d_cume_dist"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("agent_id").over(Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_1d"))).alias("distinct_agent_id_in_prior_rows_1d"),
    )
)

qualified = (
    with_trends
    .crossJoin(with_trends.agg(F.max("prior_rows_1d_cume_dist").alias("overall_max_prior_rows_1d_cume_dist")))
    .filter(F.col("prior_rows_1d_cume_dist") < F.col("overall_max_prior_rows_1d_cume_dist"))
```

```sql
WITH covered AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.played_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_12h,
        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_12h
    FROM stg_harbors a
    LEFT JOIN stg_harbors b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
with_parent_listener AS (
    -- Join fact_fjords
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.listener_id,
        s.played_at,
        s.prior_rows_12h,
        l.switche_tally AS listener_signup_date
    FROM covered s
    JOIN fact_fjords l ON l.id = s.listener_id
),
listener_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg prior_rows_12h per listener_id
    SELECT listener_id, AVG(prior_rows_12h) AS avg_prior_rows_12h
    FROM with_parent_listener
    GROUP BY listener_id
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_prior_rows_12h,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_12h - g.avg_prior_rows_12h, 2) AS amber_forge
    FROM with_parent_listener s
    JOIN listener_id_stats g ON g.listener_id = s.listener_id
    WHERE s.prior_rows_12h > g.avg_prior_rows_12h
)
SELECT
    id,
    listener_id,
    played_at,
    listener_signup_date,
    avg_prior_rows_12h,
    amber_forge,
    COALESCE(avg_prior_rows_12h, 0.0) AS midnight_railcar
FROM outliers
ORDER BY avg_prior_rows_12h DESC, id
LIMIT 20
```

```python
    df_stg_harbors.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_stg_harbors.alias("b"),

        & (F.col("b.played_at") < F.col("a.played_at"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") >= F.col("a.played_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.listener_id", "a.played_at")
    .agg(
```

```sql
        g.golden_loom
```

```sql
/*
  Recruiting pipeline: summarize rubric feedback in candidate review sessions.
  Earlier competencies receive more weight; inactive interviewers are excluded.
*/
WITH scored AS (
    SELECT r.*,
           filter(competency_scores, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AS valid_scores
    FROM stg_interview_reviews r
),
weighted AS (
    -- Position zero has the largest weight.
    SELECT s.*,
           transform(valid_scores, (x, i) -> x * (size(valid_scores) - i)) AS weighted_scores
    FROM scored s
),
review_metrics AS (
    SELECT w.requisition_id, w.candidate_id, w.submitted_at,
           w.valid_scores, w.weighted_scores, di.department,
           aggregate(
               weighted_scores, CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + x,
               acc -> round(acc / nullif(size(valid_scores) * (size(valid_scores) + 1) / 2, 0), 2)
           ) AS weighted_score,
           exists(valid_scores, x -> x = 5) AS has_excellent,
           forall(competency_scores, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AS rubric_complete
    FROM weighted w
    JOIN dim_interviewers di
      ON di.interviewer_id = w.interviewer_id AND di.is_active
),
session_metrics AS (
    -- A gap of more than 50 minutes starts a new feedback session.
    SELECT requisition_id, candidate_id, department,
           session_window(submitted_at, '50 minutes') AS review_window,
           count(*) AS review_count,
           round(avg(weighted_score), 2) AS session_score,
           sum(CASE WHEN has_excellent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excellent_reviews,
           sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(rubric_complete, FALSE) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS incomplete_reviews
    FROM review_metrics
    GROUP BY requisition_id, candidate_id, department, session_window(submitted_at, '50 minutes')
)
SELECT q.job_family,
       s.department,
       s.review_window.start AS session_start,
       s.review_window.end AS session_end,
       count(DISTINCT s.candidate_id) AS candidates_assessed,
       count(*) AS review_sessions,
       round(avg(s.session_score), 2) AS avg_session_score,
       sum(s.excellent_reviews) AS excellent_reviews,
       sum(s.incomplete_reviews) AS incomplete_reviews
FROM session_metrics s
JOIN dim_requisitions q ON q.requisition_id = s.requisition_id
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY job_family, department, session_start
```

```python
        ).alias("valid_scores"),
    )
)

weighted = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.transform(
            F.col("valid_scores"),
            lambda x, i: x * (F.size("valid_scores") - i),
        ).alias("weighted_scores"),
    )
)

denominator = F.when(
    F.size("valid_scores") > 0,
    F.size("valid_scores") * (F.size("valid_scores") + 1) / 2,
)
review_metrics = (
    weighted.alias("w")
    .join(
        df_dim_interviewers.alias("di"),
        (F.col("di.interviewer_id") == F.col("w.interviewer_id")) & F.col("di.is_active"),
    )
    .select(
        "w.requisition_id",
        "w.candidate_id",
        "w.submitted_at",
        "w.valid_scores",
        "w.weighted_scores",
        "di.department",
        F.aggregate(
            F.col("weighted_scores"),
            F.lit(0.0),
            lambda acc, x: acc + x,

session_metrics = (

        F.sum(
```

```sql
    SELECT *
    FROM commodity_lots
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous bid_at per commodity

    FROM prepared

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number

    FROM flagged
)
SELECT
    id,
    trading_post_id,
    trader_kind,
    commodity,
    tick_volume,
    burst_id,
    CONCAT(trader_kind, '#', CAST(lot_grade_number AS STRING)) AS trader_kind_ref,
    CASE WHEN tick_volume >= 559 THEN 'large' WHEN tick_volume >= 140 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS tick_volume_tier
```

```python
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_bid_at").isNull() | (F.col("bid_at") > F.col("prev_bid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)
```

```sql
WITH engaged_pairs AS (
    SELECT campaign_id, placement_id
    FROM ad_serving_daily
    WHERE clicks >= 3
    GROUP BY campaign_id, placement_id
),
eligible_pairs AS (
    -- INTERSECT removes pairs missing either signal.
    SELECT campaign_id, placement_id
    FROM engaged_pairs
    INTERSECT DISTINCT
    SELECT campaign_id, placement_id
    FROM ad_serving_daily
    WHERE conversions > 0
    GROUP BY campaign_id, placement_id
),
stamped AS (
    SELECT dly.campaign_id,
           dly.placement_id,
           dly.activity_date,
           dly.impressions,
           dly.clicks,
           dly.conversions,
           dly.media_cost,
           -- Consecutive dates receive the same island key.
           DATE_SUB(
               dly.activity_date,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY dly.campaign_id, dly.placement_id
                   ORDER BY dly.activity_date
               )
           ) AS island_key
    FROM ad_serving_daily dly
    INNER JOIN eligible_pairs elg
        ON elg.campaign_id = dly.campaign_id
       AND elg.placement_id = dly.placement_id
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT campaign_id,
           placement_id,
           MIN(activity_date) AS streak_start,
           MAX(activity_date) AS streak_end,
           COUNT(*) AS active_days,
           SUM(impressions) AS total_impressions,
           SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks,
           MAX_BY(activity_date, STRUCT(clicks, activity_date)) AS peak_click_date,
           BOOL_OR(conversions > 0) AS has_conversion_day,
           COUNT_IF(media_cost > 10.00) AS high_cost_days
    FROM stamped
    GROUP BY campaign_id, placement_id, island_key
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT str.campaign_id,
       str.placement_id,
       dir.campaign_name,
       str.streak_start,
       str.streak_end,
       str.active_days,
       str.total_impressions,
       str.total_clicks,
       str.peak_click_date,
       str.has_conversion_day,
       str.high_cost_days,
       ROUND(CAST(str.total_clicks AS DOUBLE) * 100 / str.total_impressions, 2) AS ctr_pct
FROM streaks str
INNER JOIN campaign_directory dir ON dir.campaign_id = str.campaign_id
ORDER BY str.campaign_id, str.placement_id, str.streak_start
```

```python
engaged_pairs = (
    df_ad_serving_daily
    .filter(F.col("clicks") >= 3)
    .select("campaign_id", "placement_id")
    .distinct()
)

eligible_pairs = engaged_pairs.intersect(
    df_ad_serving_daily
    .filter(F.col("conversions") > 0)
    .select("campaign_id", "placement_id")
    .distinct()
)

w_activity = Window.partitionBy("dly.campaign_id", "dly.placement_id").orderBy("dly.activity_date")
stamped = (
    df_ad_serving_daily.alias("dly")
    .join(
        eligible_pairs.alias("elg"),
        (F.col("elg.campaign_id") == F.col("dly.campaign_id"))
        & (F.col("elg.placement_id") == F.col("dly.placement_id")),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        F.col("dly.campaign_id").alias("campaign_id"),

        F.count_if(F.col("media_cost") > F.lit(10.00).cast("decimal(10,2)")).alias("high_cost_days"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("active_days") >= 2)
)

result = (
```

```python
    df_station_registry
    .filter(F.col("is_operational"))
    .select(

        F.from_json(F.col("profile_json"), profile_schema).alias("profile"),
```

```sql
    FROM crescents
    WHERE factory_id <= 12

per_group AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        factory_id,
        CASE WHEN cycle_secs >= 457 THEN 'A' WHEN cycle_secs >= 171 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS cycle_secs_tier,
        line_type,
        DATEDIFF(MAX(started_on), MIN(started_on)) AS started_on_span_days,
        ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN order_priority = 'P3' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_order_priority_p3,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(order_priority)) AS order_priority_list
    FROM base
    WHERE cycle_secs <= 457
    GROUP BY factory_id, CASE WHEN cycle_secs >= 457 THEN 'A' WHEN cycle_secs >= 171 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END, line_type
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM per_group
    WHERE pct_order_priority_p3 > (SELECT AVG(pct_order_priority_p3) FROM per_group)
),
derived AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(started_on_span_days / NULLIF(pct_order_priority_p3, 0), 3) AS started_on_span_days_per_pct_order_priority_p3
    FROM without_matches
    WHERE cycle_secs_tier IN ('B', 'C')
),
joined AS (
    -- Join core_ridges
    SELECT
        s.factory_id,
        s.cycle_secs_tier,
        s.line_type,
        s.started_on_span_days,
        s.pct_order_priority_p3,
        s.started_on_span_days_per_pct_order_priority_p3,
        f.is_rework AS factory_is_rework,
        f.started_on AS factory_started_on
    FROM derived s
    JOIN core_ridges f ON f.id = s.factory_id AND f.started_on BETWEEN DATE '2024-05-13' AND DATE '2025-03-22'
    WHERE f.is_rework = TRUE
),
joined_2 AS (
    -- Attach factory attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        f.started_on AS factory_started_on_2,
        f.shift_cd AS factory_shift_cd,
        f.is_rework AS factory_is_rework_2
    FROM joined s
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor,
        TO_DATE(event_at) AS event_at_date,
        LENGTH(TRIM(actor)) AS actor_len,
        event_at + INTERVAL 15 MINUTES AS event_at_plus_15m
    FROM ticket_events
    WHERE event_type IN ('created', 'resolved')
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        event_at,
        actor,
        actor_len,
        event_at_plus_15m,
        ROUND(actor_len - AVG(actor_len) OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_at)), 2) AS actor_len_vs_ticket_id_event_at_month_avg,
        ROUND(actor_len / NULLIF(SUM(actor_len) OVER w_ticket_id_event_at_month, 0), 4) AS actor_len_share_of_ticket_id_event_at_month,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_at)) AS rows_in_ticket_id_event_at_month
    FROM filtered_events
    WINDOW w_ticket_id_event_at_month AS (PARTITION BY ticket_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_at))
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE rows_in_ticket_id_event_at_month > (SELECT AVG(rows_in_ticket_id_event_at_month) FROM with_windows)
),
qualified AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM with_activity
    WHERE actor_len < (SELECT MAX(actor_len) FROM with_activity)
)
SELECT
    id,
    event_at,
    actor,
    event_at_plus_15m,
    actor_len_vs_ticket_id_event_at_month_avg,
    actor_len_share_of_ticket_id_event_at_month,
    rows_in_ticket_id_event_at_month
FROM qualified
ORDER BY id DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered_events = (
    df_ticket_events
    .filter(F.col("event_type").isin("created", "resolved"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.to_date(F.col("event_at")).alias("event_at_date"),
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("actor"))).alias("actor_len"),
        (F.col("event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES")).alias("event_at_plus_15m"),
    )
)

w_ticket_id_event_at_month = Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", F.date_trunc("month", "event_at"))
with_windows = (
    filtered_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "event_at",
        "actor",
        "actor_len",
        "event_at_plus_15m",
        F.round(F.col("actor_len") - F.avg("actor_len").over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", F.date_trunc("month", "event_at"))), 2).alias("actor_len_vs_ticket_id_event_at_month_avg"),

)

qualified = (
    with_activity
    .crossJoin(with_activity.agg(F.max("actor_len").alias("overall_max_actor_len")))
    .filter(F.col("actor_len") < F.col("overall_max_actor_len"))
    .drop("overall_max_actor_len")
)

result = (

    .select(

        "event_at",
        "actor",
        "event_at_plus_15m",
        "actor_len_vs_ticket_id_event_at_month_avg",
```

```sql
FROM latest
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((tier_section_len, distinct_tier_section_in_tier_section_len_genre_, genre_code), (tier_section_len), (distinct_tier_section_in_tier_section_len_genre_))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped = (
    df_raw_sleds
    .filter((F.col("stage_width_m") <= 31.2) | (F.col("corridor_score").between(7421, 16167)))
    .select(
        "id",
        "solar_cooler",
        "genre_code",
        "stage_width_m",
        "sold_at",
        "act_name",
        F.round(F.col("corridor_score") / F.nullif(F.col("stage_width_m"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("seats_sold_per_stage_width_m"),

metrics = (

        "solar_cooler",
```

```sql
  Recruiting pipeline: summarize rubric feedback in candidate review sessions.
  Earlier competencies receive more weight; inactive interviewers are excluded.

WITH scored AS (
    SELECT r.*,
           filter(competency_scores, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AS valid_scores
    FROM stg_interview_reviews r
),
weighted AS (
    -- Position zero has the largest weight.
    SELECT s.*,
           transform(valid_scores, (x, i) -> x * (size(valid_scores) - i)) AS weighted_scores
    FROM scored s
),
review_metrics AS (
    SELECT w.requisition_id, w.candidate_id, w.submitted_at,
           w.valid_scores, w.weighted_scores, di.department,
           aggregate(
               weighted_scores, CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + x,
               acc -> round(acc / nullif(size(valid_scores) * (size(valid_scores) + 1) / 2, 0), 2)
           ) AS weighted_score,
           exists(valid_scores, x -> x = 5) AS has_excellent,
           forall(competency_scores, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AS rubric_complete
    FROM weighted w
    JOIN dim_interviewers di
      ON di.interviewer_id = w.interviewer_id AND di.is_active
),
session_metrics AS (
    -- A gap of more than 50 minutes starts a new feedback session.
    SELECT requisition_id, candidate_id, department,
           session_window(submitted_at, '50 minutes') AS review_window,
           count(*) AS review_count,
           round(avg(weighted_score), 2) AS session_score,
           sum(CASE WHEN has_excellent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excellent_reviews,
           sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(rubric_complete, FALSE) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS incomplete_reviews
    FROM review_metrics
    GROUP BY requisition_id, candidate_id, department, session_window(submitted_at, '50 minutes')
)
SELECT q.job_family,
       s.department,
       s.review_window.start AS session_start,
       s.review_window.end AS session_end,
       count(DISTINCT s.candidate_id) AS candidates_assessed,
       count(*) AS review_sessions,
       round(avg(s.session_score), 2) AS avg_session_score,
       sum(s.excellent_reviews) AS excellent_reviews,
       sum(s.incomplete_reviews) AS incomplete_reviews
FROM session_metrics s
JOIN dim_requisitions q ON q.requisition_id = s.requisition_id
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY job_family, department, session_start
```

```python
scored = (
    df_stg_interview_reviews
    .select(
        "*",
        F.filter(
            F.col("competency_scores"),
            lambda x: x.isNotNull() & x.between(1, 5),
        ).alias("valid_scores"),
    )
)

weighted = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.transform(
            F.col("valid_scores"),
            lambda x, i: x * (F.size("valid_scores") - i),
        ).alias("weighted_scores"),
    )
)

denominator = F.when(
    F.size("valid_scores") > 0,
    F.size("valid_scores") * (F.size("valid_scores") + 1) / 2,
)
review_metrics = (
    weighted.alias("w")
    .join(
        df_dim_interviewers.alias("di"),
        (F.col("di.interviewer_id") == F.col("w.interviewer_id")) & F.col("di.is_active"),
    )
    .select(
        "w.requisition_id",
        "w.candidate_id",
        "w.submitted_at",
        "w.valid_scores",
        "w.weighted_scores",
        "di.department",
        F.aggregate(
            F.col("weighted_scores"),
            F.lit(0.0),
            lambda acc, x: acc + x,
            lambda acc: F.round(acc / denominator, 2),
        ).alias("weighted_score"),
        F.exists(F.col("valid_scores"), lambda x: x == 5).alias("has_excellent"),

session_metrics = (

        F.sum(
```

```sql
    -- common rows per registered_on_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', registered_on) AS registered_on_month, COUNT(*) AS common_count, ROUND(AVG(ping_ms), 2) AS common_avg_ping_ms
    FROM match_rounds
    WHERE drop_tier = 'common'

rare_monthly AS (

    FROM match_rounds
    WHERE drop_tier = 'rare'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', registered_on)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.registered_on_month, b.registered_on_month) AS registered_on_month,
    COALESCE(a.common_count, 0) AS common_count,
    a.common_avg_ping_ms,
    COALESCE(b.rare_count, 0) AS rare_count,
    b.rare_total_ping_ms,
    COALESCE(a.common_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.rare_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM common_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN rare_monthly b
  ON a.registered_on_month = b.registered_on_month
ORDER BY registered_on_month
```

```python
    df_match_rounds
    .filter(F.col("drop_tier") == "common")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "registered_on").alias("registered_on_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("common_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("ping_ms"), 2).alias("common_avg_ping_ms"),
    )
)

rare_monthly = (
    df_match_rounds
    .filter(F.col("drop_tier") == "rare")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "registered_on").alias("registered_on_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rare_count"),
        F.sum("ping_ms").alias("rare_total_ping_ms"),
    )
)

result = (
    common_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(rare_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.registered_on_month") == F.col("b.registered_on_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.registered_on_month"), F.col("b.registered_on_month")).alias("registered_on_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.common_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("common_count"),
        F.col("a.common_avg_ping_ms"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.rare_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("rare_count"),

        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.common_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.rare_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
```

```python
    .select(
```

```python
        "whistle_amt",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        F.col("quantity").cast("string").alias("quantity_num"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .select(

        "whistle_amt",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",

        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id")).alias("event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("whistle_amt", "product_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
```

```sql
),
latest_per_key AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per quality
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        quality,
        read_at_dayofweek,
        site_commissioned_on,
        site_name
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY quality ORDER BY site_commissioned_on DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM enriched_site
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1

joined_site AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.site_id,
        s.read_at,
        s.kwh,
        s.quality,
        s.read_at_dayofweek,
        s.site_commissioned_on,
        s.site_name,
        si.zone AS site_zone
    FROM latest_per_key s
    JOIN sites si ON si.id = s.site_id
),
with_windows AS (

    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY read_at_dayofweek, quality) AS rows_in_read_at_dayofweek_quality,

        SUM(kwh) OVER (ORDER BY read_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kwh_sum_4,
        FIRST_VALUE(read_at) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, read_at_dayofweek ORDER BY site_commissioned_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_read_at
    FROM joined_site
)
SELECT DISTINCT read_at_dayofweek, rows_in_read_at_dayofweek_quality, first_known_read_at
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.open_count, 0) AS open_count,
    a.open_avg_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(b.approved_count, 0) AS approved_count,
    COALESCE(b.approved_total_claimed_amount, 0) AS approved_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.open_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.approved_count, 0) AS open_count_minus_approved_count
```

```python
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("status") == "OPEN")

    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("open_count"),

result = (

    .join(approved_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.claim_date_month") == F.col("b.claim_date_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.claim_date_month"), F.col("b.claim_date_month")).alias("claim_date_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.open_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("open_count"),
```

```sql
        LEAD(carrier_length, 1) OVER w_grp AS next_carrier_length,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY carrier_length DESC NULLS LAST) AS carrier_length_dense_rank
    FROM with_dims
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(shipped_date), status_adj_hi ORDER BY shipped_date, id), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', shipped_date), order_id ORDER BY dedup_rank, id)
)

    ROUND(AVG(carrier_length_dense_rank), 2) AS avg_carrier_length_dense_rank,

    COUNT_IF(carrier = 'Flash') AS flash_events,
```

```python
        F.lag("enrolled_at", 3).over(Window.partitionBy("student_id", "term").orderBy("score_distance", "id")).alias("prev3_enrolled_at"),
```

```sql
      ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id
     AND b.opened_at < a.opened_at
     AND b.opened_at >= a.opened_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.opened_at
),
with_counts AS (

    SELECT

        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nozzle_podcasts t WHERE t.ticket_id = s.id) AS event_count
    FROM in_window s

    opened_at,
```

```python
    df_taverns.alias("a")
    .join(

        & (F.col("b.opened_at") >= F.col("a.opened_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_shift = Window.partitionBy("courier_id").orderBy("shift_date")

    df_stg_courier_shifts
    .filter(F.col("on_shift"))
    .select(
        "courier_id",
        "shift_date",
        F.row_number().over(w_shift).alias("rn"),
    )
)

# gaps-and-islands: consecutive days share the same date_sub key
streaks = (
    on_shift_days
    .groupBy(
        "courier_id",
        F.date_sub(F.col("shift_date"), F.col("rn").cast("int")).alias("island_key"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("shift_date").alias("streak_start"),
        F.max("shift_date").alias("streak_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("streak_days"),

longest_streak = (
    streaks
    .withColumn("rk", F.row_number().over(w_streak))
    .filter(F.col("rk") == 1)
    .select("courier_id", "streak_start", "streak_end", "streak_days")

        lambda x, i: F.when(i == 0, x).otherwise(x * F.lit(0.9).cast("decimal(10,2)")),
    ),
    F.lit(0).cast("decimal(22,4)"),
    lambda acc, x: (acc + x).cast("decimal(22,4)"),

    )
    .groupBy("courier_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("delivered_orders"),
        F.sum(F.size(F.filter(F.col("charges"), lambda x, i: (i > 0) & (x > F.lit(10).cast("decimal(10,2)"))))).alias("extra_big_lines"),
        F.max(F.when(F.forall(F.col("charges"), lambda x: x < F.lit(100).cast("decimal(10,2)")), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("all_under_cap"),
        F.avg(F.timestamp_diff("MINUTE", F.col("placed_at"), F.col("delivered_at"))).alias("avg_minutes"),
        F.sum(discounted_total).alias("adj_revenue"),
        F.max(F.when(F.exists(F.col("charges"), lambda x: x > F.lit(25).cast("decimal(10,2)")), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("any_big_charge"),
        F.min(F.date_trunc("HOUR", F.col("placed_at"))).alias("first_bucket"),
    )
)

result = (
```

```python
payload_schema = "STRUCT<model:STRUCT<name:STRING,version:STRING>,audit:STRUCT<reviewed:BOOLEAN,analyst:STRING>,baseline_c:DOUBLE>"

    .join(

        "inner",
    )
    .filter(
        (F.col("f.issued_at") >= F.lit("2025-06-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("f.issued_at") < F.lit("2025-06-02 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    )
    .select(
        "f.run_id",
        "f.station_id",
        "s.district",
        F.from_json("f.payload", payload_schema).alias("parsed"),
        F.get_json_object("f.payload", "$.model.name").alias("model_name"),
        "f.outlooks",
    )
)

expanded = (
    decoded.alias("d")
    .select(
        "d.run_id",
        "d.station_id",
        "d.district",
        "d.model_name",
        F.col("d.parsed.model.version").alias("model_version"),
        F.col("d.parsed.audit.reviewed").alias("reviewed"),
        F.col("d.parsed.baseline_c").alias("baseline_c"),
        F.posexplode_outer("d.outlooks").alias("slot", "o"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("slot").isNull() | F.col("o.metric").isin("temperature_c", "wind_kph"))
    .select(
        "run_id",
        "station_id",

        "model_name",
        "model_version",

    .pivot("metric", ["temperature_c", "wind_kph"])

        F.max("reading").alias("peak_value"),
```

```python
filtered = (
    df_raw_blueprints
    .select(
        "id",

        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2026-01-01").cast("date"), F.col("arctic_gantrie")).alias("days_since_read_at"),
    )
)

with_prev = filtered.withColumn("prev_read_at", F.lag("arctic_gantrie").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("arctic_gantrie", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_read_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("arctic_gantrie") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_read_at")) / 60 > 120), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("arctic_gantrie", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

session_summary = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("site_id", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("arctic_gantrie").alias("harbor_telescope"),
        F.max("arctic_gantrie").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.sum("kwh").alias("outpost_code"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("arctic_gantrie")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("arctic_gantrie"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

with_parent = (
    session_summary.alias("s")
    .join(df_alpha_blueprints.alias("si"), F.col("si.id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "inner")
    .select(

)

w_site_id_session_id_by_site_c = Window.partitionBy("site_id", "session_id").orderBy(F.col("site_commissioned_on").asc_nulls_last(), "site_id", "session_id")

        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "site_tariff").orderBy("duration_min", "site_id", "session_id")).alias("duration_min_seq"),
    )

        "session_id",
        "harbor_telescope",
        "session_end",
        "duration_min",

        "distinct_site_tariff_in_site_id_events",
```

```python
    .withColumn("basket_state_prefix", F.substring("basket_state", 1, 2))
)

    filtered
    .filter((F.col("account_opened_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-07"))) & F.col("basket_state").isNotNull())

        "basket_state",
        "basket_total",
        "basket_total_band",
        "basket_state_prefix",
        F.round("basket_total", 1).alias("basket_total_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("basket_state", F.lit("NONE")).alias("basket_state_filled"),
    )
)
```

```sql
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        quality,
        CASE WHEN kwh >= 80.8 THEN 'A' WHEN kwh >= 43.1 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS kwh_tier
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE quality IN ('OK', 'EST')
),
combined_details AS (
    -- Join sites
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.site_id,
        s.read_at,
        s.voltage,
        s.kwh_tier,
        si.commissioned_on AS site_commissioned_on,
        si.zone AS site_zone
    FROM prepared_readings s
    JOIN sites si ON si.id = s.site_id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY kwh_tier ORDER BY read_at DESC, id) AS prev_read_at,
        ROUND(voltage - AVG(voltage) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(site_commissioned_on)), 2) AS voltage_vs_site_commissioned_on_year_avg,
        LAG(read_at, 3) OVER w_all_by_read_at AS prev3_read_at,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_read_at_month AS rows_in_read_at_month,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(site_zone) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(read_at))) AS distinct_site_zone_in_read_at_month,
        LAG(voltage) OVER w_all_by_site_commissioned_on AS prev_voltage,
        MIN(voltage) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(read_at)) AS read_at_month_min_voltage,
        NTH_VALUE(site_commissioned_on, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY kwh_tier ORDER BY read_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_site_commissioned_on
    FROM combined_details
    WINDOW w_all_by_read_at AS (ORDER BY read_at ASC, id), w_read_at_month AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(read_at)), w_all_by_site_commissioned_on AS (ORDER BY site_commissioned_on DESC NULLS FIRST, id)
),
labeled AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', kwh_tier, site_zone) AS kwh_tier_site_zone_label,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(kwh_tier), ' ', '_')) AS kwh_tier_slug
    FROM ranked
    WHERE site_id >= 5
)
SELECT
```

```sql
    FROM profiled
    WINDOW w_cluster_id_by_first_deploy_j_2 AS (PARTITION BY ochre_album ORDER BY first_deploy_job_provisioned_on ASC, id), w_deploy_result AS (PARTITION BY deploy_result)

summary AS (

    )
```

```python
    ranked
```

```sql
    SELECT campaign_id, tier_name, min_pledge, valid_from,
           LEAD(valid_from, 1, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 00:00:00')
               OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS valid_to,
           min_pledge IS DISTINCT FROM LAG(min_pledge)
               OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS pledge_changed
    FROM reward_tiers
),
matched AS (
    -- As-of join: attach the tier valid at pledge time plus a trailing 7-day funded sum
    SELECT p.campaign_id, p.pledge_id, p.backer_id, p.amount, p.pledged_at, p.status, p.payment_method,
           (p.amount >= t.min_pledge) AS meets_min,
           t.pledge_changed,
           SUM(p.amount) OVER (
               PARTITION BY p.campaign_id
               ORDER BY p.pledged_at
               RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '7' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS trailing_7d_amount
    FROM pledges p
    LEFT JOIN tier_windows t
      ON t.campaign_id = p.campaign_id
     AND p.pledged_at >= t.valid_from
     AND p.pledged_at < t.valid_to
),
stats AS (
    -- Per-campaign highlights: top backer, first pledge, failures, peak weekly momentum
    SELECT campaign_id,
           MAX_BY(backer_id, amount) AS top_backer,
           MIN_BY(pledge_id, pledged_at) AS first_pledge_id,
           COUNT_IF(status = 'failed') AS failed_cnt,
           BOOL_OR(meets_min) AS any_meets_min,
           BOOL_OR(pledge_changed) AS tier_repriced,
           MAX(trailing_7d_amount) AS peak_7d_amount
    FROM matched
    GROUP BY campaign_id
),
pivoted AS (
    -- Payment-method breakdown with two aggregates per method
    SELECT *
    FROM (SELECT campaign_id, payment_method, pledge_id, amount FROM matched) m
    PIVOT (
        COUNT(pledge_id) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total
        FOR payment_method IN ('card', 'paypal', 'bank')
    )
)
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, s.top_backer, s.first_pledge_id, s.failed_cnt,
       s.any_meets_min, s.tier_repriced, s.peak_7d_amount,
       ROUND(s.peak_7d_amount / c.goal, 4) AS peak_pct_of_goal,
```

```python
w_tier = Window.partitionBy("campaign_id").orderBy("valid_from")

tier_windows = (
    df_reward_tiers
    .select(
        "campaign_id",
        "tier_name",
        "min_pledge",
        "valid_from",
        F.coalesce(
            F.lead("valid_from", 1).over(w_tier),
            F.lit("9999-12-31 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"),
        ).alias("valid_to"),
        (~F.col("min_pledge").eqNullSafe(F.lag("min_pledge").over(w_tier))).alias("pledge_changed"),
    )
)

w_roll = (
    Window.partitionBy("p.campaign_id")
    .orderBy(F.col("p.pledged_at").cast("long"))
    .rangeBetween(-7 * 86400, 0)
)

matched = (
    df_pledges.alias("p")
    .join(
        tier_windows.alias("t"),
        (F.col("t.campaign_id") == F.col("p.campaign_id"))
        & (F.col("p.pledged_at") >= F.col("t.valid_from"))
        & (F.col("p.pledged_at") < F.col("t.valid_to")),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "p.campaign_id",
        "p.pledge_id",
        "p.backer_id",
        "p.amount",
        "p.pledged_at",

        F.col("t.pledge_changed"),

        F.bool_or("meets_min").alias("any_meets_min"),
        F.bool_or("pledge_changed").alias("tier_repriced"),
        F.max("trailing_7d_amount").alias("peak_7d_amount"),
    )
)

pivoted = (
    matched
    .select("campaign_id", "payment_method", "pledge_id", "amount")
    .groupBy("campaign_id")
    .pivot("payment_method", ["card", "paypal", "bank"])
    .agg(
        F.count("pledge_id").alias("n"),
        F.sum("amount").alias("total"),
    )
)

result = (

        "s.first_pledge_id",
        "s.failed_cnt",
        "s.any_meets_min",
```

```sql
    from prep o

    lateral view posexplode(array_sort(o.lines, (l, r) -> case
        when l.amt < r.amt then 1
        when l.amt > r.amt then -1
        when l.line_id < r.line_id then -1
        when l.line_id > r.line_id then 1
        else 0 end)) li as line_pos, line
)

       regexp_replace(o.acct_no, '^([A-Z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)$', '$1/$2/$3') as acct_norm,

       parse_url(o.service_url, 'HOST') as portal_host,
       array_join(regexp_extract_all(o.note_tags, '([a-z]+):([A-Z0-9-]+)', 2), ',') as ref_list,
       o.line.line_id, o.line_pos, o.line.cpt, o.line.qty,
       cast(round(o.line.qty * c.rate, 2) as decimal(12,2)) as allowed_amt,
       c.reviewer, c.reviewer_changed,
       array_position(o.diag_codes, o.line.cpt) as diag_pos,
       try_element_at(o.diag_codes, o.line_pos + 2) as peer_diag,
       case when size(o.diag_codes) = 0 then cast(null as string)
            else element_at(arrays_zip(o.diag_codes, array_sort(o.diag_codes)), -1)['1']
       end as last_sorted_diag,
       slice(o.diag_codes, 1, 2) as diag_slice
from expanded o
-- half-open as-of interval; retain lines without a matching rate
left join rate_scd c
  on c.dept = o.dept and c.cpt = o.line.cpt
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_rate = Window.partitionBy("dept", "cpt").orderBy("valid_from")
rate_scd = (
    df_bill_rate_hist
    .select(
        "dept", "cpt", "valid_from",
        F.coalesce(
            F.lead("valid_from", 1).over(w_rate),
            F.lit("9999-12-31 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"),
        ).alias("valid_to"),
        "rate", "reviewer",
        (~F.col("reviewer").eqNullSafe(F.lag("reviewer").over(w_rate))).alias("reviewer_changed"),
    )
)

prep = (
    df_hosp_admits.alias("o")
    .filter(
        ((F.col("acct_no").like("HSP-%")) | (F.col("acct_no").like("CLN-%")))
        & F.lower(F.col("dept")).like("%card%")
    )
)

def line_order(l, r):
    return (
        F.when(l.getField("amt") < r.getField("amt"), 1)
        .when(l.getField("amt") > r.getField("amt"), -1)
        .when(l.getField("line_id") < r.getField("line_id"), -1)
        .when(l.getField("line_id") > r.getField("line_id"), 1)
        .otherwise(0)
    )

expanded = (
    prep.alias("o")
    .select("o.*", F.posexplode(F.array_sort(F.col("lines"), line_order)).alias("line_pos", "line"))
)

last_diag_pair = F.element_at(
    F.arrays_zip(F.col("o.diag_codes"), F.array_sort(F.col("o.diag_codes"))), -1
).getItem("1")
result = (
    expanded.alias("o")
    .join(
        rate_scd.alias("c"),
        (F.col("c.dept") == F.col("o.dept"))
        & (F.col("c.cpt") == F.col("line.cpt"))
        & (F.col("c.valid_from") <= F.col("o.adm_ts"))
        & (F.col("o.adm_ts") < F.col("c.valid_to")),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        F.col("o.adm_id"),
        F.regexp_replace(F.col("o.acct_no"), "^([A-Z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)$", "$1/$2/$3").alias("acct_norm"),
        F.split_part(F.col("o.patient_ref"), F.lit("|"), F.lit(2)).alias("mrn"),
        F.str_to_map(F.col("o.meta_txt"), F.lit(","), F.lit(":")).getItem("payor").alias("payor"),
        F.parse_url(F.col("o.service_url"), F.lit("HOST")).alias("portal_host"),
        F.array_join(F.regexp_extract_all(F.col("o.note_tags"), F.lit("([a-z]+):([A-Z0-9-]+)"), 2), ",").alias("ref_list"),
        F.col("line.line_id"), F.col("line_pos"), F.col("line.cpt"), F.col("line.qty"),
        F.round(F.col("line.qty") * F.col("c.rate"), 2).cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("allowed_amt"),
        F.col("c.reviewer"), F.col("c.reviewer_changed"),
        F.array_position(F.col("o.diag_codes"), F.col("line.cpt")).alias("diag_pos"),
        F.try_element_at(F.col("o.diag_codes"), F.col("line_pos") + 2).alias("peer_diag"),
        F.when(F.size(F.col("o.diag_codes")) == 0, F.lit(None).cast("string"))
        .otherwise(last_diag_pair).alias("last_sorted_diag"),
        F.slice(F.col("o.diag_codes"), 1, 2).alias("diag_slice"),
    )
    .orderBy("adm_id", "line_pos")
)
```

```python
        "street_line",
```

```sql
           sum(sum(daily_spend)) over (
               partition by card_id
               order by min(activity_date)
               range between interval '45' day preceding and current row
           ) as rolling_45d_spend,
```

```python
    .select(
        "merchant_id",
        "risk_tier",
        "valid_from",
        F.lag("risk_tier").over(w_risk).alias("prev_tier"),
        F.lag("valid_from").over(w_risk).alias("prev_from"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("prev_from").isNull() | (~F.col("risk_tier").eqNullSafe(F.col("prev_tier"))))
)
dim_merchant_risk = risk_changes.select(
    "merchant_id",
    "risk_tier",
    "valid_from",
    F.lead("valid_from", 1, "9999-12-31 00:00:00").over(w_risk).alias("valid_to"),
)

stg_daily_activity = (
```

```sql
        id,
```

```sql
        attr_value,
        service_lower,

)

    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(attr_key)) AS attr_key_list,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(dedup_rank_per_is_trace, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS dedup_rank_per_is_trace_quartiles,

FROM filtered_app_logs
```

```python
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "attr_key",
        "attr_value",
```

```sql
    FROM enrollments

    GROUP BY course_id

SELECT
    COALESCE(a.course_id, b.course_id) AS course_id,
    COALESCE(a.pass_count, 0) AS pass_count,
    a.pass_avg_score,
    COALESCE(b.withdrawn_count, 0) AS withdrawn_count,
    b.withdrawn_avg_score,
    COALESCE(a.pass_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.withdrawn_count, 0) AS pass_count_minus_withdrawn_count
FROM pass_by_course a
FULL OUTER JOIN withdrawn_by_course b
  ON a.course_id = b.course_id
ORDER BY course_id
```

```python
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("grade_status") == "PASS")

    .filter(F.col("grade_status") == "WITHDRAWN")
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.pack_count, 0) AS pack_count,
    a.pack_total_scrap_rate,
    COALESCE(b.assembly_count, 0) AS assembly_count,
    b.assembly_total_scrap_rate,
    COALESCE(a.pack_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.assembly_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM pack_monthly a
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared_readings = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter((F.col("site_id") >= 5) | (F.col("voltage") >= 219.6))
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("quality"))).alias("quality_len"),
        F.date_format(F.col("read_at"), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:00").alias("read_at_label"),
    )
)

w_quality_len = Window.partitionBy("quality_len")
w_all_by_read_at = Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id")
w_site_id_by_quality_len = Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("quality_len", "id")
windowed = (
    prepared_readings
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("quality_len").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_quality_len"),
        F.sum("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "quality_len").orderBy("kwh", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("kwh_sum_3_prior"),
        F.round(F.col("quality_len") / F.nullif(F.sum("quality_len").over(w_quality_len), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("quality_len_share_of_quality_len"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("read_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("quality_len", "id")))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_read_at"),
        F.lag("read_at", 3).over(w_all_by_read_at).alias("prev3_read_at"),
        (F.col("quality_len") - F.lag("quality_len").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id"))).alias("quality_len_change"),
        F.lag("quality_len").over(Window.partitionBy("quality_len").orderBy("voltage", "id")).alias("prev_quality_len"),
        F.max("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "quality_len").orderBy("kwh", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_voltage_so_far"),
        F.first("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("quality_len", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_kwh"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("read_at"))).alias("rows_in_read_at_year"),
        F.min("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("quality_len").orderBy("voltage", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("min_voltage_so_far"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc())), 3).alias("read_at_cume_dist"),
        F.lead("read_at").over(w_site_id_by_quality_len).alias("next_read_at"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("voltage", "id")).alias("voltage_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("read_at", "id")).alias("rn"),
        F.round(F.col("quality_len") - F.avg("quality_len").over(Window.partitionBy("quality_len")), 2).alias("quality_len_vs_quality_len_avg"),
    )
)

derived = (
    windowed
    .select(
        "id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        "quality_len",
        "first_quality_len",
        "kwh_sum_3_prior",
        "minutes_since_prev_read_at",
        "prev3_read_at",
        "quality_len_change",
        "prev_quality_len",
        "rows_in_read_at_year",
        "voltage_seq",
        "quality_len_vs_quality_len_avg",
        (F.col("read_at_cume_dist") + F.col("prev_quality_len")).alias("read_at_cume_dist_plus_prev_quality_len"),
    )
)

w_prev_quality_len = Window.partitionBy("prev_quality_len")
with_trends = (
    derived
    .select(
        "id",
        "read_at",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        "quality_len",
        "first_quality_len",
        "kwh_sum_3_prior",
        "minutes_since_prev_read_at",
        "quality_len_change",
        "prev_quality_len",
        "rows_in_read_at_year",
        "quality_len_vs_quality_len_avg",
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy("rows_in_read_at_year")), 3).alias("rows_in_read_at_year_percent_rank"),
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("kwh_sum_3_prior").desc())).alias("kwh_sum_3_prior_rank"),
        F.round(F.col("voltage") - F.avg("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("prev_quality_len")), 2).alias("voltage_vs_prev_quality_len_avg"),
        F.last("voltage_seq").over(Window.orderBy("rows_in_read_at_year", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_voltage_seq"),
        F.round(F.col("quality_len") / F.nullif(F.sum("quality_len").over(w_prev_quality_len), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("quality_len_share_of_prev_quality_len"),
    )
)

stats = (
    with_trends
    .groupBy("first_quality_len", "quality")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.countDistinct("quality").alias("distinct_qualitys"),
    )
)

w_distinct_qualitys_by_cnt = Window.partitionBy("distinct_qualitys").orderBy(F.col("cnt").desc(), "first_quality_len", "quality")
w_first_quality_len_cnt = Window.partitionBy("first_quality_len", "cnt")
metrics = (
    stats
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("first_quality_len", 1, 0).over(w_distinct_qualitys_by_cnt).alias("next_first_quality_len"),
        F.round(F.col("cnt") - F.avg("cnt").over(w_first_quality_len_cnt), 2).alias("cnt_vs_first_quality_len_cnt_avg"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "first_quality_len",
        "quality",
        "cnt",
        "distinct_qualitys",
        "next_first_quality_len",
        "cnt_vs_first_quality_len_cnt_avg",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("quality")), 1, 2).alias("quality_prefix"),
        F.lower(F.trim(F.col("quality"))).alias("quality_clean"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("next_first_quality_len").asc_nulls_last(),
        "cnt",
        "first_quality_len",
        "quality",
    )
    .limit(5)
)
```

```sql
)
select id, airframe, n_items, top_zone, total_finding_sev,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

    df_aircraft_fleet_findings

    .select("id", "airframe", F.col("e.finding_sev"), F.col("e.zone"))
)

per_aircraft_fleet_finding = (
    finding_items
    .groupBy("id", "airframe")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("n_items"),
        F.max_by("zone", F.struct("finding_sev", "zone")).alias("top_zone"),

w_rank = Window.partitionBy("airframe").orderBy(F.col("total_finding_sev").desc(), "id")
result = (

        "n_items",

        "total_finding_sev",
```

```sql
    -- Filter baggage_claims
    SELECT
        id,
        gate_id,
        terminal_code,
        lane_type,
        gate_capacity,
        bag_weight_kg,
        vendor_label,
        bag_weight_kg + gate_capacity AS bag_weight_kg_plus_gate_capacity,
        CASE WHEN terminal_code IN ('T1', 'T2') THEN 'group_a' WHEN terminal_code = 'T3' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS terminal_code_group,
        FLOOR(bag_weight_kg / 5) * 5 AS bag_weight_kg_bucket
    FROM baggage_claims
    WHERE lane_type = 'crew'
),
unique_rows AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per terminal_code
    SELECT
        id,
        gate_id,
        terminal_code,
        lane_type,
        gate_capacity,
        bag_weight_kg,
        vendor_label,
        bag_weight_kg_plus_gate_capacity,
        terminal_code_group,
        bag_weight_kg_bucket
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY terminal_code ORDER BY bag_weight_kg_plus_gate_capacity DESC, id DESC) AS rn
        FROM cleaned_baggage_claims
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach baggage_claims metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.lane_type NOT IN ('priority', 'standard')) FROM baggage_claims b WHERE b.gate_id = s.gate_id) AS baggage_claim_lane_type_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM baggage_claims b WHERE b.gate_id = s.gate_id) AS baggage_claim_count
    FROM unique_rows s
),
with_details AS (
    -- Join gates
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.gate_id,
        s.terminal_code,
        s.lane_type,
        s.gate_capacity,
        s.vendor_label,
        s.terminal_code_group,
        s.bag_weight_kg_bucket,
        s.baggage_claim_lane_type_count,
        s.baggage_claim_count,
        g.service_codes AS gate_service_codes,
        g.opened_on AS gate_opened_on
    FROM with_stats s
    JOIN gates g ON g.id = s.gate_id
)
SELECT
    terminal_code_group,
    terminal_code,
    GROUPING(terminal_code_group) AS is_total_terminal_code_group,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM with_details
GROUP BY CUBE(terminal_code_group, terminal_code)
```

```sql
                       (k, v) -> lower(k)
                   ),

                   'line_no', i + 1,
                   'cost_code', x.cost_code,
                   'extended', cast(x.quantity * x.unit_rate as decimal(12,2))
               )),
               cast(0 as decimal(12,2)),
               (acc, x) -> cast(acc + coalesce(x.extended, cast(0 as decimal(12,2))) as decimal(12,2)),
               acc -> acc + coalesce(element_at(merged_adjustments, 'contingency'),
                                     cast(0 as decimal(12,2)))
           ) as decimal(14,2)) as change_total,
           exists(line_items, x -> x.quantity >= 25) as bulk_work,
           forall(line_items, x -> x.unit_rate is not null) as all_priced,
           size(filter(line_items, x -> x.quantity * x.unit_rate >= 1000)) as major_line_count
    from map_stage m
),
expanded as (
    select p.project_id, p.change_id, li.line_pos, li.item
    from priced p
    lateral view posexplode_outer(p.line_items) li as line_pos, item
),
line_rollup as (
    select project_id, change_id,
           count(item.cost_code) as priced_line_count,
           array_join(array_sort(filter(collect_set(item.cost_code), x -> x is not null)), ' > ') as cost_code_path,
           array_sort(collect_list(named_struct(
               'line_no', line_pos + 1,
               'cost_code', item.cost_code,
               'note_count', size(item.notes)
           ))) as line_details
    from expanded
    group by project_id, change_id
)
select p.project_id, project_name, p.change_id, status, change_total,

       map_values(merged_adjustments) as adjustment_values,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

zero = F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)")
map_stage = (
    df_change_order_log.alias("c")
    .join(df_construction_projects.alias("p"), F.col("p.project_id") == F.col("c.project_id"))
    .filter(F.col("c.status").isin("approved", "pending"))
    .select(
        "c.*",
        "p.project_name",
        F.map_concat(
            F.transform_values(
                F.transform_keys(
                    F.map_filter(F.col("c.adjustments"), lambda k, v: v.isNotNull() & (v != 0)),
                    lambda k, v: F.lower(k),
                ),
                lambda k, v: F.round(v * F.lit("1.10").cast("decimal(3,2)"), 2),
            ),
            F.col("p.standard_adjustments"),
        ).alias("merged_adjustments"),
    )
)

def price_lines(lines):
    return F.transform(lines, lambda x, i: F.struct(
        (i + 1).alias("line_no"),
        x["cost_code"].alias("cost_code"),
        (x["quantity"] * x["unit_rate"]).cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("extended"),
    ))

priced_lines = price_lines(F.col("line_items"))
priced = (
    map_stage
    .select(
        "*",
        priced_lines.alias("priced_lines"),
        F.aggregate(
            priced_lines,
            zero,
            lambda acc, x: (acc + F.coalesce(x["extended"], zero)).cast("decimal(12,2)"),
            lambda acc: acc + F.coalesce(F.element_at(F.col("merged_adjustments"), "contingency"), zero),
        ).cast("decimal(14,2)").alias("change_total"),
        F.exists(F.col("line_items"), lambda x: x["quantity"] >= 25).alias("bulk_work"),
        F.forall(F.col("line_items"), lambda x: x["unit_rate"].isNotNull()).alias("all_priced"),
        F.size(F.filter(F.col("line_items"), lambda x: x["quantity"] * x["unit_rate"] >= 1000)).alias("major_line_count"),
    )
)
expanded = priced.select(
    "project_id", "change_id",
    F.posexplode_outer("line_items").alias("line_pos", "item"),
)
line_rollup = (
    expanded
    .groupBy("project_id", "change_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.col("item.cost_code")).alias("priced_line_count"),
        F.array_join(F.array_sort(F.filter(F.collect_set(F.col("item.cost_code")), lambda x: x.isNotNull())), " > ").alias("cost_code_path"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_list(F.struct(
            (F.col("line_pos") + 1).alias("line_no"),
            F.col("item.cost_code").alias("cost_code"),
            F.size(F.col("item.notes")).alias("note_count"),
        ))).alias("line_details"),
    )
)
result = (
    priced.alias("p")
    .join(line_rollup.alias("r"), ["project_id", "change_id"])
    .select(
        "project_id", "project_name", "change_id", "status", "change_total",
        "bulk_work", "all_priced", "major_line_count", "priced_line_count",
        "cost_code_path",
        F.array_sort(F.map_keys("merged_adjustments")).alias("adjustment_keys"),
        F.map_values("merged_adjustments").alias("adjustment_values"),
        "line_details",
    )
    .orderBy("project_id", "change_id")
)
```

```sql
  Blocked accounts are removed after the loan facts are prepared.

WITH loan_base AS (
    -- Open loans and loans returned after their due date are late.
    SELECT loan_id, member_id, branch_id, item_ref, loan_date,
           COALESCE(fine_amt, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(8,2))) AS fine_amt,
           CASE WHEN returned_at IS NULL
                  OR CAST(returned_at AS DATE) > due_date
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS late_flag,
           renew_qty
    FROM loan_txn
    WHERE loan_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
),
hold_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT member_id
    FROM hold_txn
    WHERE hold_status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND placed_on >= DATE '2025-01-01'
),
member_rollup AS (
    SELECT member_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_qty,
           COUNT_IF(late_flag = 1) AS late_qty,
           BOOL_OR(renew_qty > 1) AS multi_renew_flag,
           MAX_BY(item_ref, STRUCT(loan_date, loan_id)) AS latest_item
    FROM loan_base
    GROUP BY member_id
)
SELECT l.member_id, l.branch_id, l.loan_id, l.loan_date, l.item_ref,
       COUNT(*) OVER (
           PARTITION BY l.member_id ORDER BY l.loan_date
           RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '14' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
       ) AS rolling_loan_qty,
       SUM(l.fine_amt) OVER (
           PARTITION BY l.member_id ORDER BY l.loan_date
           RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '14' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
       ) AS rolling_fine_amt,
       r.loan_qty, r.late_qty, r.multi_renew_flag, r.latest_item
FROM loan_base l
LEFT SEMI JOIN hold_members h ON h.member_id = l.member_id
LEFT ANTI JOIN member_acct a
  ON a.member_id = l.member_id AND a.acct_status = 'BLOCKED'
JOIN member_rollup r ON r.member_id = l.member_id
ORDER BY l.member_id, l.loan_date, l.loan_id
```

```sql
    FROM hotel_folio_lines
),
spine AS (
    SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(first_day, last_day, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS cal_day
    FROM bounds
),
daily AS (
    SELECT checkout_day AS cal_day, SUM(task_minutes) AS task_minutes_total
    FROM hotel_folio_lines
    WHERE checkout_day IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY checkout_day
)
SELECT s.cal_day,
       d.task_minutes_total,
       LAST(d.task_minutes_total, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY s.cal_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS task_minutes_filled
FROM spine s
LEFT JOIN daily d ON d.cal_day = s.cal_day
ORDER BY s.cal_day
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

bounds = df_hotel_folio_lines.agg(
    F.min("checkout_day").alias("first_day"),
    F.max("checkout_day").alias("last_day"),
)

spine = bounds.select(
    F.explode(F.sequence("first_day", "last_day", F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAY"))).alias("cal_day")
)

daily = (
    df_hotel_folio_lines
    .filter(F.col("checkout_day").isNotNull())
    .groupBy(F.col("checkout_day").alias("cal_day"))
    .agg(F.sum("task_minutes").alias("task_minutes_total"))
)

    spine.alias("s")
    .join(daily.alias("d"), F.col("d.cal_day") == F.col("s.cal_day"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("s.cal_day").alias("cal_day"),
        F.col("d.task_minutes_total"),
        F.last(F.col("d.task_minutes_total"), ignorenulls=True).over(w_fill).alias("task_minutes_filled"),
    )

)
```

```sql
kept as (
```

```sql
        start_date,

    FROM policies

screened AS (

    FROM base s

            FROM policies p
            WHERE p.holder_id = s.holder_id
              AND p.end_date < DATE '2026-12-05'
              AND p.product = 'HEALTH'
        )
),
ranked AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        holder_id,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        start_date_month_start,
        SUM(premium) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(start_date_month_start)) AS start_date_month_start_month_sum_premium,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(holder_id) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(start_date_month_start))) AS distinct_holder_id_in_start_date_month_start_mon,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY holder_id ORDER BY start_date_month_start, id), 3) AS start_date_month_start_cume_dist,
        premium - LAG(premium) OVER (PARTITION BY holder_id ORDER BY premium, id) AS premium_change,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', start_date_month_start) ORDER BY premium DESC, id) AS premium_decile
    FROM screened
),
claim_stats AS (
    -- Per-policy claims metrics
    SELECT
        policy_id,
        MIN(claim_date) AS first_claim_date,
        MAX(claim_date) AS last_claim_date

    GROUP BY policy_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach claims metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        c.first_claim_date,
        c.last_claim_date
    FROM ranked s
    LEFT JOIN claim_stats c ON c.policy_id = s.id
)
SELECT
    distinct_holder_id_in_start_date_month_start_mon,
    premium_decile,

    PERCENTILE_APPROX(distinct_holder_id_in_start_date_month_start_mon, 0.5) AS median_distinct_holder_id_in_start_date_month_st
```

```sql
        FROM recent
```
```sql
    ) ranked
```

```sql
ranked AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(capacity_sec) OVER w_all_by_opened_on AS prev_capacity,
        ROUND(capacity_filled - AVG(capacity_filled) OVER (PARTITION BY city), 2) AS capacity_filled_vs_city_avg
    FROM deduped
```
