),
deduped_2 AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per city
    SELECT
        id,
        wh_code,
        city,
        capacity_sec,
        opened_on,
        city_slug,
        capacity_filled,
        prev_capacity,
        capacity_filled_vs_city_avg
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY prev_capacity, id) AS row_num
        FROM ranked
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
city_stats AS (
    -- Max capacity_sec per city
    SELECT city, MAX(capacity_sec) AS max_capacity
    FROM deduped_2

vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic

        s.*,
        g.max_capacity,

FROM (
    SELECT id, capacity_filled_vs_city_avg, capacity_minus_max
    FROM vs_group

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent = (
    df_warehouses
    .filter((F.col("opened_on") < F.lit("2025-02-14").cast("date")) & (F.lower(F.col("wh_code")).like("%kk%")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "wh_code",
        "city",
        "capacity_sec",
        "opened_on",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("city")), " ", "_")).alias("city_slug"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("capacity_sec"), F.lit(0)).alias("capacity_filled"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    recent
    .withColumn("recency_rank_peak", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("opened_on").desc(), F.col("id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("recency_rank_peak") == 1)
    .drop("recency_rank_peak")
)

w_all_by_opened_on = Window.orderBy(F.col("opened_on").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
ranked = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("prev_capacity", F.lag("capacity_sec").over(w_all_by_opened_on))

    .agg(F.max("capacity_sec").alias("max_capacity"))

vs_group = (

        "g.max_capacity",

result = (

        F.col("capacity_minus_max").alias("m_capacity_minus_max"),

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_voyages

        "id",

        "vessel_flag",
        "reefer_temp",
        "gross_tonnage",
        "built_on",
        "is_reefer",
        F.upper(F.trim(F.col("crew_role"))).alias("crew_role_clean"),
        F.dayofweek(F.col("built_on")).alias("built_on_dayofweek"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("built_on_dayofweek", "is_reefer").orderBy(F.col("gross_tonnage").desc(), "id")), 3).alias("gross_tonnage_cume_dist"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("built_on_dayofweek", "is_reefer").orderBy(F.col("gross_tonnage").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.nth_value("built_on", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("built_on_dayofweek", "is_reefer").orderBy(F.col("gross_tonnage").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_built_on"),
        F.sum("reefer_temp").over(Window.partitionBy("built_on_dayofweek", "is_reefer").orderBy(F.col("gross_tonnage").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)).alias("reefer_temp_sum_6_prior"),
    )
)

w_is_reefer_by_seq_no = Window.partitionBy("is_reefer").orderBy(F.col("seq_no").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
with_trends = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("running_count", F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("built_on_dayofweek", "seq_no").orderBy("built_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("prev_built_on_dayofweek", F.lag("built_on_dayofweek").over(w_is_reefer_by_seq_no))
)

leaders = (
    with_trends
    .filter(F.col("seq_no") <= 3)
    .drop("seq_no")
)

detail_rows_port_calls = (
    leaders.alias("s")
    .join(df_port_calls.alias("p"), F.col("p.voyage_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.vessel_id",

        "s.vessel_flag",
        "s.reefer_temp",
        "s.gross_tonnage",
        "s.built_on",

        "s.crew_role_clean",
        "s.gross_tonnage_cume_dist",
        "s.reefer_temp_sum_6_prior",
        F.col("p.id").alias("port_call_id"),

    .agg(

        F.coalesce(F.col("total_reefer_temp"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("total_reefer_temp_filled"),

    )

result = (

    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.student_id,

        SUM(b.score) AS prior_score_12h
    FROM enrollments a
    LEFT JOIN enrollments b
      ON b.student_id = a.student_id
     AND b.enrolled_at < a.enrolled_at
     AND b.enrolled_at >= a.enrolled_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.student_id, a.enrolled_at
),
scored AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAST(prior_score_12h, prior_rows_12h) AS least_prior_score_12h_prior_rows_12h,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', enrolled_at) AS enrolled_at_week
    FROM covered
)
SELECT
    id,
    student_id,
    enrolled_at,
    prior_score_12h,
    least_prior_score_12h_prior_rows_12h,

    COALESCE(b.inbound_total_qty, 0) AS inbound_total_qty,
    COALESCE(a.outbound_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.inbound_count, 0) AS net_count

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped = df_rigs

with_prev = scoped.withColumn("prev_event_at", F.lag("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_event_at").isNull() | (F.col("event_at") > F.col("prev_event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("event_type", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("event_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("event_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("event_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("event_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

derived = (
    sessions
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("duration_min") >= 192.0, "large").when(F.col("duration_min") >= 60.0, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("duration_min_tier"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.col("session_end")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.col("session_start"))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_session_start_to_session_end"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("session_id"), F.lit(0)).alias("session_id_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    derived
    .groupBy("n_events")
    .pivot("duration_min_tier", ["large", "small", "medium"])
    .agg(F.sum("duration_min").alias("amount"), F.count("duration_min").alias("n"))
    .orderBy("n_events")
)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_coastal_murals
    .filter(F.col("kickoff_ts") >= F.lit("2023-10-05").cast("date"))

    .select("rental_id", "bike_id", "start_dock_id", "end_dock_id", "started_at", "duration_min", "parsed", "firmware")
)

h = (
    df_dock_rate_history
    .withColumn("prev_valid_from", F.lag("valid_from").over(w_dock))
    .withColumn("prev_rate", F.lag("rate_cents").over(w_dock))
    .withColumn("prev_status", F.lag("dock_status").over(w_dock))
)

    .withColumn("valid_to", F.coalesce(F.lead("valid_from").over(w_dock), F.lit("9999-12-31 00:00:00").cast("timestamp")))
    .select("dock_id", "rate_cents", "valid_from", "valid_to")
)

    prepared
    .withColumn("sorted_trace", F.array_sort("parsed.trace", lambda l, r: F.when(l.getField("at") < r.getField("at"), -1).when(l.getField("at") > r.getField("at"), 1).otherwise(0)))
    .withColumn("recent_bike_rentals", F.expr("count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY bike_id ORDER BY started_at RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '2' HOURS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)"))
)
matched = (
    scored.alias("s")
    .join(rate_versions.alias("v"), (F.col("v.dock_id") == F.col("s.start_dock_id")) & (F.col("v.valid_from") <= F.col("s.started_at")) & (F.col("s.started_at") < F.col("v.valid_to")))
    .withColumn("incomplete_trace", F.array_position(F.transform("sorted_trace", lambda x: x.getField("dock")), F.col("end_dock_id")) == 0)
    .withColumn("trace_closed", F.coalesce(F.when(F.size("sorted_trace") > 0, F.element_at("sorted_trace", -1).getField("dock")) == F.col("end_dock_id"), F.lit(False)))

        F.bool_or("fifth_stop_low").alias("any_low_fifth_stop"),
        F.max("switch_count").alias("max_switches"),
        F.round(F.avg("recent_bike_rentals"), 2).alias("avg_recent_bike_load"),

               OVER (PARTITION BY acct_id, drug_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS valid_to,
           copay, max_qty
    FROM (
        SELECT h.*
        FROM (
            SELECT t.*,
                   lag(valid_from) OVER (PARTITION BY acct_id, drug_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_valid_from,
                   lag(copay) OVER (PARTITION BY acct_id, drug_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_copay,
                   lag(max_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY acct_id, drug_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_max_qty
            FROM drug_terms t
        ) h
        WHERE prev_valid_from IS NULL
           OR copay IS DISTINCT FROM prev_copay
           OR max_qty IS DISTINCT FROM prev_max_qty
    ) changed
),
eligible_fills AS (
    -- Require a registered account and remove suspended accounts.
    SELECT rx.*
    FROM rx_txn rx
    LEFT SEMI JOIN acct_registry acct
      ON acct.acct_id = rx.acct_id
    LEFT ANTI JOIN acct_registry blocked
      ON blocked.acct_id = rx.acct_id AND blocked.acct_status = 'SUSPENDED'
),
fill_metrics AS (
    -- Apply terms as of the fill and derive array-based quality metrics.
    SELECT ef.*, tm.copay, tm.max_qty,
           transform(ef.day_marks, (x, i) -> x + i) AS indexed_marks,
           aggregate(filter(ef.day_marks, x -> x > 0), 0,
                     (acc, x) -> acc + x, acc -> acc) AS positive_day_total,
           exists(ef.day_marks, x -> x < 0) AS has_negative,
           forall(ef.day_marks, x -> x <= 90) AS marks_within_limit
    FROM eligible_fills ef
    JOIN terms_scd tm
      ON tm.acct_id = ef.acct_id AND tm.drug_id = ef.drug_id
     AND tm.valid_from <= ef.fill_ts AND ef.fill_ts < tm.valid_to
)
SELECT acct_id, drug_id,
       grouping_id(acct_id, drug_id) AS grp_id,
       count(*) AS fill_cnt,
       sum(qty) AS total_qty,
       count(txn_id) FILTER (WHERE qty <= max_qty) AS compliant_fills,
       sum(qty) FILTER (WHERE has_negative OR NOT marks_within_limit
                             OR exists(indexed_marks, x -> x > 90)) AS exception_qty,
       max(positive_day_total) AS max_positive_days,
       round(avg(copay), 2) AS avg_copay
FROM fill_metrics
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((acct_id, drug_id), (acct_id), ())
ORDER BY grp_id DESC, acct_id NULLS LAST, drug_id NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_terms = Window.partitionBy("acct_id", "drug_id").orderBy("valid_from")
terms_scd = (
    df_drug_terms
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("valid_from").over(w_terms).alias("prev_valid_from"),
        F.lag("copay").over(w_terms).alias("prev_copay"),
        F.lag("max_qty").over(w_terms).alias("prev_max_qty"),
    )
    .filter(
        F.col("prev_valid_from").isNull()
        | (~F.col("copay").eqNullSafe(F.col("prev_copay")))
        | (~F.col("max_qty").eqNullSafe(F.col("prev_max_qty")))
    )
    .select(
        "acct_id",
        "drug_id",
        "valid_from",
        F.lead("valid_from", 1, "9999-12-31 00:00:00").over(w_terms).alias("valid_to"),
        "copay",
        "max_qty",
    )
)

eligible_fills = (
    df_rx_txn.alias("rx")
    .join(df_acct_registry.alias("acct"), F.col("acct.acct_id") == F.col("rx.acct_id"), "left_semi")
    .join(
        df_acct_registry.alias("blocked"),
        (F.col("blocked.acct_id") == F.col("rx.acct_id")) & (F.col("blocked.acct_status") == "SUSPENDED"),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .select("rx.*")
)

fill_metrics = (
    eligible_fills.alias("ef")
    .join(
        terms_scd.alias("tm"),
        (F.col("tm.acct_id") == F.col("ef.acct_id"))
        & (F.col("tm.drug_id") == F.col("ef.drug_id"))
        & (F.col("tm.valid_from") <= F.col("ef.fill_ts"))
        & (F.col("ef.fill_ts") < F.col("tm.valid_to")),
    )
    .select(
        "ef.*",
        "tm.copay",
        "tm.max_qty",
        F.transform("ef.day_marks", lambda x, i: x + i).alias("indexed_marks"),
        F.aggregate(
            F.filter("ef.day_marks", lambda x: x > 0),
            F.lit(0),
            lambda acc, x: acc + x,
            lambda acc: acc,
        ).alias("positive_day_total"),
        F.exists("ef.day_marks", lambda x: x < 0).alias("has_negative"),
        F.forall("ef.day_marks", lambda x: x <= 90).alias("marks_within_limit"),
    )
)

exception_cond = (
    F.col("has_negative")
    | (~F.col("marks_within_limit"))
    | F.exists("indexed_marks", lambda x: x > 90)
)
metric_aggs = [
    F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("fill_cnt"),
    F.sum("qty").alias("total_qty"),
    F.count(F.when(F.col("qty") <= F.col("max_qty"), F.col("txn_id"))).alias("compliant_fills"),
    F.sum(F.when(exception_cond, F.col("qty"))).alias("exception_qty"),
    F.max("positive_day_total").alias("max_positive_days"),
    F.round(F.avg("copay"), 2).alias("avg_copay"),
]
metric_cols = ["fill_cnt", "total_qty", "compliant_fills", "exception_qty", "max_positive_days", "avg_copay"]

detail_totals = fill_metrics.groupBy("acct_id", "drug_id").agg(F.lit(0).cast("bigint").alias("grp_id"), *metric_aggs)
acct_totals = (
    fill_metrics.groupBy("acct_id")
    .agg(F.lit(1).cast("bigint").alias("grp_id"), *metric_aggs)
    .select("acct_id", F.lit(None).cast("string").alias("drug_id"), "grp_id", *metric_cols)
)
grand_totals = (
    fill_metrics.agg(F.lit(3).cast("bigint").alias("grp_id"), *metric_aggs)
    .select(F.lit(None).cast("int").alias("acct_id"), F.lit(None).cast("string").alias("drug_id"), "grp_id", *metric_cols)
)
result = (
    detail_totals.unionByName(acct_totals).unionByName(grand_totals)
    .orderBy(F.col("grp_id").desc(), F.col("acct_id").asc_nulls_last(), F.col("drug_id").asc_nulls_last())
)

    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(received_on, 'yyyy-MM') AS quartz_binder,
        angler_amt,
        ROUND(SUM(warehouses_v_id_lift_model_min_slot_minutes) / NULLIF(SUM(slot_minutes), 0), 3) AS warehouses_v_id_lift_model_min_slot_minutes_to_s,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,

        CASE WHEN n_rows >= 9 THEN 'large' WHEN n_rows >= 4 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS n_rows_tier

           MAP_CONCAT(COALESCE(context, MAP()), MAP('reviewed', 1)) AS enriched_context,
           TRANSFORM(risk_signals, (x, i) -> CONCAT(CAST(i + 1 AS STRING), ':', x)) AS numbered_signals,
           FILTER(risk_signals, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x <> 'new_device') AS scored_signals,
           AGGREGATE(FILTER(risk_signals, x -> x IS NOT NULL), 0,
                     (acc, x) -> acc + LENGTH(x),
                     acc -> acc + COALESCE(SIZE(risk_signals), 0)) AS signal_score,

rolled AS (

        F.transform("risk_signals", lambda x, i: F.concat((i + 1).cast("string"), F.lit(":"), x)).alias("numbered_signals"),
        F.filter("risk_signals", lambda x: x.isNotNull() & (x != "new_device")).alias("scored_signals"),
        F.aggregate(clean_signals, F.lit(0), lambda acc, x: acc + F.length(x), lambda acc: acc + F.coalesce(F.size("risk_signals"), F.lit(0))).alias("signal_score"),
        F.exists("risk_signals", lambda x: x == "mfa_fatigue").alias("fatigue_flag"),
        F.forall("risk_signals", lambda x: x.isNotNull()).alias("signals_complete"),
    )
)
p = prepared.alias("p")
eligible = (

           (F.col("p.auth_method") == F.col("r.auth_method")) & F.col("r.enabled")
           & F.exists(F.col("p.risk_signals"), lambda x: x == F.col("r.watched_signal")), "left_semi")
    .join(df_access_suppressions.alias("s"),
          (F.col("p.user_id") == F.col("s.user_id")) & F.col("s.active"), "left_anti")
    .select(
        "p.*",
        (F.coalesce("failed_attempts", F.lit(0)) + F.size(F.map_keys("filtered_context"))
         + F.size(F.map_values("scaled_context")) + F.size("normalized_context")
         + F.size("enriched_context") + F.coalesce("signal_score", F.lit(0))).alias("risk_score"),
    )
)
pivoted = (
    df_login_events
    .select(F.to_date("event_time").alias("event_date"), "outcome")
    .groupBy("event_date")
    .pivot("outcome", ["SUCCESS", "FAILURE", "CHALLENGE"])

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_claims
    .filter(F.col("adjuster_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "policy_id",
        "adjuster_id",
        "claim_date",
        "claim_type",
        "approved_amount",
        "reported_at",
        F.round(F.col("approved_amount") * 0.9, 2).alias("approved_amount_adj"),
    )
)

with_details = (
    base.alias("s")
    .join(df_policies.alias("p"), F.col("p.id") == F.col("s.policy_id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("p.product").alias("policy_product"))
)

w_policy_product_by_approved_a = Window.partitionBy("policy_product").orderBy(F.col("approved_amount").desc())
w_all_by_approved_amount = Window.orderBy(F.col("approved_amount").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
windowed = (
    with_details
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.avg("approved_amount_adj").over(Window.partitionBy("policy_product", "adjuster_id").orderBy(F.col("reported_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("approved_amount_adj_avg_3"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_policy_product_by_approved_a), 3).alias("approved_amount_cume_dist"),
        F.first("claim_date", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("policy_product").orderBy(F.col("approved_amount").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_claim_date"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("policy_product", "adjuster_id").orderBy(F.col("reported_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id")).alias("rn"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("approved_amount").asc_nulls_last(), "id")), 3).alias("approved_amount_percent_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("approved_amount").asc_nulls_last())).alias("approved_amount_dense_rank"),
        F.max("approved_amount_adj").over(Window.partitionBy("policy_product", "adjuster_id").orderBy("approved_amount_adj", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("approved_amount_adj_max_2_prior"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("policy_product", "adjuster_id").orderBy("approved_amount_adj")).alias("approved_amount_adj_dense_rank"),
        F.row_number().over(w_all_by_approved_amount).alias("approved_amount_seq"),
    )
)

derived = (
    windowed
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("approved_amount") * 1.07, 2).alias("approved_amount_adj_2"),
        F.least(F.col("rn"), F.col("approved_amount")).alias("least_rn_approved_amount"),
    )
)

per_group = (
    derived
    .groupBy(F.to_date("reported_at").alias("reported_at_day"), "rn")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("approved_amount_adj"), 2).alias("stddev_approved_amount_adj"),
        F.countDistinct("adjuster_id").alias("distinct_adjuster_ids"),
        F.max("approved_amount_seq").alias("max_approved_amount_seq"),
        F.round(F.avg("approved_amount_percent_rank"), 2).alias("avg_approved_amount_percent_rank"),
        F.countDistinct("claim_type").alias("distinct_claim_types"),
        F.avg("approved_amount_seq").alias("avg_approved_amount_seq_check"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_approved_amount_seq_check") > 3)
    .drop("avg_approved_amount_seq_check")
)

w_distinct_claim_types_distinc = Window.partitionBy("distinct_claim_types", "distinct_adjuster_ids")
w_all_by_distinct_claim_types = Window.orderBy("distinct_claim_types", "reported_at_day", "rn")
metrics = (
    per_group
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_distinct_claim_types_distinc).alias("rows_in_distinct_claim_types_distinct_adjuster_i"),

        (F.col("distinct_claim_types") - F.lag("distinct_claim_types").over(w_all_by_distinct_claim_types)).alias("distinct_claim_types_change"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "reported_at_day",
        "rn",
        "stddev_approved_amount_adj",
        "distinct_adjuster_ids",
        "max_approved_amount_seq",
        "distinct_claim_types",
        "rows_in_distinct_claim_types_distinct_adjuster_i",
        "second_stddev_approved_amount_adj",
        "distinct_claim_types_change",
        (F.floor(F.col("distinct_claim_types") / 2) * 2).alias("distinct_claim_types_bucket"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("rn").asc())
)

  Map and array signals feed risk scores; daily pivots add outcome context.

WITH prepared AS (
    SELECT event_id, user_id, auth_method, outcome, risk_signals,
           DATE(event_time) AS event_date,
           ELEMENT_AT(context, 'failed_attempts') AS failed_attempts,
           MAP_FILTER(COALESCE(context, MAP()), (k, v) -> v > 0) AS filtered_context,
           TRANSFORM_VALUES(COALESCE(context, MAP()), (k, v) -> v * 10) AS scaled_context,
           TRANSFORM_KEYS(COALESCE(context, MAP()), (k, v) -> UPPER(k)) AS normalized_context,
           MAP_CONCAT(COALESCE(context, MAP()), MAP('reviewed', 1)) AS enriched_context,
           TRANSFORM(risk_signals, (x, i) -> CONCAT(CAST(i + 1 AS STRING), ':', x)) AS numbered_signals,
           FILTER(risk_signals, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x <> 'new_device') AS scored_signals,
           AGGREGATE(FILTER(risk_signals, x -> x IS NOT NULL), 0,
                     (acc, x) -> acc + LENGTH(x),
                     acc -> acc + COALESCE(SIZE(risk_signals), 0)) AS signal_score,
           EXISTS(risk_signals, x -> x = 'mfa_fatigue') AS fatigue_flag,
           FORALL(risk_signals, x -> x IS NOT NULL) AS signals_complete
    FROM login_events
),
eligible AS (

    SELECT p.*,
           COALESCE(failed_attempts, 0) + SIZE(MAP_KEYS(filtered_context))
             + SIZE(MAP_VALUES(scaled_context)) + SIZE(normalized_context)
             + SIZE(enriched_context) + COALESCE(signal_score, 0) AS risk_score
    FROM prepared p
    LEFT SEMI JOIN alert_rules r
      ON p.auth_method = r.auth_method AND r.enabled
     AND EXISTS(p.risk_signals, x -> x = r.watched_signal)
    LEFT ANTI JOIN access_suppressions s

),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT *

    PIVOT (
        COUNT(*) AS attempts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'FAILURE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures
        FOR outcome IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'CHALLENGE')
    )
),
rolled AS (
    SELECT event_date, auth_method, GROUPING_ID() AS group_level,
           COUNT(*) AS event_count,
           SUM(risk_score) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'FAILURE') AS failure_risk_score,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fatigue_flag) AS fatigue_events,
           MAX(SIZE(numbered_signals)) AS max_signal_count,
           SUM(SIZE(scored_signals)) AS filtered_signal_total,
           MAX(risk_score) FILTER (WHERE signals_complete) AS max_risk_score
    FROM eligible

)

    FROM willow_hermitages

    SELECT site_id, MAX(kwh_per_voltage) AS max_kwh_per_voltage
    FROM filtered_readings

),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_kwh_per_voltage,
        ROUND(s.kwh_per_voltage - g.max_kwh_per_voltage, 2) AS kwh_per_voltage_minus_max
    FROM filtered_readings s
    JOIN site_id_stats g ON g.site_id = s.site_id
    WHERE s.kwh_per_voltage = g.max_kwh_per_voltage
),
windowed AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(kwh_per_voltage_minus_max / NULLIF(SUM(kwh_per_voltage_minus_max) OVER (PARTITION BY quality), 0), 4) AS kwh_per_voltage_minus_max_share_of_quality,
        FIRST_VALUE(kwh) OVER (ORDER BY max_kwh_per_voltage ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_kwh,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(voltage_tier) OVER w_quality) AS distinct_voltage_tier_in_quality
    FROM compared
    WINDOW w_quality AS (PARTITION BY quality)
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(kwh / NULLIF(SUM(kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(read_at)), 0), 4) AS kwh_share_of_read_at_month,
        kwh_per_voltage - LAG(kwh_per_voltage) OVER (ORDER BY kwh_per_voltage_minus_max, id) AS kwh_per_voltage_change
    FROM windowed
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    quality,
    distinct_voltage_tier_in_quality,
    voltage_tier,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(quality)) AS quality_list,

        F.when(F.col("voltage") >= 237.8, "A").when(F.col("voltage") >= 221.4, "B").otherwise("C").alias("voltage_tier"),

    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(F.max("kwh_per_voltage").alias("max_kwh_per_voltage"))

with_activity AS (

    FROM with_children

           arrays_zip(t.stop_codes, t.stop_minutes) AS stop_timing,
           slice(t.stop_codes, 2, 2) AS middle_stops,
           CASE WHEN size(t.stop_codes) > 0 THEN element_at(t.stop_codes, -1) END AS final_stop,
           array_position(t.stop_codes, 'AIRPORT') AS airport_position,
           try_element_at(t.stop_codes, 3) AS third_stop_safe

           median(distance_km) AS median_distance
    FROM enriched

    FROM daily_driver d

    FROM streak_tagged

    from deduped
    group by rollup (date_trunc('year', last_restock), case when quantity >= 189 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end)

    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.site_id,
        a.read_at,

),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(prior_rows_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_7d, site_id ORDER BY read_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_prior_rows_7d,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_7d, site_id ORDER BY read_at DESC), 3) AS read_at_cume_dist,

        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_prior_rows_7d_site_id_by_rea_2, 3) AS read_at_percent_rank,
        NTH_VALUE(prior_kwh_7d, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_7d, site_id ORDER BY read_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_prior_kwh_7d,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prior_rows_7d NULLS LAST, id) AS prior_rows_7d_dense_rank
    FROM covered
    WINDOW w_prior_rows_7d_site_id_by_rea_2 AS (PARTITION BY prior_rows_7d, site_id ORDER BY read_at DESC)

    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM metrics
GROUP BY ROLLUP(first_prior_rows_7d, prior_rows_7d_dense_rank)

    .select(

        "warehouses_v_id",
        "lift_model",
        "pallet_kilos",

    FROM base s
    JOIN channel_or_unknown_stats g ON g.channel_or_unknown = s.channel_or_unknown

),
combined_details AS (

    SELECT

        s.agent_id,
        s.opened_at,
        s.closed_at,
        s.priority,
        s.csat,
        s.tags,
        s.hours_closed_at_to_opened_at,

        s.csat_minus_max,
        su.team AS agent_team
    FROM outliers s
    JOIN support_agents su ON su.id = s.agent_id
)

    SELECT priority, agent_id, agent_team, csat

        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "csat",
        "tags",
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.col("opened_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.col("closed_at"))) / 3600, 1).alias("hours_closed_at_to_opened_at"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("channel"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("channel_or_unknown"),
    )

            FROM app_daily_metrics

        LEFT JOIN app_daily_metrics m
          ON m.app_id = s.app_id AND m.metric_date = s.metric_date
    ) j

        LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(m.rating_events) rv AS rating_pos, rating_evt
    ) f
    JOIN policy_scd p
      ON p.app_id = f.app_id
     AND p.valid_from <= f.rating_at

)

    .select(
        "app_id", "valid_from",
        F.lead("valid_from", 1, "9999-12-31 00:00:00").over(w_policy).alias("valid_to"),
        "review_band",
    )

    df_app_daily_metrics

streaks = (

    .filter(F.col("dl_cnt") >= 100)

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY vcpu_cnt, id) AS seq_no

    df_tunnels_registry
    .filter(F.col("cloud_region") == "us-east-1")
    .select(
        "id",
        "cloud_region",
        "vm_family",
        "vcpu_cnt",
        "paged_at",
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("cloud_region")), " ", "_")).alias("cloud_region_slug"),
    )
)

qualified = (
    base_teams
    .crossJoin(base_teams.agg(F.avg("vcpu_cnt").alias("overall_avg_vcpu_cnt")))
    .filter(F.col("vcpu_cnt") > F.col("overall_avg_vcpu_cnt"))

w_running = Window.orderBy("promo_id", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

matched = (
    df_promotions
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("e.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & (F.col("e.ends_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("e.ends_on") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), "inner")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )

    .filter(F.year("starts_on") == 2024)
    .withColumn("running_min_discount_pct", F.min("discount_pct").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_avg_discount_pct", F.avg("discount_pct").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_max_discount_pct", F.max("discount_pct").over(w_part))

        "starts_on",
        "promo_id",

        "running_max_discount_pct",

        F.lead("running_min_discount_pct").over(w_grp).alias("next_running_min_discount_pct"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("row_seq"),
        F.first("running_min_discount_pct", ignorenulls=True).over(w_running).alias("first_known_running_min_discount_pct"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("starts_on") >= F.lit("2023-08-26").cast("date"))
    .select(

               PARTITION BY listing_id ORDER BY snapshot_date
           )) AS island_key
    FROM stg_listing_days
    WHERE status = 'active'
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT listing_id, island_key, COUNT(*) AS streak_days,
           MAX(garden_position) AS garden_position
    FROM active_days
    GROUP BY listing_id, island_key
),
offer_rollup AS (
    SELECT listing_id,
           ARRAY_SORT(
               COLLECT_LIST(NAMED_STRUCT(
                   'offer_id', offer_id, 'amount', amount,
                   'submitted_on', submitted_on, 'terms', terms
               )),
               (a, b) -> CASE
                   WHEN a.amount > b.amount THEN -1
                   WHEN a.amount < b.amount THEN 1
                   WHEN a.offer_id < b.offer_id THEN -1
                   WHEN a.offer_id > b.offer_id THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END
           ) AS sorted_offers
    FROM stg_offers
    GROUP BY listing_id
),
screened AS (
    SELECT l.*,
           -- A blocked NULL rejects NOT IN matches; NOT EXISTS still passes.
           l.agent_id NOT IN (
               SELECT agent_id FROM fct_agent_flags WHERE review_state = 'blocked'
           ) AS passes_not_in,
           NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM fct_agent_flags f
               WHERE f.review_state = 'blocked' AND f.agent_id = l.agent_id
           ) AS passes_not_exists
    FROM dim_listings l
    LEFT SEMI JOIN stg_offers o ON o.listing_id = l.listing_id
    LEFT ANTI JOIN stg_listing_days d
        ON d.listing_id = l.listing_id AND d.status = 'withdrawn'
)
SELECT s.listing_id, s.city, a.longest_active_streak, a.garden_position,
       ELEMENT_AT(r.sorted_offers, -1).offer_id AS lowest_offer_id,
       TRY_ELEMENT_AT(r.sorted_offers, 5).offer_id AS fifth_offer_id,
       ARRAYS_ZIP(
           SLICE(r.sorted_offers, 1, 2), SLICE(r.sorted_offers, 2, 2)
       ) AS offer_matchups,
       s.passes_not_in, s.passes_not_exists
FROM screened s
JOIN (
    SELECT listing_id, MAX(streak_days) AS longest_active_streak,
           MAX(garden_position) AS garden_position
    FROM streaks
    GROUP BY listing_id
) a ON a.listing_id = s.listing_id
JOIN offer_rollup r ON r.listing_id = s.listing_id
ORDER BY s.listing_id
```

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_day = Window.partitionBy("listing_id").orderBy("snapshot_date")
active_days = (
    df_stg_listing_days
    .filter(F.col("status") == "active")
    .select(
        "listing_id",
        "snapshot_date",
        "asking_price",
        F.array_position(F.col("tags"), "garden").alias("garden_position"),
        F.date_sub(F.col("snapshot_date"), F.row_number().over(w_day)).alias("island_key"),
    )
)

streaks = (
    active_days
    .groupBy("listing_id", "island_key")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("streak_days"),
        F.max("garden_position").alias("garden_position"),
    )
)

activity = (
    streaks
    .groupBy("listing_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("streak_days").alias("longest_active_streak"),
        F.max("garden_position").alias("garden_position"),
    )
)

def offer_order(a, b):
    return (
        F.when(a.amount > b.amount, -1)
        .when(a.amount < b.amount, 1)
        .when(a.offer_id < b.offer_id, -1)
        .when(a.offer_id > b.offer_id, 1)
        .otherwise(0)
    )

offer_rollup = (
    df_stg_offers
    .groupBy("listing_id")
    .agg(
        F.array_sort(
            F.collect_list(F.struct("offer_id", "amount", "submitted_on", "terms")),
            offer_order,
        ).alias("sorted_offers")
    )
)

blocked = df_fct_agent_flags.filter(F.col("review_state") == "blocked")
blocked_nonnull = blocked.filter(F.col("agent_id").isNotNull()).select("agent_id").dropDuplicates()
blocked_stats = blocked.agg(F.sum(F.when(F.col("agent_id").isNull(), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("null_agent_rows"))
passes_not_in = (
    F.when(F.col("bf.agent_id").isNotNull(), F.lit(False))
    .when(F.col("bs.null_agent_rows") > 0, F.lit(False))
    .when(F.col("l.agent_id").isNull(), F.lit(None).cast("boolean"))
    .otherwise(F.lit(True))
)
screened = (
    df_dim_listings.alias("l")
    .join(df_stg_offers.alias("o"), F.col("o.listing_id") == F.col("l.listing_id"), "left_semi")
    .join(
        df_stg_listing_days.alias("d"),
        (F.col("d.listing_id") == F.col("l.listing_id")) & (F.col("d.status") == "withdrawn"),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .crossJoin(blocked_stats.alias("bs"))
    .join(blocked_nonnull.alias("bf"), F.col("bf.agent_id") == F.col("l.agent_id"), "left")
    .select("l.*", passes_not_in.alias("passes_not_in"), F.col("bf.agent_id").isNull().alias("passes_not_exists"))
)

result = (
    screened.alias("s")
    .join(activity.alias("a"), F.col("a.listing_id") == F.col("s.listing_id"))
    .join(offer_rollup.alias("r"), F.col("r.listing_id") == F.col("s.listing_id"))
    .select(
        "s.listing_id",
        "s.city",
        "a.longest_active_streak",
        "a.garden_position",
        F.element_at(F.col("r.sorted_offers"), -1).getField("offer_id").alias("lowest_offer_id"),
        F.try_element_at(F.col("r.sorted_offers"), F.lit(5)).getField("offer_id").alias("fifth_offer_id"),
        F.arrays_zip(F.slice("r.sorted_offers", 1, 2), F.slice("r.sorted_offers", 2, 2)).alias("offer_matchups"),
        "s.passes_not_in",
        "s.passes_not_exists",
    )
    .orderBy("s.listing_id")
)
```

                       (k, v) -> lower(k)

           )) as priced_lines,

                   'line_no', i + 1,
                   'cost_code', x.cost_code,
                   'extended', cast(x.quantity * x.unit_rate as decimal(12,2))
               )),
               cast(0 as decimal(12,2)),
               (acc, x) -> cast(acc + coalesce(x.extended, cast(0 as decimal(12,2))) as decimal(12,2)),

           ) as decimal(14,2)) as change_total,
           exists(line_items, x -> x.quantity >= 25) as bulk_work,
           forall(line_items, x -> x.unit_rate is not null) as all_priced,

    from map_stage m

),

           count(item.cost_code) as priced_line_count,
           array_join(array_sort(filter(collect_set(item.cost_code), x -> x is not null)), ' > ') as cost_code_path,
           array_sort(collect_list(named_struct(

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

zero = F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)")
map_stage = (
    df_change_order_log.alias("c")
    .join(df_construction_projects.alias("p"), F.col("p.project_id") == F.col("c.project_id"))
    .filter(F.col("c.status").isin("approved", "pending"))
    .select(
        "c.*",
        "p.project_name",
        F.map_concat(
            F.transform_values(
                F.transform_keys(
                    F.map_filter(F.col("c.adjustments"), lambda k, v: v.isNotNull() & (v != 0)),
                    lambda k, v: F.lower(k),
                ),
                lambda k, v: F.round(v * F.lit("1.10").cast("decimal(3,2)"), 2),
            ),
            F.col("p.standard_adjustments"),
        ).alias("merged_adjustments"),
    )
)

def price_lines(lines):
    return F.transform(lines, lambda x, i: F.struct(
        (i + 1).alias("line_no"),
        x["cost_code"].alias("cost_code"),
        (x["quantity"] * x["unit_rate"]).cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("extended"),
    ))

priced_lines = price_lines(F.col("line_items"))
priced = (
    map_stage
    .select(
        "*",
        priced_lines.alias("priced_lines"),
        F.aggregate(
            priced_lines,
            zero,
            lambda acc, x: (acc + F.coalesce(x["extended"], zero)).cast("decimal(12,2)"),
            lambda acc: acc + F.coalesce(F.element_at(F.col("merged_adjustments"), "contingency"), zero),
        ).cast("decimal(14,2)").alias("change_total"),
        F.exists(F.col("line_items"), lambda x: x["quantity"] >= 25).alias("bulk_work"),
        F.forall(F.col("line_items"), lambda x: x["unit_rate"].isNotNull()).alias("all_priced"),
        F.size(F.filter(F.col("line_items"), lambda x: x["quantity"] * x["unit_rate"] >= 1000)).alias("major_line_count"),
    )
)
expanded = priced.select(
    "project_id", "change_id",
    F.posexplode_outer("line_items").alias("line_pos", "item"),
)
line_rollup = (
    expanded
    .groupBy("project_id", "change_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.col("item.cost_code")).alias("priced_line_count"),
        F.array_join(F.array_sort(F.filter(F.collect_set(F.col("item.cost_code")), lambda x: x.isNotNull())), " > ").alias("cost_code_path"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_list(F.struct(
            (F.col("line_pos") + 1).alias("line_no"),
            F.col("item.cost_code").alias("cost_code"),
            F.size(F.col("item.notes")).alias("note_count"),
        ))).alias("line_details"),
    )
)
result = (
    priced.alias("p")
    .join(line_rollup.alias("r"), ["project_id", "change_id"])
    .select(
        "project_id", "project_name", "change_id", "status", "change_total",
        "bulk_work", "all_priced", "major_line_count", "priced_line_count",
        "cost_code_path",
        F.array_sort(F.map_keys("merged_adjustments")).alias("adjustment_keys"),
        F.map_values("merged_adjustments").alias("adjustment_values"),
        "line_details",
    )
    .orderBy("project_id", "change_id")
)

    SELECT

        COUNT(*) AS play_count,
        COUNT(*) AS play_count_2
    FROM plays
    GROUP BY listener_id

    -- Attach plays metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.first_played_at,
        COALESCE(p.play_count, 0) AS play_count,
        COALESCE(p.play_count_2, 0) AS play_count_2
    FROM in_window s
    LEFT JOIN play_stats p ON p.listener_id = s.listener_id
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per listener_id
    SELECT

        listener_id,
        played_at,

        FROM with_counts

),
totals AS (

        MAX(first_played_at) AS last_first_played_at,
        ROUND(SUM(prior_rows_1d) / NULLIF(SUM(prior_ms_played_1d), 0), 3) AS prior_rows_1d_to_prior_ms_played_1d_ratio

in_window = (
    df_plays.alias("a")
    .join(

        & (F.col("b.played_at") < F.col("a.played_at"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") >= F.col("a.played_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.listener_id", "a.played_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_1d"),
        F.sum("b.ms_played").alias("prior_ms_played_1d"),

    df_plays

    .agg(
        F.min("played_at").alias("first_played_at"),
        F.count("*").alias("play_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("play_count_2"),

)

with_counts = (

totals = (

        F.min("played_at").alias("first_played_at_2"),
        F.min("first_played_at").alias("first_first_played_at"),
        F.max("first_played_at").alias("last_first_played_at"),
        F.round(F.sum("prior_rows_1d") / F.nullif(F.sum("prior_ms_played_1d"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("prior_rows_1d_to_prior_ms_played_1d_ratio"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("row_count") >= 3)

    FROM clusters

    FROM valid_clusters

    FROM flagged

screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg

with_activity AS (

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("amount", "id")
w_grp_2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("last3_count_quantity", "id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("last3_max_quantity", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_fleets
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("quantity") == 5))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        F.col("quantity").cast("string").alias("quantity_num"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .withColumn("last3_count_quantity", F.count("quantity").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("last3_min_quantity", F.min("quantity").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("last3_sum_quantity", F.sum("quantity").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("last3_max_quantity", F.max("quantity").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("last_known_quantity", F.last("quantity", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("product_id", "order_id").orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))
)

joined = (

    .alias("a")
    .join(df_textiles.alias("o"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "left")

        "a.last3_count_quantity",
        "a.last3_min_quantity",
        "a.last3_max_quantity",
        "a.last_known_quantity",
        F.col("o.status"),
        F.col("o.order_date"),
        F.col("o.amount"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    joined
    .withColumn("amount_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("prev_quantity", F.lag("quantity", 1).over(w_grp_2))
    .withColumn("quantity_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc())))
    .withColumn("last3_max_quantity_avg_5", F.avg("last3_max_quantity").over(w_hist))
)

stats = (
    with_windows
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("quantity_tier"),

    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("order_id").alias("distinct_order_ids"),

)

    .select("quantity_tier", "pending_rows")

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Scope the ticket_events rows
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor,
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', event_at) AS event_at_hour
    FROM ticket_events
    WHERE ticket_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_children_events AS (
    -- One row per event
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.ticket_id,
        s.event_at,
        s.event_type,
        s.actor,
        t.id AS event_id,
        t.event_at AS event_event_at,
        t.event_type AS event_event_type,
        t.actor AS event_actor
    FROM cleaned s
    LEFT JOIN ticket_events t ON t.ticket_id = s.ticket_id AND HOUR(t.event_at) BETWEEN 10 AND 14
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach ticket_events metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_events t WHERE t.ticket_id = s.ticket_id) AS event_count
    FROM with_children_events s
)
SELECT
    id,
    ticket_id,
    event_type,
    actor,
    event_id,
    event_event_at,
    event_event_type,
    event_count,
    COALESCE(event_count, 0) AS event_count_filled
FROM profiled
ORDER BY event_event_at DESC NULLS FIRST
```

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_ticket_events
    .filter(F.col("ticket_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.date_trunc("hour", F.col("event_at")).alias("event_at_hour"),
    )
)

with_children_events = (
    cleaned.alias("s")
    .join(df_ticket_events.alias("t"), (F.col("t.ticket_id") == F.col("s.ticket_id")) & (F.hour(F.col("t.event_at")).between(10, 14)), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.ticket_id",
        "s.event_at",
        "s.event_type",
        "s.actor",
        F.col("t.id").alias("event_id"),
        F.col("t.event_at").alias("event_event_at"),
        F.col("t.event_type").alias("event_event_type"),
        F.col("t.actor").alias("event_actor"),
    )
)

event_stats = (
    df_ticket_events
    .groupBy("ticket_id")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("event_count"))
)

profiled = (
    with_children_events.alias("s")
    .join(event_stats.alias("t"), F.col("t.ticket_id") == F.col("s.ticket_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("t.event_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("event_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    profiled
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        "event_id",
        "event_event_at",
        "event_event_type",
        "event_count",
        F.coalesce(F.col("event_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("event_count_filled"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("event_event_at").desc_nulls_first())
)

    -- One row per active day, including days without a delivery report.
    SELECT r.ad_id, r.campaign, d.report_dt
    FROM ad_registry r
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(r.start_dt, r.end_dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) d AS report_dt
    WHERE r.is_enabled
),
filled AS (
    SELECT c.ad_id, c.campaign, c.report_dt,
           LAST(s.cum_imps, TRUE) OVER (
               PARTITION BY c.ad_id ORDER BY c.report_dt
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cum_imps,
           LAST(s.cum_clicks, TRUE) OVER (
               PARTITION BY c.ad_id ORDER BY c.report_dt
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cum_clicks
    FROM calendar c
    LEFT JOIN ad_daily_stats s
      ON s.ad_id = c.ad_id AND s.report_dt = c.report_dt
),
long_stats AS (
    -- STACK retains the leading NULLs before an ad's first report.
    SELECT f.ad_id, f.campaign, f.report_dt, metric_name, metric_value
    FROM filled f
    LATERAL VIEW STACK(2, 'impressions', f.cum_imps, 'clicks', f.cum_clicks) u
      AS metric_name, metric_value
),
ad_quality AS (
    SELECT ad_id,
           -- Index i aligns each click count with its hourly impression count.
           ROUND(AVG(AGGREGATE(
               TRANSFORM(hourly_clicks, (x, i) ->
                   CASE WHEN ELEMENT_AT(hourly_imps, i + 1) >= 100 AND x >= 0
                        THEN x ELSE 0 END),
               CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + x,
               acc -> acc / SIZE(hourly_clicks)
           )), 2) AS avg_valid_clicks,
           MAX(SIZE(FILTER(hourly_imps, x -> x >= 100))) AS peak_qualified_hours,
           BOOL_OR(EXISTS(hourly_clicks, x -> x >= 3)) AS engaged,
           BOOL_AND(FORALL(hourly_clicks, x -> x >= 0)) AS counts_valid,
           MAX(ELEMENT_AT(TRANSFORM_VALUES(
               MAP_FILTER(device_clicks, (k, v) -> v >= 2),
               (k, v) -> v * 10), 'mobile')) AS mobile_score
    FROM ad_daily_stats
    GROUP BY ad_id
)
SELECT l.ad_id, l.campaign, l.metric_name,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.metric_value) AS p50_value,
       q.avg_valid_clicks, q.peak_qualified_hours, q.engaged,
       q.counts_valid, q.mobile_score
FROM long_stats l
JOIN ad_quality q ON q.ad_id = l.ad_id
GROUP BY l.ad_id, l.campaign, l.metric_name, q.avg_valid_clicks,

    )

    Window.partitionBy("c.ad_id")
    .orderBy("c.report_dt")
    .rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

    SELECT *, LAG(paid_at_period) OVER (PARTITION BY method_src ORDER BY paid_at_period, id) AS prev_paid_at_period

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_paid_at_period IS NULL OR paid_at_period > prev_paid_at_period + INTERVAL 60 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM with_prev
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY method_src ORDER BY paid_at_period, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps
)

    df_raw_looms
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-18"))) & F.col("method_src").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("method_src", F.lit("N/A")).alias("method_filled"),
        F.coalesce("method_src", F.lit("N/A")).alias("method_filled_2"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(

    )
)

metrics = (
    filtered

)

    FROM flagged

    SELECT
        r.id,
        r.site_id,
        r.read_at,

        tw.rate,

    FROM meter_readings r
    JOIN sites st ON st.id = r.site_id
    JOIN tariff_windows tw
      ON tw.tariff = st.tariff
     AND r.read_at >= tw.valid_from
     AND r.read_at < tw.valid_to
),
qualified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose site matches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM matched s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sites si
            WHERE si.id = s.site_id
              AND si.installed_kw > 66.5
              AND si.tariff = 'TOU'
        )
),
annotated AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(kwh / NULLIF(energy_cost, 0), 3) AS kwh_per_energy_cost,
        COALESCE(quality, 'UNKNOWN') AS quality_or_unknown,
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', read_at) AS read_at_year
    FROM qualified
),
zone_stats AS (
    -- Median rate per zone
    SELECT zone, PERCENTILE_APPROX(rate, 0.5) AS median_rate
    FROM annotated
    GROUP BY zone
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT s.*, g.median_rate, ROUND(s.rate - g.median_rate, 2) AS rate_minus_median
    FROM annotated s
    JOIN zone_stats g ON g.zone = s.zone
    WHERE s.rate >= g.median_rate
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    read_at,
    quality,
    rate,
    energy_cost,
    kwh_per_energy_cost,
    quality_or_unknown,
    median_rate,
    LOWER(TRIM(quality_or_unknown)) AS quality_or_unknown_clean,
    CASE WHEN kwh_per_energy_cost >= 6.5 THEN 'A' WHEN kwh_per_energy_cost >= 3.0 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS kwh_per_energy_cost_tier
FROM outliers
WHERE quality_or_unknown <> 'BAD'
ORDER BY quality_or_unknown DESC, energy_cost

matched = (
    df_meter_readings.alias("r")
    .join(df_sites.alias("st"), F.col("st.id") == F.col("r.site_id"), "inner")
    .join(
        df_tariff_windows.alias("tw"),
        (F.col("tw.tariff") == F.col("st.tariff"))
        & (F.col("r.read_at") >= F.col("tw.valid_from"))
        & (F.col("r.read_at") < F.col("tw.valid_to")),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "r.id",
        "r.site_id",
        "r.read_at",
        "r.kwh",
        "r.quality",
        "st.zone",

    )
)

qualified = (
    matched.alias("s")
    .join(df_sites.alias("si"), (F.col("si.id") == F.col("s.site_id")) & (F.col("si.installed_kw") > 66.5) & (F.col("si.tariff") == "TOU"), "left_anti")
)

result = (

        event_at,
        event_type,

        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', event_at) AS days_since_event_at,

        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor,
        days_since_event_at,
        event_type_actor_label,
        actor_prefix
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor, event_type ORDER BY event_at, id) AS row_num
        FROM scoped_events
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per actor
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor,
        days_since_event_at,
        event_type_actor_label,
        actor_prefix
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY days_since_event_at DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM latest
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    ticket_id,
    COALESCE(event_type, 'ALL') AS event_type,
    COALESCE(actor, 'ALL') AS actor,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(event_type)) AS event_type_list
FROM deduped
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((ticket_id, event_type, actor), (ticket_id), ())

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_events = (
    df_tbl_greenhouses
    .filter((F.col("actor").isin("agent", "system")) & (F.month(F.col("event_at")).isin(1, 3)))
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("event_at")).alias("days_since_event_at"),
        F.concat_ws("-", F.col("event_type"), F.col("actor")).alias("event_type_actor_label"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("actor")), 1, 2).alias("actor_prefix"),
    )

    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("actor", "event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

deduped = (

    .withColumn("recency_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("actor").orderBy(F.col("days_since_event_at").desc(), F.col("id").desc())))

WITH tier_windows AS (
    -- Build half-open SCD2 validity intervals for each reward tier version
    SELECT campaign_id, tier_name, min_pledge, valid_from,
           LEAD(valid_from, 1, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 00:00:00')
               OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS valid_to,
           min_pledge IS DISTINCT FROM LAG(min_pledge)
               OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS pledge_changed
    FROM reward_tiers
),
matched AS (
    -- As-of join: attach the tier valid at pledge time plus a trailing 7-day funded sum
    SELECT p.campaign_id, p.pledge_id, p.backer_id, p.amount, p.pledged_at, p.status, p.payment_method,
           (p.amount >= t.min_pledge) AS meets_min,
           t.pledge_changed,
           SUM(p.amount) OVER (
               PARTITION BY p.campaign_id
               ORDER BY p.pledged_at
               RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '7' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS trailing_7d_amount
    FROM pledges p
    LEFT JOIN tier_windows t
      ON t.campaign_id = p.campaign_id
     AND p.pledged_at >= t.valid_from
     AND p.pledged_at < t.valid_to
),
stats AS (
    -- Per-campaign highlights: top backer, first pledge, failures, peak weekly momentum
    SELECT campaign_id,
           MAX_BY(backer_id, amount) AS top_backer,
           MIN_BY(pledge_id, pledged_at) AS first_pledge_id,
           COUNT_IF(status = 'failed') AS failed_cnt,
           BOOL_OR(meets_min) AS any_meets_min,
           BOOL_OR(pledge_changed) AS tier_repriced,
           MAX(trailing_7d_amount) AS peak_7d_amount
    FROM matched
    GROUP BY campaign_id
),
pivoted AS (
    -- Payment-method breakdown with two aggregates per method
    SELECT *
    FROM (SELECT campaign_id, payment_method, pledge_id, amount FROM matched) m
    PIVOT (
        COUNT(pledge_id) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total
        FOR payment_method IN ('card', 'paypal', 'bank')
    )
)
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, s.top_backer, s.first_pledge_id, s.failed_cnt,
       s.any_meets_min, s.tier_repriced, s.peak_7d_amount,
       ROUND(s.peak_7d_amount / c.goal, 4) AS peak_pct_of_goal,
       p.card_n, p.card_total, p.paypal_n, p.paypal_total, p.bank_n, p.bank_total
FROM campaigns c
JOIN stats s ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
JOIN pivoted p ON p.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
ORDER BY c.campaign_id

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_tier = Window.partitionBy("campaign_id").orderBy("valid_from")

tier_windows = (
    df_reward_tiers
    .select(
        "campaign_id",
        "tier_name",
        "min_pledge",
        "valid_from",
        F.coalesce(
            F.lead("valid_from", 1).over(w_tier),
            F.lit("9999-12-31 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"),
        ).alias("valid_to"),
        (~F.col("min_pledge").eqNullSafe(F.lag("min_pledge").over(w_tier))).alias("pledge_changed"),
    )
)

w_roll = (
    Window.partitionBy("p.campaign_id")
    .orderBy(F.col("p.pledged_at").cast("long"))
    .rangeBetween(-7 * 86400, 0)
)

matched = (
    df_pledges.alias("p")
    .join(
        tier_windows.alias("t"),
        (F.col("t.campaign_id") == F.col("p.campaign_id"))
        & (F.col("p.pledged_at") >= F.col("t.valid_from"))
        & (F.col("p.pledged_at") < F.col("t.valid_to")),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "p.campaign_id",
        "p.pledge_id",
        "p.backer_id",
        "p.amount",
        "p.pledged_at",
        "p.status",
        "p.payment_method",
        (F.col("p.amount") >= F.col("t.min_pledge")).alias("meets_min"),
        F.col("t.pledge_changed"),
        F.sum("p.amount").over(w_roll).alias("trailing_7d_amount"),
    )
)

stats = (
    matched
    .groupBy("campaign_id")
    .agg(
        F.max_by("backer_id", "amount").alias("top_backer"),
        F.min_by("pledge_id", "pledged_at").alias("first_pledge_id"),
        F.count_if(F.col("status") == "failed").alias("failed_cnt"),
        F.bool_or("meets_min").alias("any_meets_min"),
        F.bool_or("pledge_changed").alias("tier_repriced"),
        F.max("trailing_7d_amount").alias("peak_7d_amount"),
    )
)

pivoted = (
    matched
    .select("campaign_id", "payment_method", "pledge_id", "amount")
    .groupBy("campaign_id")
    .pivot("payment_method", ["card", "paypal", "bank"])
    .agg(
        F.count("pledge_id").alias("n"),
        F.sum("amount").alias("total"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_campaigns.alias("c")
    .join(stats.alias("s"), "campaign_id")
    .join(pivoted.alias("p"), "campaign_id")
    .select(
        "c.campaign_id",
        "c.campaign_name",
        "s.top_backer",
        "s.first_pledge_id",
        "s.failed_cnt",
        "s.any_meets_min",
        "s.tier_repriced",
        "s.peak_7d_amount",
        F.round(F.col("s.peak_7d_amount") / F.col("c.goal"), 4).alias("peak_pct_of_goal"),
        "p.card_n",
        "p.card_total",
        "p.paypal_n",
        "p.paypal_total",
        "p.bank_n",
        "p.bank_total",
    )

)

        round(cost / sum(cost) over (partition by status), 4) as cost_share_2
    from cleaned
    where status = 'LOST'
    window w_running as (partition by carrier, status order by delivered_date_plus_months, id), w_hist as (order by cost, id rows between 6 preceding and 1 preceding)
),
enriched as (
    select
        id,

        status,
        status_group,
        seq_no,
        row_seq,

        lag(row_seq) over w_recent as prev_row_seq,
        lead(row_seq) over w_recent as next_row_seq,
        row_number() over w_recent as seq_no_2,
        percent_rank() over (partition by status order by cost_share desc) as cost_share_percent_rank
    from with_windows
    window w_recent as (partition by status order by delivered_date, id)
)
select
    id,
    status_group,
    row_seq,
    cost_share_2,

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("carrier", "status").orderBy("delivered_date_plus_months", "id")
w_hist = Window.orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("delivered_date", "id")

filtered = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") >= F.lit("2023-03-13").cast("date")) & F.col("carrier").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.dayofmonth("delivered_date").alias("delivered_date_day"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("status") != "LOST")
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("status").isin(["RETURNED", "IN_TRANSIT"]), "Tier 1").otherwise("Other").alias("status_group"),
        F.add_months("delivered_date", 1).alias("delivered_date_plus_months"),

with_windows = (

    .filter(F.col("status") == "LOST")
    .select(

        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        "status_group",

        F.row_number().over(w_running).alias("seq_no"),
        F.avg("cost").over(w_hist).alias("cost_avg_6_prior"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("delivered_date").desc(), "id")).alias("row_seq"),
        F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(Window.partitionBy("status"))), 4).alias("cost_share_2"),

        "cost",
        "status",
        "status_group",
        "seq_no",
        "row_seq",

        F.lag("row_seq").over(w_recent).alias("prev_row_seq"),
        F.lead("row_seq").over(w_recent).alias("next_row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w_recent).alias("seq_no_2"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("cost_share").desc())).alias("cost_share_percent_rank"),
    )

WITH matched AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.sku_id,
        a.moved_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS pantrie_mark,
        SUM(b.qty) AS prior_qty_7d
    FROM raw_cabins a
    LEFT JOIN raw_cabins b
      ON b.sku_id = a.sku_id
     AND b.moved_at < a.moved_at
     AND b.moved_at >= a.moved_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.sku_id, a.moved_at
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2026-01-01', moved_at) AS ivory_theater,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', moved_at) AS days_since_moved_at_2
    FROM matched
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    moved_at,
    pantrie_mark,
    days_since_moved_at_2,
    COALESCE(pantrie_mark, 0) AS prior_rows_7d_filled,
    ivory_theater + prior_qty_7d AS elevator_qty
FROM annotated
WHERE moved_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-02 09:00:00'
ORDER BY prior_rows_7d_filled
```

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

matched = (
    df_raw_cabins.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_raw_cabins.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.sku_id") == F.col("a.sku_id"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") < F.col("a.moved_at"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") >= F.col("a.moved_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.sku_id", "a.moved_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("pantrie_mark"),
        F.sum("b.qty").alias("prior_qty_7d"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    matched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2026-01-01").cast("date"), F.col("moved_at")).alias("ivory_theater"),
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("moved_at")).alias("days_since_moved_at_2"),
    )
)

result = (

        "moved_at",
        "pantrie_mark",
        "days_since_moved_at_2",
        F.coalesce(F.col("pantrie_mark"), F.lit(0)).alias("prior_rows_7d_filled"),
        (F.col("ivory_theater") + F.col("prior_qty_7d")).alias("elevator_qty"),

enriched AS (

        "ms_played",
        "device",
        "is_skipped",
        "source",
        F.date_format(F.col("played_at"), "yyyy-MM").alias("played_at_label"),
    )
)

w_listener_id_by_played_at_tie = Window.partitionBy("listener_id").orderBy(F.col("played_at").desc())
w_is_skipped = Window.partitionBy("is_skipped")
w_device = Window.partitionBy("device")
w_all_by_ms_played = Window.orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc(), "id")
w_all_by_ms_played_ties = Window.orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc_nulls_first())
sequenced = (
    valid_plays
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_listener_id_by_played_at_tie), 3).alias("played_at_cume_dist"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("listener_id").orderBy(F.col("played_at").desc(), "id")).alias("played_at_quintile"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc_nulls_first())), 3).alias("ms_played_cume_dist"),
        F.round(F.col("ms_played") - F.avg("ms_played").over(Window.partitionBy("source", "listener_id")), 2).alias("ms_played_vs_source_listener_id_avg"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_is_skipped).alias("rows_in_is_skipped"),
        F.round(F.avg("ms_played").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-1, -1)), 2).alias("ms_played_avg_1_prior"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_device).alias("rows_in_device"),
        F.lead("played_at").over(w_all_by_ms_played).alias("next_played_at"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_all_by_ms_played_ties), 3).alias("ms_played_percent_rank"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("track_id").over(Window.partitionBy("is_skipped"))).alias("distinct_track_id_in_is_skipped"),
    )
)

derived = (
    sequenced
    .filter(F.col("rows_in_device") > 7)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat(F.col("source"), F.lit("#"), F.col("track_id").cast("string")).alias("source_ref"),

        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy("ms_played_percent_rank", "id")).alias("ms_played_percent_rank_rank"),

        "played_at_label",
        "played_at_cume_dist",
        "played_at_quintile",

        "ms_played_vs_source_listener_id_avg",
        "ms_played_avg_1_prior",
        "rows_in_device",

        "distinct_track_id_in_is_skipped",

        "ms_played_percent_rank_rank",

    from deduped

           arrays_zip(t.stop_codes, t.stop_minutes) AS stop_timing,
           slice(t.stop_codes, 2, 2) AS middle_stops,
           CASE WHEN size(t.stop_codes) > 0 THEN element_at(t.stop_codes, -1) END AS final_stop,
           array_position(t.stop_codes, 'AIRPORT') AS airport_position,
           try_element_at(t.stop_codes, 3) AS third_stop_safe

           max(service_date) AS streak_end,

        ROUND(enrolled_at_quarter / NULLIF(SUM(enrolled_at_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id, term), 0), 4) AS enrolled_at_quarter_share_of_student_id_term,

        SUM(enrolled_at_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status, MONTH(enrolled_at) ORDER BY enrolled_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS enrolled_at_quarter_sum_3,

        SUM(enrolled_at_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(enrolled_at)) AS midnight_lense,
        LEAD(enrolled_at_quarter, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status, MONTH(enrolled_at) ORDER BY enrolled_at DESC, id) AS next2_enrolled_at_quarter

    FROM sequenced
    WHERE quartz_thermostat <= 3

WITH claimed_monthly AS (
    -- claimed rows per opened_on_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_on) AS opened_on_month, COUNT(*) AS claimed_count, ROUND(AVG(belt_no), 2) AS claimed_avg_belt_no
    FROM gates
    WHERE bag_state = 'claimed'

delayed_monthly AS (

    FROM gates
    WHERE bag_state = 'delayed'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_on)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.opened_on_month, b.opened_on_month) AS opened_on_month,
    COALESCE(a.claimed_count, 0) AS claimed_count,
    COALESCE(a.claimed_avg_belt_no, 0) AS claimed_avg_belt_no,
    COALESCE(b.delayed_count, 0) AS delayed_count,
    b.delayed_total_belt_no,
    COALESCE(a.claimed_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.delayed_count, 0) AS claimed_count_minus_delayed_count
FROM claimed_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN delayed_monthly b
  ON a.opened_on_month = b.opened_on_month
ORDER BY opened_on_month
```

claimed_monthly = (
    df_gates
    .filter(F.col("bag_state") == "claimed")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "opened_on").alias("opened_on_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("claimed_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("belt_no"), 2).alias("claimed_avg_belt_no"),
    )
)

    df_gates
    .filter(F.col("bag_state") == "delayed")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "opened_on").alias("opened_on_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("delayed_count"),
        F.sum("belt_no").alias("delayed_total_belt_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    claimed_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(delayed_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.opened_on_month") == F.col("b.opened_on_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.opened_on_month"), F.col("b.opened_on_month")).alias("opened_on_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.claimed_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("claimed_count"),

        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.claimed_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.delayed_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("claimed_count_minus_delayed_count"),

    FROM tickets

    SELECT

        closed_at,
        priority,
        channel,
        csat,
        requester_id_tier,
        least_csat_requester_id
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, requester_id_tier ORDER BY least_csat_requester_id DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM valid
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    agent_id,
    COALESCE(channel, 'ALL') AS channel,
    COALESCE(requester_id_tier, 'ALL') AS requester_id_tier,
    SUM(csat) AS total_csat,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(least_csat_requester_id, 0.5) AS median_least_csat_requester_id
FROM latest_per_key
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((agent_id, channel, requester_id_tier), (agent_id), (channel), ())
ORDER BY agent_id NULLS LAST, channel NULLS LAST, requester_id_tier NULLS LAST

        ROUND(listing_asking_price - AVG(listing_asking_price) OVER (PARTITION BY listing_ref, has_parking), 2) AS listing_asking_price_vs_listing_ref_has_parking_,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY listing_ref ORDER BY offer_made_at ASC), 3) AS offer_made_at_percent_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(listing_asking_price) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY listing_asking_price ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_listing_asking_price

        F.col("l.asking_price").alias("listing_asking_price"),
    )
)

w_property_kind_by_offer_made = Window.partitionBy("property_kind").orderBy(F.col("offer_made_at").desc(), "id")
w_listing_ref_has_parking = Window.partitionBy("listing_ref", "has_parking")
with_trends = (

        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_listing_ref_has_parking).alias("rows_in_listing_ref_has_parking"),
        F.nth_value("listing_asking_price", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("listing_ref").orderBy("offer_made_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_listing_asking_price"),
        F.nth_value("listing_offer_made_ts", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("property_kind").orderBy(F.col("offer_made_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_listing_offer_made_ts"),
        F.max("listing_asking_price").over(Window.partitionBy("listing_ref", "has_parking")).alias("listing_ref_has_parking_max_listing_asking_price"),

        F.size(F.collect_set("property_kind").over(Window.partitionBy("listing_ref", "has_parking"))).alias("distinct_property_kind_in_listing_ref_has_parkin"),
        F.sum("listing_asking_price").over(Window.orderBy("listing_asking_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_listing_asking_price"),
        F.round(F.col("listing_asking_price") - F.avg("listing_asking_price").over(Window.partitionBy("listing_ref", "has_parking")), 2).alias("listing_asking_price_vs_listing_ref_has_parking_"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("listing_ref").orderBy("offer_made_at")), 3).alias("offer_made_at_percent_rank"),

with bounds as (
    select min(loss_date) as first_day, max(loss_date) as last_day
    from insured_damages_log
),
spine as (
    select explode(sequence(first_day, last_day, interval 1 day)) as cal_day
    from bounds
),
daily as (
    select loss_date as cal_day, sum(days_to_settle) as days_to_settle_total
    from insured_damages_log
    where loss_date is not null
    group by loss_date
)
select s.cal_day,
       d.days_to_settle_total,
       last(d.days_to_settle_total, true) over (order by s.cal_day rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as days_to_settle_filled

order by s.cal_day

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

bounds = df_insured_damages_log.agg(
    F.min("loss_date").alias("first_day"),
    F.max("loss_date").alias("last_day"),
)

spine = bounds.select(
    F.explode(F.sequence("first_day", "last_day", F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAY"))).alias("cal_day")
)

daily = (
    df_insured_damages_log
    .filter(F.col("loss_date").isNotNull())
    .groupBy(F.col("loss_date").alias("cal_day"))
    .agg(F.sum("days_to_settle").alias("days_to_settle_total"))
)

    .select(
        F.col("s.cal_day").alias("cal_day"),
        F.col("d.days_to_settle_total"),
        F.last(F.col("d.days_to_settle_total"), ignorenulls=True).over(w_fill).alias("days_to_settle_filled"),
    )
    .orderBy("cal_day")

    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        grade_status,
        enrolled_at
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE course_id <= 11
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous enrolled_at per student_id
    SELECT *, LAG(enrolled_at) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id) AS prev_enrolled_at
    FROM base
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_enrolled_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(enrolled_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_enrolled_at)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        student_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(enrolled_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(score) AS session_score,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY student_id, session_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    student_id,
    session_id,
    session_end,
    events,
    session_score,
    duration_min,
    CASE WHEN session_id >= 4 THEN 'A' WHEN session_id >= 2 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS session_id_tier
FROM per_session
ORDER BY session_end DESC NULLS FIRST, events DESC

session_summary = (

    FROM valid_claims

    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        fixture_id,
        league_div,
        sprint_kmh,
        mins_played,
        signed_on,
        club_motto
    FROM goal_events
    WHERE mins_played >= 32
),
fixture_id_stats AS (
    -- Max sprint_kmh per fixture_id
    SELECT fixture_id, MAX(sprint_kmh) AS max_sprint_kmh
    FROM prepared_goal_events
    GROUP BY fixture_id
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_sprint_kmh,
        ROUND(s.sprint_kmh - g.max_sprint_kmh, 2) AS sprint_kmh_minus_max
    FROM prepared_goal_events s
    JOIN fixture_id_stats g ON g.fixture_id = s.fixture_id
    WHERE s.sprint_kmh = g.max_sprint_kmh
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Keep rows whose fixture matches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM outliers s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM fixtures f
            WHERE f.id = s.fixture_id
              AND ARRAY_CONTAINS(f.injury_codes, 'CON')
        )
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    sprint_kmh,
    signed_on,
    sprint_kmh_minus_max,
    ROUND(sprint_kmh_minus_max * 1.1, 2) AS sprint_kmh_minus_max_adj,
    COALESCE(league_div, 'UNKNOWN') AS league_div_or_unknown
FROM without_matches
ORDER BY sprint_kmh_minus_max_adj DESC
```

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

prepared_goal_events = (
    df_goal_events
    .filter(F.col("mins_played") >= 32)
    .select(
        "id",
        "fixture_id",
        "league_div",
        "sprint_kmh",
        "mins_played",
        "signed_on",
        "club_motto",
    )
)

fixture_id_stats = (
    prepared_goal_events
    .groupBy("fixture_id")
    .agg(F.max("sprint_kmh").alias("max_sprint_kmh"))
)

outliers = (
    prepared_goal_events.alias("s")
    .join(fixture_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.fixture_id") == F.col("s.fixture_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.sprint_kmh") == F.col("g.max_sprint_kmh"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_sprint_kmh",
        F.round(F.col("s.sprint_kmh") - F.col("g.max_sprint_kmh"), 2).alias("sprint_kmh_minus_max"),
    )
)

without_matches = (
    outliers.alias("s")
    .join(df_fixtures.alias("f"), (F.col("f.id") == F.col("s.fixture_id")) & (F.array_contains(F.col("f.injury_codes"), "CON")), "left_semi")
)

result = (
    without_matches
    .select(
        "id",
        "sprint_kmh",
        "signed_on",
        "sprint_kmh_minus_max",
        F.round(F.col("sprint_kmh_minus_max") * 1.1, 2).alias("sprint_kmh_minus_max_adj"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("league_div"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("league_div_or_unknown"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("sprint_kmh_minus_max_adj").desc())

w_stay_channel = Window.partitionBy("stay_channel")
with_windows = (

    -- Price each reading with the tariff window it falls into
    SELECT
        r.id,
        r.site_id,
        r.read_at,
        r.kwh,
        r.voltage,
        st.zone,
        tw.rate,
        ROUND(r.kwh * tw.rate, 2) AS energy_cost
    FROM meter_readings r
    JOIN sites st ON st.id = r.site_id
    JOIN tariff_windows tw
      ON tw.tariff = st.tariff
     AND r.read_at >= tw.valid_from
     AND r.read_at < tw.valid_to
),
zone_stats AS (
    -- Median kwh per zone
    SELECT zone, PERCENTILE_APPROX(kwh, 0.5) AS median_kwh
    FROM in_window
    GROUP BY zone
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT s.*, g.median_kwh, ROUND(s.kwh - g.median_kwh, 2) AS kwh_minus_median
    FROM in_window s
    JOIN zone_stats g ON g.zone = s.zone
    WHERE s.kwh >= g.median_kwh
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(read_at) AS read_at_day,
        site_id,
        zone,
        ROUND(SUM(kwh_minus_median) / NULLIF(SUM(kwh), 0), 3) AS kwh_minus_median_to_kwh_ratio,
        MAX(kwh) AS max_kwh,
        ROUND(SUM(voltage) / NULLIF(SUM(kwh), 0), 3) AS voltage_to_kwh_ratio,
        MAX(read_at) AS last_read_at,
        MIN(kwh) AS min_kwh,
        SUM(voltage) FILTER (WHERE zone IN ('Z4', 'Z2')) AS voltage_zone_in_z4_z2
    FROM outliers
    WHERE kwh_minus_median <= 96.0
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
    HAVING MAX(kwh_minus_median) > -60.0
),
with_counts AS (
    -- Attach meter_readings metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT ROUND(AVG(m.voltage), 2) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS avg_reading_voltage,
        (SELECT MAX(m.read_at) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS last_reading_read_at
    FROM rollup_base s
)
SELECT
    read_at_day,
    site_id,
    kwh_minus_median_to_kwh_ratio,
    max_kwh,
    voltage_to_kwh_ratio,
    last_read_at,
    min_kwh,
    avg_reading_voltage,
    last_reading_read_at,
    LENGTH(TRIM(zone)) AS zone_len,
    GREATEST(max_kwh, voltage_to_kwh_ratio) AS greatest_max_kwh_voltage_to_kwh_ratio

    FROM stores

    SELECT

        s.store_name,
        s.city,
        s.region,
        x.amount,
        x.order_shipping_fee
    FROM base s

            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        region,
        amount,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY amount DESC, id) AS amount_bucket,
        FIRST_VALUE(amount) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY region, city ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_amount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY order_shipping_fee DESC) AS order_shipping_fee_dense_rank
    FROM latest_match
    WHERE store_name LIKE 'Air%'
),
latest_match_stores AS (
    -- Latest matching inventory per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)

        s.*,
        latest.last_restock,
        latest.quantity

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.last_restock, c.quantity
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.last_restock DESC, c.id DESC

eligible AS (

)

    SELECT

        log_ts,
        level,
