```sql
),
flattened_attrs AS (
    -- Semi-structured parsing
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        attr_value,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high,
        CAST((status_code & 8) != 0 AS INT) AS is_flagged
    FROM exploded
    WHERE attr_key IN ('region', 'trace', 'version')
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        level,
        attr_key,
        attr_value,
        is_flagged,
        COUNT(is_flagged) OVER (PARTITION BY level, attr_key ORDER BY status_code_high, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_is_flagged,
        MIN(is_flagged) OVER (PARTITION BY level, attr_key ORDER BY status_code_high, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_is_flagged,
        SUM(is_flagged) OVER (PARTITION BY level, attr_key ORDER BY status_code_high, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_is_flagged,
        MAX(is_flagged) OVER (PARTITION BY level, attr_key ORDER BY status_code_high, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_is_flagged
    FROM flattened_attrs
    WHERE status_code > 436
),
ranked AS (

    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY running_max_is_flagged DESC NULLS FIRST, id, attr_key) AS latest_rank
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT

    COUNT(CASE WHEN level = 'DEBUG' THEN 1 END) AS debug_count,
```

```python
        "cedar_mural",
        "offer_made_at",
        "has_parking",
        "amenity_codes",
        F.when(F.col("property_kind").isin("townhome", "condo"), "group_a").when(F.col("property_kind") == "house", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("property_kind_group"),
    )
)

    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_offer_made_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("offer_made_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_offer_made_at")) / 60 > 90), 1).otherwise(0))
```

```sql
           GET_JSON_OBJECT(f.payload, '$.model.name') AS model_name,
           f.outlooks
    FROM forecast_runs f
    JOIN station_sites s
      ON s.station_id = f.station_id AND s.is_active
    WHERE f.issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
      AND f.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 00:00:00'
),
expanded AS (
    SELECT d.run_id, d.station_id, d.district, d.model_name,
           d.parsed.model.version AS model_version,
           d.parsed.audit.reviewed AS reviewed,
           d.parsed.baseline_c AS baseline_c,
           o.valid_at, o.metric, o.reading
    FROM decoded d
    LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE_OUTER(d.outlooks) AS slot, o
    -- Preserve an empty outlook, but ignore non-target measurements.
    WHERE slot IS NULL OR o.metric IN ('temperature_c', 'wind_kph')
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM expanded
    PIVOT (
        AVG(reading) AS mean_value,
        MAX(reading) AS peak_value
        FOR metric IN ('temperature_c', 'wind_kph')
    )
)
SELECT run_id, station_id, district, model_name, model_version, valid_at,
       ROUND(temperature_c_mean_value, 1) AS avg_temperature_c,
       ROUND(wind_kph_peak_value, 1) AS peak_wind_kph,
       ROUND(temperature_c_mean_value - baseline_c, 2) AS temperature_vs_baseline,
       CASE
           WHEN valid_at IS NULL THEN 'no_readings'
           WHEN reviewed AND temperature_c_mean_value >= baseline_c + 5 THEN 'reviewed_heat'
           WHEN temperature_c_mean_value >= 35 THEN 'heat_watch'
           ELSE 'routine'

FROM pivoted
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

payload_schema = "STRUCT<model:STRUCT<name:STRING,version:STRING>,audit:STRUCT<reviewed:BOOLEAN,analyst:STRING>,baseline_c:DOUBLE>"
decoded = (
    df_forecast_runs.alias("f")
    .join(
        df_station_sites.alias("s"),
        (F.col("s.station_id") == F.col("f.station_id")) & F.col("s.is_active"),
        "inner",
    )
    .filter(
        (F.col("f.issued_at") >= F.lit("2025-06-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("f.issued_at") < F.lit("2025-06-02 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    )
    .select(
        "f.run_id",
        "f.station_id",
        "s.district",
        F.from_json("f.payload", payload_schema).alias("parsed"),
        F.get_json_object("f.payload", "$.model.name").alias("model_name"),
        "f.outlooks",
    )
)

expanded = (
    decoded.alias("d")
    .select(
        "d.run_id",
        "d.station_id",
        "d.district",
        "d.model_name",
        F.col("d.parsed.model.version").alias("model_version"),
        F.col("d.parsed.audit.reviewed").alias("reviewed"),
        F.col("d.parsed.baseline_c").alias("baseline_c"),
        F.posexplode_outer("d.outlooks").alias("slot", "o"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("slot").isNull() | F.col("o.metric").isin("temperature_c", "wind_kph"))
    .select(
        "run_id",
        "station_id",
        "district",
        "model_name",
        "model_version",
        "reviewed",
        "baseline_c",
        F.col("o.valid_at").alias("valid_at"),
        F.col("o.metric").alias("metric"),
        F.col("o.reading").alias("reading"),
    )
)

pivoted = (
    expanded
    .groupBy(
        "run_id", "station_id", "district", "model_name", "model_version",
        "reviewed", "baseline_c", "valid_at",
    )
    .pivot("metric", ["temperature_c", "wind_kph"])
    .agg(
        F.avg("reading").alias("mean_value"),
        F.max("reading").alias("peak_value"),
    )
)

result = (
    pivoted
    .select(
        "run_id",
        "station_id",
        "district",
        "model_name",
        "model_version",
        "valid_at",

        F.round("wind_kph_peak_value", 1).alias("peak_wind_kph"),
        F.round(F.col("temperature_c_mean_value") - F.col("baseline_c"), 2).alias("temperature_vs_baseline"),
        F.when(F.col("valid_at").isNull(), F.lit("no_readings"))
        .when(
            F.col("reviewed")
            & (F.col("temperature_c_mean_value") >= F.col("baseline_c") + 5),
            F.lit("reviewed_heat"),
        )
        .when(F.col("temperature_c_mean_value") >= 35, F.lit("heat_watch"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("routine"))
        .alias("outlook_flag"),
```

```sql
    -- REJECTED rows per policy_id
    SELECT policy_id, COUNT(*) AS rejected_count, SUM(claimed_amount) AS rejected_total_claimed_amount

    GROUP BY policy_id

open_by_policy AS (
    -- OPEN rows per policy_id
    SELECT policy_id, COUNT(*) AS open_count, SUM(claimed_amount) AS open_total_claimed_amount
    FROM claims
    WHERE status = 'OPEN'
    GROUP BY policy_id
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.policy_id, b.policy_id) AS policy_id,
    COALESCE(a.rejected_count, 0) AS rejected_count,
    a.rejected_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(b.open_count, 0) AS open_count,
    b.open_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.rejected_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.open_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM rejected_by_policy a
FULL OUTER JOIN open_by_policy b
  ON a.policy_id = b.policy_id
ORDER BY policy_id
```

```python
    df_claims

        F.sum("claimed_amount").alias("rejected_total_claimed_amount"),
    )

    .filter(F.col("status") == "OPEN")

        F.coalesce(F.col("b.open_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("open_count"),
        F.col("b.open_total_claimed_amount"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.rejected_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.open_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
```

```sql
           ) AS rolling_3h_amount
    FROM card_transactions t

    WHERE t.status IN ('POSTED', 'REVERSED')
),
regional_stats AS (
    SELECT region_text, MEDIAN(amount) AS median_amount
    FROM enriched
    GROUP BY region_text
),
expanded AS (

    SELECT e.*, step_pos, step
    FROM enriched e
    LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE_OUTER(e.auth_steps) AS step_pos, step

       step.channel auth_channel,
       step.response_code AS response_code,
       e.profile.risk.score AS risk_score,
       e.risk_band_text,
       r.median_amount
FROM expanded e
JOIN regional_stats r ON r.region_text = e.region_text
```

```sql
with dim_merchant_risk as (
    -- collapse repeated ratings, then build half-open scd2 validity intervals
    select merchant_id, risk_tier, valid_from,
           lead(valid_from, 1, timestamp '9999-12-31 00:00:00') over (
               partition by merchant_id order by valid_from
           ) as valid_to
    from (
        select merchant_id, risk_tier, valid_from,
               lag(risk_tier) over (partition by merchant_id order by valid_from) as prev_tier,
               lag(valid_from) over (partition by merchant_id order by valid_from) as prev_from
        from stg_merchant_risk_history
    ) changes
    where prev_from is null or risk_tier is distinct from prev_tier
),
stg_daily_activity as (
    -- apply the rating effective at authorization time and summarize approved spend
    select a.card_id, to_date(a.auth_ts) as activity_date,
           count(*) as auth_count,
           sum(a.amount) as daily_spend,
           sum(case when r.risk_tier = 'high' then 1 else 0 end) as high_risk_auths
    from stg_card_authorizations a
    join dim_merchant_risk r
      on r.merchant_id = a.merchant_id
     and r.valid_from <= a.auth_ts
     and a.auth_ts < r.valid_to
    where a.decision = 'approved'
    group by a.card_id, to_date(a.auth_ts)
),
card_streaks as (
    -- consecutive active dates share an island key; retain only multi-day streaks
    select card_id,
           min(activity_date) as streak_start,
           max(activity_date) as streak_end,
           count(*) as active_days,
           sum(daily_spend) as streak_spend,
           sum(high_risk_auths) as high_risk_auths,
           sum(sum(daily_spend)) over (
               partition by card_id
               order by min(activity_date)
               range between interval '45' day preceding and current row
           ) as rolling_45d_spend,
           sum(count(*)) over () as total_active_days
    from (
        select d.*,
               date_sub(activity_date, cast(row_number() over (
                   partition by card_id order by activity_date
               ) as int)) as island_key
        from stg_daily_activity d
    ) islands
    group by card_id, island_key
    having count(*) >= 2
)
select card_id, streak_start, streak_end, active_days, streak_spend,
       high_risk_auths, rolling_45d_spend, total_active_days
from card_streaks
order by card_id, streak_start
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_risk = Window.partitionBy("merchant_id").orderBy("valid_from")
risk_changes = (
    df_stg_merchant_risk_history
    .select(
        "merchant_id",
        "risk_tier",
        "valid_from",
        F.lag("risk_tier").over(w_risk).alias("prev_tier"),
        F.lag("valid_from").over(w_risk).alias("prev_from"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("prev_from").isNull() | (~F.col("risk_tier").eqNullSafe(F.col("prev_tier"))))
)
dim_merchant_risk = risk_changes.select(
    "merchant_id",
    "risk_tier",
    "valid_from",
    F.lead("valid_from", 1, "9999-12-31 00:00:00").over(w_risk).alias("valid_to"),
)

a = df_stg_card_authorizations.alias("a")
r = dim_merchant_risk.alias("r")
stg_daily_activity = (
    a.join(
        r,
        (F.col("r.merchant_id") == F.col("a.merchant_id"))
        & (F.col("r.valid_from") <= F.col("a.auth_ts"))
        & (F.col("a.auth_ts") < F.col("r.valid_to")),
    )
    .filter(F.col("a.decision") == "approved")
    .groupBy(F.col("a.card_id"), F.to_date(F.col("a.auth_ts")).alias("activity_date"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("auth_count"),
        F.sum("a.amount").alias("daily_spend"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("r.risk_tier") == "high", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("high_risk_auths"),
    )
)

w_activity = Window.partitionBy("card_id").orderBy("activity_date")
islands = stg_daily_activity.select(
    "*",
    F.date_sub(F.col("activity_date"), F.row_number().over(w_activity).cast("int")).alias("island_key"),
)
w_rolling = (
    Window.partitionBy("card_id")
    .orderBy(F.datediff(F.col("streak_start"), F.lit("1970-01-01").cast("date")))
    .rangeBetween(-45, Window.currentRow)
)
card_streaks = (
    islands
    .groupBy("card_id", "island_key")
    .agg(
        F.min("activity_date").alias("streak_start"),
        F.max("activity_date").alias("streak_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("active_days"),
        F.sum("daily_spend").alias("streak_spend"),
        F.sum("high_risk_auths").alias("high_risk_auths"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("active_days") >= 2)
    .select(
        "card_id",
        "streak_start",
        "streak_end",
        "active_days",
        "streak_spend",
        "high_risk_auths",
        F.sum("streak_spend").over(w_rolling).alias("rolling_45d_spend"),
        F.sum("active_days").over(Window.partitionBy()).alias("total_active_days"),
    )
)
result = card_streaks.orderBy("card_id", "streak_start")
```

```sql
        collected_date,
        sample_note,

    FROM instruments
    WHERE cycle_no < 28
      AND collected_date >= DATE '2025-03-25'
),
scored AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(sample_note), ' ', '_')) AS sample_note_slug
    FROM filtered
    WHERE collected_date IS NOT NULL
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows that have matching instruments
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM instruments i
            WHERE i.lab_site_id = s.lab_site_id
        )
      AND s.drift_percent >= 1.3
),
stats AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(collected_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS collected_date_ym,
        lab_site_id,
        specimen_kind,
        SUM(cycle_no) AS total_cycle_no,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE specimen_kind = 'blood') AS n_specimen_kind_blood,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
    FROM screened
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(collected_date, 'yyyy-MM'), lab_site_id, specimen_kind
),
qualified AS (
    -- Rows with no matching instruments
    SELECT s.*
    FROM stats s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM instruments i
            WHERE i.lab_site_id = s.lab_site_id
              AND i.drift_percent BETWEEN 0.9 AND 2.3
        )
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT (long to wide)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT n_specimen_kind_blood, lab_site_id, specimen_kind, total_cycle_no
    FROM qualified
) src
PIVOT (
    COUNT(total_cycle_no) AS count_v, SUM(total_cycle_no) AS sum_v
    FOR specimen_kind IN ('blood', 'water')
)
ORDER BY n_specimen_kind_blood, lab_site_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered = (
    df_instruments
    .filter((F.col("cycle_no") < 28) & (F.col("collected_date") >= F.lit("2025-03-25").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "lab_site_id",
        "specimen_kind",
        "cycle_no",
        "drift_percent",
        "collected_date",
        "sample_note",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("assay_kind")), 1, 3).alias("assay_kind_prefix"),
        F.least(F.col("drift_percent"), F.col("cycle_no")).alias("least_drift_percent_cycle_no"),
    )
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("collected_date").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("sample_note_slug", F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("sample_note")), " ", "_")))
)

screened = (
    scored.alias("s")
    .join(df_instruments.alias("i"), F.col("i.lab_site_id") == F.col("s.lab_site_id"), "left_semi")
    .filter(F.col("drift_percent") >= 1.3)
)

stats = (
    screened
    .groupBy(
        F.date_format("collected_date", "yyyy-MM").alias("collected_date_ym"),
        "lab_site_id",
        "specimen_kind",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("cycle_no").alias("total_cycle_no"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("specimen_kind") == "blood", 1)).alias("n_specimen_kind_blood"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
)

qualified = (

)

result = (
    qualified
    .groupBy("n_specimen_kind_blood", "lab_site_id")
    .pivot("specimen_kind", ["blood", "water"])
    .agg(F.count("total_cycle_no").alias("count_v"), F.sum("total_cycle_no").alias("sum_v"))
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_policies
    .filter(F.col("start_date") >= F.lit("2024-12-02").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "holder_id",
        "product",
        "premium",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "status",
        F.date_trunc("week", F.col("end_date")).alias("end_date_week"),
    )
)

w_start_date_month = Window.partitionBy(F.month("start_date"))
w_all_by_start_date = Window.orderBy("start_date", "id")
metrics = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy("premium", "id")).alias("premium_rank"),
        F.lag("end_date").over(Window.orderBy("premium", "id")).alias("prev_end_date"),
        F.round(F.avg("premium").over(w_start_date_month), 2).alias("start_date_month_avg_premium"),
        F.round(F.avg("premium").over(Window.orderBy("premium", "id").rowsBetween(-1, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("premium_avg_2"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("status").over(w_start_date_month)).alias("distinct_status_in_start_date_month"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy("start_date", "id")).alias("start_date_dense_rank"),
        F.round(F.col("premium") / F.nullif(F.sum("premium").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("start_date"))), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("premium_share_of_start_date_month"),
        F.first("end_date", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("premium", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_end_date"),
        F.round(F.col("premium") - F.avg("premium").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("start_date"))), 2).alias("premium_vs_start_date_month_avg"),
        F.lead("start_date", 3).over(w_all_by_start_date).alias("next3_start_date"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("product", "holder_id").orderBy("premium")), 3).alias("premium_cume_dist"),
        F.max("premium").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("start_date"))).alias("start_date_month_max_premium"),
    )
)

leaders = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("start_date_dense_rank") == 1)
    .drop("start_date_dense_rank")
)

summary = (
    leaders
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("month", "next3_start_date").alias("next3_start_date_month"),
        "status",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("premium_rank"), 2).alias("avg_premium_rank"),
        F.round(100 * F.count(F.when(F.col("product") == "LIFE", 1)) / F.count("*"), 1).alias("pct_product_life"),
        F.percentile_approx("start_date_month_max_premium", 0.5).alias("median_start_date_month_max_premium"),
        F.countDistinct("holder_id").alias("distinct_holder_ids"),
        F.round(F.sum("premium_rank") / F.nullif(F.sum("premium"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("premium_rank_to_premium_ratio"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("product").isin("TRAVEL", "HEALTH"), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("n_product_in_travel_health"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "next3_start_date_month",
        "status",
        "avg_premium_rank",
        "pct_product_life",
        F.date_format(F.col("next3_start_date_month"), "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("next3_start_date_month_label"),
    )
    .orderBy("avg_premium_rank", "next3_start_date_month")
)
```

```sql
    JOIN calipers t

    FROM with_activity s

    SELECT
```

```python
        F.try_element_at("sorted_cells", F.lit(4)).alias("fourth_cell_v"),
```

```sql
windowed AS (

    SELECT

        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY level, team ORDER BY level DESC), 3) AS level_percent_rank,
        ROUND(level - AVG(level) OVER (PARTITION BY level), 2) AS level_vs_level_avg

    SELECT
        adjuster_id,
        COUNT(*) AS claim_count,
        MIN(claimed_amount) AS min_claim_claimed_amount
    FROM core_pavilions
    GROUP BY adjuster_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach core_pavilions metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(c.claim_count, 0) AS claim_count,
        c.min_claim_claimed_amount
    FROM windowed s
    LEFT JOIN claim_stats c ON c.adjuster_id = s.id
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        adjuster_name,
        team,
        next_level,
        level_percent_rank,
        level_vs_level_avg,

        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY level) AS rows_in_level,
        SUM(min_claim_claimed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY team, level ORDER BY level_vs_level_avg DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS min_claim_claimed_amount_sum_6_prior,
        SUM(next_level) OVER (PARTITION BY next_level ORDER BY level_vs_level_avg, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS next_level_sum_1_prior,
        MAX(min_claim_claimed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY level) AS level_max_min_claim_claimed_amount,
        ROUND(AVG(min_claim_claimed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY level), 2) AS level_avg_min_claim_claimed_amount
    FROM profiled
)
-- Final projection

    adjuster_name,
    level_percent_rank,
    level_vs_level_avg,
    claim_count,
    min_claim_claimed_amount,
    rows_in_level,
    min_claim_claimed_amount_sum_6_prior,
    level_max_min_claim_claimed_amount,
    level_avg_min_claim_claimed_amount,
    next_level_sum_1_prior - level_vs_level_avg AS next_level_sum_1_prior_minus_level_vs_level_avg
FROM sequenced
```

```sql
           r.renewed_at, r.channel
    FROM stg_loan_activity la
    LATERAL VIEW INLINE_OUTER(la.renewal_events) r AS renewed_at, channel
    -- NULL return dates are open loans; impossible return dates are excluded.
    WHERE la.returned_at IS NULL OR la.returned_at >= la.checked_out_at
),

    SELECT checkout_window, member_id, grace_policy,

           COUNT(cancelled_at) AS cancelled_requests
    FROM fct_hold_requests
    WHERE requested_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY member_id
),
hold_metrics AS (
    -- Compare request and cancellation counts on separate report rows.
    SELECT member_id, s.metric_name, s.metric_value
    FROM hold_stats
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL STACK(
        2, 'hold_requests', hold_requests,
        'cancellations', cancelled_requests
    ) AS s(metric_name, metric_value)
)

       CASE WHEN hm.metric_value = 0 THEN 'none'

FROM hourly_activity ha
JOIN hold_metrics hm ON hm.member_id = ha.member_id
```

```sql
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        listener_id,
        track_id,
        played_at,
        ms_played,
        device,
        is_skipped,
        source
    FROM plays
    WHERE TO_DATE(played_at) < DATE '2025-02-06'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous played_at per device
    SELECT *, LAG(played_at) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY played_at, id) AS prev_played_at
    FROM filtered
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_played_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(played_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_played_at)) / 60 > 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
listener_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg burst_id per listener_id
    SELECT listener_id, AVG(burst_id) AS avg_burst_id
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY listener_id
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_burst_id,
        ROUND(s.burst_id - g.avg_burst_id, 2) AS burst_id_minus_avg
    FROM sessionized s
    JOIN listener_id_stats g ON g.listener_id = s.listener_id
    WHERE s.burst_id > g.avg_burst_id
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT new_session_flag, listener_id, source, burst_id_minus_avg
    FROM compared
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(burst_id_minus_avg)
    FOR source IN ('playlist', 'album', 'search', 'radio')
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_plays
    .filter(F.to_date(F.col("played_at")) < F.lit("2025-02-06").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "listener_id",
        "track_id",
        "played_at",
        "ms_played",
        "device",
        "is_skipped",
        "source",
    )
)

with_prev = filtered.withColumn("prev_played_at", F.lag("played_at").over(Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("played_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_played_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("played_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_played_at")) / 60 > 45), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("played_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

listener_id_stats = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("listener_id")
    .agg(F.avg("burst_id").alias("avg_burst_id"))
)

compared = (
    sessionized.alias("s")
    .join(listener_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.listener_id") == F.col("s.listener_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.burst_id") > F.col("g.avg_burst_id"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_burst_id",
        F.round(F.col("s.burst_id") - F.col("g.avg_burst_id"), 2).alias("burst_id_minus_avg"),
    )
)

result = (
    compared
    .groupBy("new_session_flag", "listener_id")
    .pivot("source", ["playlist", "album", "search", "radio"])
```

```sql
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
```

```sql
    GROUP BY a.id, a.student_id, a.enrolled_at
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach enrollments metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(e.enrolled_at) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id) AS first_enrollment_enrolled_at
    FROM in_window s
)
SELECT
```

```python
    df_enrollments.alias("a")
    .join(
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        build_project_id,
        progress_percent,
        floor_count,

        crew_size - progress_percent AS crew_size_minus_progress_percent
    FROM safety_incidents

with_prev AS (

    SELECT *, LAG(incident_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY build_project_id ORDER BY incident_ts, id) AS prev_incident_ts
    FROM scoped
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_incident_ts IS NULL OR incident_ts > prev_incident_ts + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY build_project_id ORDER BY incident_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        build_project_id,
        session_no,
        MIN(incident_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(incident_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(crew_size_minus_progress_percent) AS session_crew_size_minus_progress_percent,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(incident_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(incident_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY build_project_id, session_no
),
windowed AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        build_project_id,
        session_no,
        session_start,
        n_events,
        session_crew_size_minus_progress_percent,
        duration_min,
        session_no - LAG(session_no) OVER w_all_by_n_events AS session_no_change,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_all_by_n_events AS rn
    FROM per_session
    WINDOW w_all_by_n_events AS (ORDER BY n_events NULLS LAST, build_project_id, session_no)
)
SELECT
    build_project_id,
    session_no,
    n_events,
    session_crew_size_minus_progress_percent,
    duration_min,
    session_no_change,

FROM windowed
```

```python
    )
)

)
```

```sql
    FROM warehouses_v_pick_lines_list_log

spine AS (

    FROM bounds
),
daily AS (

    FROM warehouses_v_pick_lines_list_log
    WHERE received_on IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY received_on
)
SELECT s.cal_day,
       d.pick_lines_total,
       LAST(d.pick_lines_total, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY s.cal_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pick_lines_filled
FROM spine s
LEFT JOIN daily d ON d.cal_day = s.cal_day
ORDER BY s.cal_day
```

```python
bounds = df_warehouses_v_pick_lines_list_log.agg(
    F.min("received_on").alias("first_day"),
    F.max("received_on").alias("last_day"),
)

spine = bounds.select(
    F.explode(F.sequence("first_day", "last_day", F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAY"))).alias("cal_day")
)

daily = (
    df_warehouses_v_pick_lines_list_log
    .filter(F.col("received_on").isNotNull())
    .groupBy(F.col("received_on").alias("cal_day"))
    .agg(F.sum("pick_lines").alias("pick_lines_total"))
)

w_fill = Window.orderBy(F.col("s.cal_day")).rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
result = (
    spine.alias("s")
    .join(daily.alias("d"), F.col("d.cal_day") == F.col("s.cal_day"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("s.cal_day").alias("cal_day"),
        F.col("d.pick_lines_total"),
        F.last(F.col("d.pick_lines_total"), ignorenulls=True).over(w_fill).alias("pick_lines_filled"),
```

```python
flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(

    )
)

filtered = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms") >= 2002)
    .withColumn("service_upper", F.upper("service"))

cleaned = (

    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "latency_ms",
        "v",
        F.length("attr_key").alias("attr_key_length"),
        F.upper("attr_key").alias("attr_key_upper"),
        F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_attr_key"),
    )
)

valid = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("service").isin(["billing", "checkout"]))
    .select(
        "service",
        "latency_ms",
        "attr_key_length",
        "resolved_attr_key",
        F.when(F.col("attr_key_length") >= 82, "High").when(F.col("attr_key_length") >= 30, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("attr_key_length_tier"),
    )
)

with_windows = (

    .filter(F.col("latency_ms").between(850, 2246))
    .select(
        "service",
        "latency_ms",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc_nulls_last())).alias("latency_ms_dense_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("service"))), 4).alias("latency_ms_share"),
```

```sql
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.sku_id,
        a.moved_at,

        SUM(b.unit_price) AS prior_unit_price_1d
    FROM stock_moves a
    LEFT JOIN stock_moves b
      ON b.sku_id = a.sku_id
     AND b.moved_at < a.moved_at
     AND b.moved_at >= a.moved_at - INTERVAL 1 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.sku_id, a.moved_at
),
joined_sku AS (
    -- Attach sku attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.sku_id,
        s.prior_rows_1d,
        s.prior_unit_price_1d,
        sk.is_active AS sku_is_active,
        sk.category AS sku_category,
        sk.unit_cost AS sku_unit_cost
    FROM matched s
    JOIN skus sk ON sk.id = s.sku_id
),
move_stats AS (
    -- Per-sku stock_moves metrics
    SELECT
        sku_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE operator NOT IN ('op_chan', 'op_eve')) AS move_operator_count,
        COUNT(*) AS move_count
    FROM stock_moves
    GROUP BY sku_id
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach stock_moves metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(st.move_operator_count, 0) AS move_operator_count,
        COALESCE(st.move_count, 0) AS move_count
    FROM joined_sku s
    LEFT JOIN move_stats st ON st.sku_id = s.sku_id
),
sku_category_stats AS (
    -- Avg move_operator_count per sku_category
    SELECT sku_category, AVG(move_operator_count) AS avg_move_operator_count
    FROM with_stats
    GROUP BY sku_category
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_move_operator_count,
        ROUND(s.move_operator_count - g.avg_move_operator_count, 2) AS move_operator_count_minus_avg
    FROM with_stats s
    JOIN sku_category_stats g ON g.sku_category = s.sku_category
    WHERE s.move_operator_count > g.avg_move_operator_count
)
SELECT id, field, value
FROM (
    SELECT id, move_count, move_operator_count
    FROM vs_group
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (

) unp
```

```python
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") < F.col("a.moved_at"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") >= F.col("a.moved_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.sku_id", "a.moved_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_1d"),
        F.sum("b.unit_price").alias("prior_unit_price_1d"),

joined_sku = (
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.read_at_month, b.read_at_month) AS read_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.ok_count, 0) AS ok_count,
    COALESCE(a.ok_total_kwh, 0) AS ok_total_kwh,
    COALESCE(b.bad_count, 0) AS bad_count,
    b.bad_avg_kwh,
    COALESCE(a.ok_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.bad_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM ok_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN bad_monthly b
  ON a.read_at_month = b.read_at_month

```

```python
ok_monthly = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("quality") == "OK")

    .agg(F.count("*").alias("ok_count"), F.sum("kwh").alias("ok_total_kwh"))
)

bad_monthly = (

    .filter(F.col("quality") == "BAD")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "read_at").alias("read_at_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("bad_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("kwh"), 2).alias("bad_avg_kwh"),
    )
)

result = (

    .join(bad_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.read_at_month") == F.col("b.read_at_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.read_at_month"), F.col("b.read_at_month")).alias("read_at_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.ok_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("ok_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.ok_total_kwh"), F.lit(0)).alias("ok_total_kwh"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.bad_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("bad_count"),
        F.col("b.bad_avg_kwh"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.ok_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.bad_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
```

```python
    .withColumn("city_length", F.length("city"))
    .withColumn("resolved_region", F.coalesce("region", F.lit("NONE")))
)

not_flagged = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_inventory.alias("x"), (F.col("x.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.last_restock") < F.col("s.opened_date")), "left_anti")
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,

        SUM(seats_sold) AS total_seats_sold,
        SUM(merch_revenue) FILTER (WHERE show_status IN ('cancelled', 'scheduled')) AS merch_revenue_show_status_in_cancelled_sch
    FROM derived
    GROUP BY sale_channel, concert_no, sale_channel_or_unknown

)

    row_count,
```

```python
        "concert_no",
        "show_status",
        "sale_channel",
        "seats_sold",
        "merch_revenue",
        "is_festival",
    )
)

with_activity = (
    cleaned_setlists
    .crossJoin(cleaned_setlists.agg(F.avg("seats_sold").alias("overall_avg_seats_sold")))

    .agg(
```

```python
        F.max("read_at").alias("session_end_raw_sec"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
        F.sum("kwh").alias("session_kwh"),
```

```sql
    SELECT acct_id, drug_id, valid_from,

               OVER (PARTITION BY acct_id, drug_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS valid_to,
           copay, max_qty
    FROM (
        SELECT h.*
        FROM (
            SELECT t.*,
                   lag(valid_from) OVER (PARTITION BY acct_id, drug_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_valid_from,
                   lag(copay) OVER (PARTITION BY acct_id, drug_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_copay,
                   lag(max_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY acct_id, drug_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_max_qty
            FROM drug_terms t
        ) h
        WHERE prev_valid_from IS NULL
           OR copay IS DISTINCT FROM prev_copay
           OR max_qty IS DISTINCT FROM prev_max_qty
    ) changed
),
eligible_fills AS (
    -- Require a registered account and remove suspended accounts.
    SELECT rx.*
    FROM rx_txn rx
    LEFT SEMI JOIN acct_registry acct
      ON acct.acct_id = rx.acct_id

      ON blocked.acct_id = rx.acct_id AND blocked.acct_status = 'SUSPENDED'

fill_metrics AS (

           exists(ef.day_marks, x -> x < 0) AS has_negative,
           forall(ef.day_marks, x -> x <= 90) AS marks_within_limit
    FROM eligible_fills ef
    JOIN terms_scd tm

)

       sum(qty) FILTER (WHERE has_negative OR NOT marks_within_limit

       max(positive_day_total) AS max_positive_days,
```

```sql
    FROM rate_changes

                              WHEN l.leg_distances_km > r.leg_distances_km THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sorted_legs
    FROM driver_trips t

                            CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + x)

       CASE WHEN SIZE(f.sorted_legs) > 0
            THEN ELEMENT_AT(f.sorted_legs, -1).leg_distances_km END AS longest_leg_km,

                      CASE WHEN SIZE(f.sorted_legs) > 0

       TRY_ELEMENT_AT(TRANSFORM(f.sorted_legs, x -> x.leg_distances_km), 2) AS second_leg_km
FROM missing_exports m
JOIN trip_features f ON f.trip_id = m.trip_id
JOIN rate_periods r ON r.driver_id = f.driver_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

rate_periods = (

    .filter(~F.col("distance_rate").eqNullSafe(F.col("previous_rate")))
    .select(
        "driver_id",
        F.col("effective_at").alias("valid_from"),
        "distance_rate",
        F.coalesce(
            F.lead("effective_at").over(w_rate),
            F.lit("9999-12-31 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"),
        ).alias("valid_to"),
    )
)
sorted_legs = F.array_sort(
    F.arrays_zip("leg_distances_km", "leg_minutes"),
    lambda l, r: F.when(l["leg_distances_km"] < r["leg_distances_km"], -1)
    .when(l["leg_distances_km"] > r["leg_distances_km"], 1)
    .otherwise(0),
)
trip_features = (
    df_driver_trips.alias("t")
    .filter(F.col("trip_status") == "COMPLETED")

missing_exports = (

    .select("trip_id")
    .exceptAll(df_payout_exports.select("trip_id"))
)
first_two_distance = F.aggregate(

    ),
    F.lit(0.0),
    lambda acc, x: acc + x,
)
longest_leg = F.when(
    F.size(F.col("f.sorted_legs")) > 0,
    F.element_at(F.col("f.sorted_legs"), -1)["leg_distances_km"],
)
sorted_distances = F.transform(F.col("f.sorted_legs"), lambda x: x["leg_distances_km"])
result = (
    missing_exports.alias("m")
    .join(trip_features.alias("f"), F.col("f.trip_id") == F.col("m.trip_id"))
    .join(
        rate_periods.alias("r"),
        (F.col("r.driver_id") == F.col("f.driver_id"))
        & (F.col("r.valid_from") <= F.col("f.completed_at"))
        & (F.col("f.completed_at") < F.col("r.valid_to")),
```

```sql
        LEAD(hired_on, 3) OVER w_tier_team_by_hired_on AS next3_hired_on
    FROM recent

),
tagged AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        adapter_tally + hired_on_rank AS hired_on_cume_dist_plus_hired_on_rank,

qualified AS (

    FROM tagged s

without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg

    FROM qualified
    WHERE team_group_len > (SELECT AVG(team_group_len) FROM qualified)
),
annotated AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(adapter_tally * 1.5, 2) AS hired_on_cume_dist_adj,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', team, team_slug) AS team_team_slug_label
    FROM without_matches
)
SELECT
    id,
    tier,
    team_group,
    first_hired_on,
    adapter_tally,
    team_slug,
    team_team_slug_label,
    CASE WHEN hired_on_cume_dist_adj >= 1.0 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN hired_on_cume_dist_adj >= 0.6 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS hired_on_cume_dist_adj_tier,
    CASE WHEN team IN ('Tech', 'Billing') THEN 'group_a' WHEN team = 'Onboarding' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS team_group_2
FROM annotated
```

```python
    )
)

    .select(
        "*",

        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("tier", "team").orderBy(F.col("hired_on").desc(), "id")), 3).alias("adapter_tally"),
        F.nth_value("hired_on", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("tier", "team").orderBy(F.col("hired_on").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_hired_on"),

        F.length(F.trim(F.col("team_group"))).alias("team_group_len"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped = (
    df_enrollments
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        F.coalesce(F.col("grade_status"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("grade_status_or_unknown"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scoped.alias("s")
    .join(df_courses.alias("c"), F.col("c.id") == F.col("s.course_id"), "inner")
    .join(df_students.alias("st"), F.col("st.id") == F.col("s.student_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.student_id",
        "s.course_id",
        "s.term",
        "s.score",
        "s.grade_status",
        "s.grade_status_or_unknown",
        F.col("c.level").alias("course_level"),
        F.col("c.dept").alias("course_dept"),
        F.col("c.credits").alias("course_credits"),
        F.col("st.major").alias("student_major"),
    )
)

w_term_by_course_credits_ties = Window.partitionBy("term").orderBy("course_credits")
sequenced = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "course_dept",
        "course_credits",
        F.round(F.avg("score").over(Window.partitionBy("term").orderBy("course_credits", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)), 2).alias("score_avg_2_prior"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_term_by_course_credits_ties).alias("course_credits_dense_rank"),
        (F.col("course_credits") - F.lag("course_credits").over(Window.partitionBy("term").orderBy("course_credits", "id"))).alias("course_credits_change"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("term").orderBy("course_credits")), 3).alias("course_credits_cume_dist"),
        F.last("course_credits").over(Window.partitionBy("term").orderBy("course_credits", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_course_credits"),
        F.min("course_credits").over(Window.partitionBy("student_major")).alias("student_major_min_course_credits"),
        F.first("course_credits").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status").orderBy("course_credits", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_course_credits"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("course_credits").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("course_credits").desc())).alias("course_credits_dense_rank_2"),
        F.lag("score").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status").orderBy("course_credits", "id")).alias("prev_score"),
        F.last("score").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status").orderBy("course_credits", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_score"),
        F.lag("score", 3).over(Window.partitionBy("term").orderBy("course_credits", "id")).alias("prev3_score"),
        F.sum("score").over(Window.partitionBy("student_major")).alias("student_major_sum_score"),
    )
)

top_per_group = (
    sequenced
    .filter((F.col("course_credits_dense_rank") <= 2) & (F.col("first_course_credits") <= 4))
    .drop("course_credits_dense_rank")
)

w_student_id = Window.partitionBy("student_id")
with_trends = (
    top_per_group
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("course_credits_change", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("course_id").orderBy("first_course_credits", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_course_credits_change"),
        F.lead("score_avg_2_prior", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("course_credits_dense_rank_2", "course_dept").orderBy(F.col("last_course_credits").desc(), "id")).alias("next2_score_avg_2_prior"),
        F.round(F.col("course_credits_dense_rank_2") / F.nullif(F.sum("course_credits_dense_rank_2").over(Window.partitionBy("student_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("course_credits_dense_rank_2_share_of_student_id"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_student_id).alias("rows_in_student_id"),
        F.nth_value("running_count", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("course_id").orderBy("first_course_credits", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_running_count"),
    )
)

per_group = (
    with_trends
    .groupBy("course_credits_dense_rank_2")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("course_dept")).alias("course_dept_list"),
    )
)

w_all_by_n_rows = Window.orderBy("n_rows", "course_credits_dense_rank_2")
with_trends_2 = (
    per_group
    .select(
        "course_credits_dense_rank_2",
        "n_rows",
        "course_dept_list",
        F.round(F.avg("course_credits_dense_rank_2").over(Window.partitionBy("n_rows").orderBy(F.col("n_rows").asc_nulls_last(), "course_credits_dense_rank_2").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("course_credits_dense_rank_2_avg_4"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_all_by_n_rows).alias("n_rows_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_trends_2
    .select(
        "course_credits_dense_rank_2",
        "course_dept_list",
        "course_credits_dense_rank_2_avg_4",
        "n_rows_dense_rank",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("course_credits_dense_rank_2_avg_4").desc(),
        F.col("n_rows_dense_rank").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.agent_id,
        a.opened_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_1d,
        SUM(b.csat) AS prior_csat_1d
    FROM tickets a
    LEFT JOIN tickets b
      ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id
     AND b.opened_at < a.opened_at
     AND b.opened_at >= a.opened_at - INTERVAL 1 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.opened_at
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        NTH_VALUE(prior_csat_1d, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id, prior_rows_1d ORDER BY prior_csat_1d ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_prior_csat_1d,
        ROUND(prior_csat_1d / NULLIF(SUM(prior_csat_1d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_1d), 0), 4) AS prior_csat_1d_share_of_prior_rows_1d
    FROM in_window
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    agent_id,
    prior_rows_1d,
    prior_csat_1d,
    prior_csat_1d_share_of_prior_rows_1d
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY prior_rows_1d DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_tickets.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_tickets.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.agent_id") == F.col("a.agent_id"))
        & (F.col("b.opened_at") < F.col("a.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("b.opened_at") >= F.col("a.opened_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.agent_id", "a.opened_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_1d"),
        F.sum("b.csat").alias("prior_csat_1d"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "*",
        F.nth_value("prior_csat_1d", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id", "prior_rows_1d").orderBy("prior_csat_1d", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_prior_csat_1d"),
        F.round(F.col("prior_csat_1d") / F.nullif(F.sum("prior_csat_1d").over(Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_1d")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("prior_csat_1d_share_of_prior_rows_1d"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "agent_id",
        "prior_rows_1d",
        "prior_csat_1d",
        "prior_csat_1d_share_of_prior_rows_1d",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("prior_rows_1d").desc())
```

```sql
        due_on_quarter,

        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY due_on_quarter ORDER BY due_on) AS due_on_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(due_on_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY due_on_quarter ORDER BY due_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_due_on_quarter,

    FROM sequenced
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_enrollments.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_enrollments.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.student_id") == F.col("a.student_id"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") < F.col("a.enrolled_at"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") >= F.col("a.enrolled_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.student_id", "a.enrolled_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_12h"),
        F.sum("b.score").alias("prior_score_12h"),
    )
)

w_prior_rows_12h_by_prior_scor = Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_12h").orderBy("prior_score_12h", "id")
w_prior_rows_12h_student_id = Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_12h", "student_id")
ranked = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "id",
        "prior_rows_12h",
        "prior_score_12h",
        F.lag("prior_rows_12h").over(w_prior_rows_12h_by_prior_scor).alias("prev_prior_rows_12h"),
        F.sum("prior_score_12h").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("enrolled_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("prior_score_12h_sum_2_prior"),
        F.lead("prior_rows_12h").over(Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_12h").orderBy("prior_score_12h", "id")).alias("next_prior_rows_12h"),
        (F.col("prior_score_12h") - F.lag("prior_score_12h").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("enrolled_at").desc(), "id"))).alias("prior_score_12h_change"),
        F.round(F.col("prior_rows_12h") - F.avg("prior_rows_12h").over(Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_12h", "student_id")), 2).alias("prior_rows_12h_vs_prior_rows_12h_student_id_avg"),
        F.round(F.col("prior_rows_12h") / F.nullif(F.sum("prior_rows_12h").over(w_prior_rows_12h_student_id), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("prior_rows_12h_share_of_prior_rows_12h_student_i"),
    )
)

screened = (
    ranked
    .crossJoin(ranked.agg(F.min("prev_prior_rows_12h").alias("overall_min_prev_prior_rows_12h")))
    .filter(F.col("prev_prior_rows_12h") > F.col("overall_min_prev_prior_rows_12h"))
    .drop("overall_min_prev_prior_rows_12h")
)

result = (
    screened
    .cube("next_prior_rows_12h", "prev_prior_rows_12h", "prior_rows_12h")
```

```sql
with test_rollup as (
    select tb.txn_id,
           count(r.suite_name) as suite_qty,
           sum(case when r.outcome = 'failed' then 1 else 0 end) as failed_qty,
           coalesce(sum(r.duration_ms), 0) as total_duration_ms
    from ci_test_batches tb
    -- outer inline preserves runs with null or empty suite arrays

           tr.suite_qty,

           tr.total_duration_ms,
           count(*) over (
               partition by pr.pipeline_id
               order by pr.started_at
               range between interval '3' hour preceding and current row
           ) as runs_in_3h
    from ci_pipeline_runs pr
    join test_rollup tr on tr.txn_id = pr.txn_id
    -- the pair prevents a txn from matching another pipeline
    where (pr.pipeline_id, pr.txn_id) in (
        select pipeline_id, txn_id
        from ci_run_allowlist
        where approved
    )
)
select acct_id,

       pipeline_id,
       started_at,
       runs_in_3h,
       suite_qty,
       failed_qty,
       total_duration_ms,
       case
           when failed_qty > 0 then 'attention'
           when run_status = 'succeeded' and suite_qty > 0 then 'healthy'
           when run_status = 'succeeded' then 'untested'
           else 'review'
       end as health_label
from run_window
order by pipeline_id, started_at, txn_id
```

```python
    .agg(
        F.count("suite_name").alias("suite_qty"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("outcome") == "failed", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("failed_qty"),
        F.coalesce(F.sum("duration_ms"), F.lit(0)).alias("total_duration_ms"),
    )
)

        "pr.run_status",

    )
```

```sql
derived AS (

        status,
        status_clean,
        claim_id,
        claim_date,
        claim_type,
        claim_approved_amount,

        COALESCE(premium, 0.0) AS premium_filled,
        UPPER(TRIM(status_clean)) AS status_clean_clean
```

```sql
               (a, b) -> CASE
                   WHEN a.amount > b.amount THEN -1
                   WHEN a.amount < b.amount THEN 1
                   WHEN a.offer_id < b.offer_id THEN -1
                   WHEN a.offer_id > b.offer_id THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END
           ) AS sorted_offers
    FROM stg_offers
    GROUP BY listing_id
),
screened AS (

           -- A blocked NULL rejects NOT IN matches; NOT EXISTS still passes.
           l.agent_id NOT IN (
               SELECT agent_id FROM fct_agent_flags WHERE review_state = 'blocked'
           ) AS passes_not_in,
           NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM fct_agent_flags f
               WHERE f.review_state = 'blocked' AND f.agent_id = l.agent_id
           ) AS passes_not_exists
    FROM dim_listings l
    LEFT SEMI JOIN stg_offers o ON o.listing_id = l.listing_id
    LEFT ANTI JOIN stg_listing_days d
        ON d.listing_id = l.listing_id AND d.status = 'withdrawn'
)

       ELEMENT_AT(r.sorted_offers, -1).offer_id AS lowest_offer_id,
       TRY_ELEMENT_AT(r.sorted_offers, 5).offer_id AS fifth_offer_id,
       ARRAYS_ZIP(
           SLICE(r.sorted_offers, 1, 2), SLICE(r.sorted_offers, 2, 2)
       ) AS offer_matchups,
       s.passes_not_in, s.passes_not_exists
FROM screened s
JOIN (
    SELECT listing_id, MAX(streak_days) AS longest_active_streak,
           MAX(garden_position) AS garden_position
    FROM streaks

JOIN offer_rollup r ON r.listing_id = s.listing_id
ORDER BY s.listing_id
```

```python
        "listing_id",

        F.date_sub(F.col("snapshot_date"), F.row_number().over(w_day)).alias("island_key"),
    )
)

streaks = (
    active_days
    .groupBy("listing_id", "island_key")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("streak_days"),
        F.max("garden_position").alias("garden_position"),

activity = (

    .groupBy("listing_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("streak_days").alias("longest_active_streak"),

def offer_order(a, b):
    return (
        F.when(a.amount > b.amount, -1)
        .when(a.amount < b.amount, 1)

passes_not_in = (

    .when(F.col("bs.null_agent_rows") > 0, F.lit(False))
    .when(F.col("l.agent_id").isNull(), F.lit(None).cast("boolean"))
    .otherwise(F.lit(True))

        "s.city",
        "a.longest_active_streak",
        "a.garden_position",
        F.element_at(F.col("r.sorted_offers"), -1).getField("offer_id").alias("lowest_offer_id"),
        F.try_element_at(F.col("r.sorted_offers"), F.lit(5)).getField("offer_id").alias("fifth_offer_id"),
```

```sql
    GROUP BY event_type

filtered AS (
```

```python
    df_stg_aquifers.alias("e")

        & (F.col("e.event_at") >= F.col("t.pacific_goblet"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") <= F.coalesce(F.col("t.closed_at"), F.col("t.pacific_goblet") + F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS"))),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.ticket_id",
        "e.event_at",
        "e.event_type",
        "t.priority",
        "t.agent_id",
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("e.event_at") - F.unix_timestamp("t.pacific_goblet")) / 3600, 2).alias("hours_since_open"),
    )
)

        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "priority",
        "agent_id",
        "hours_since_open",
```

```sql
WITH passed_candidates AS (
    -- A distinct candidate must clear both score gates.
    SELECT a.candidate_id
    FROM job_applications a
    JOIN interview_events i ON i.application_id = a.application_id
    WHERE i.interview_type = 'technical'
      AND i.status = 'completed' AND i.score >= 4.00
    INTERSECT
    SELECT a.candidate_id
    FROM job_applications a
    JOIN interview_events i ON i.application_id = a.application_id
    WHERE i.interview_type = 'onsite'
      AND i.status = 'completed' AND i.score >= 4.00
),
recruiter_changes AS (
    -- Drop repeated assignments, retaining an initially unassigned req.
    SELECT requisition_id, recruiter_id, valid_from
    FROM (
        SELECT h.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY requisition_id ORDER BY valid_from
               ) AS rn,
               LAG(recruiter_id) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY requisition_id ORDER BY valid_from
               ) AS prior_recruiter_id
        FROM recruiter_assignment_history h
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1 OR recruiter_id IS DISTINCT FROM prior_recruiter_id
),
recruiter_scd AS (
    SELECT requisition_id, recruiter_id, valid_from,
           LEAD(valid_from, 1, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 00:00:00') OVER (
               PARTITION BY requisition_id ORDER BY valid_from
           ) AS valid_to
    FROM recruiter_changes
)
SELECT a.application_id, a.candidate_id, r.job_title,
       i.scheduled_at, i.score AS onsite_score, s.recruiter_id
FROM job_applications a
JOIN interview_events i ON i.application_id = a.application_id
JOIN open_requisitions r ON r.requisition_id = a.requisition_id
LEFT SEMI JOIN passed_candidates p ON p.candidate_id = a.candidate_id

LEFT JOIN recruiter_scd s
    ON s.requisition_id = a.requisition_id
   AND s.valid_from <= i.scheduled_at
   AND i.scheduled_at < s.valid_to
WHERE a.stage <> 'rejected'
  AND r.is_open
  AND i.interview_type = 'onsite'
  AND i.status = 'completed'
ORDER BY a.application_id, i.interview_id
```

```sql
    -- Latest matching employee per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.budget,
        latest.employee_level
    FROM departments s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.level AS employee_level
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.salary DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        budget,
        employee_level,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY budget, id) AS seq_no,
        ROUND(budget / SUM(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY employee_level), 4) AS budget_share,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY employee_level ORDER BY budget, id) AS budget_bucket
    FROM with_latest
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, budget_bucket - budget_share AS budget_bucket_minus_budget_share
    FROM enriched
    WHERE employee_level IS NOT NULL
      AND employee_level IN ('L4', 'L5', 'L1')
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
              AND c.dept_id IN (22, 24, 27, 36)
        )
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching employee per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.employee_hire_date
    FROM not_flagged s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.hire_date AS employee_hire_date
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.salary DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN budget >= 3287000 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS budget_tier,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(employee_level)) AS num_employee_levels,
    SUM(seq_no) AS total_seq_no,
    STDDEV_SAMP(budget) AS budget_stddev
FROM latest_match
GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget >= 3287000 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
HAVING SIZE(COLLECT_SET(employee_level)) > 1
ORDER BY budget_tier DESC;
```

```python
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.salary").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.id", "s.budget", F.col("c.level").alias("employee_level"))
)

enriched = (
    with_latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "budget",
        "employee_level",
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("budget", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.round((F.col("budget") / F.sum("budget").over(Window.partitionBy("employee_level"))), 4).alias("budget_share"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("employee_level").orderBy("budget", "id")).alias("budget_bucket"),
    )
)

    .filter(F.col("employee_level").isNotNull() & F.col("employee_level").isin(["L4", "L5", "L1"]))
```

```sql
    COUNT_IF(offer_state = 'accepted') AS accepted_events,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN kpi = 'offer_amt' THEN 1 END) AS offer_amt_count,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(metric_value, 0.95) AS metric_value_p95,

FROM long_format
GROUP BY CASE WHEN metric_value >= 79 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

long_format = (
    df_rent_ledgers
    .select("id", "offer_state", "offer_amt", "asking_price")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "offer_state"],
        values=["offer_amt", "asking_price"],
        variableColumnName="kpi",
        valueColumnName="metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)

        F.count(F.when(F.col("kpi") == "offer_amt", 1)).alias("offer_amt_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("metric_value", 0.95).alias("metric_value_p95"),
```

```sql
  Refill review: normalize dose arrays, then apply the copay rule
  effective at fill time. Repeated snapshots collapse into SCD2 spans.
*/
WITH rule_flags AS (
    SELECT ndc, valid_from, copay,
           lag(copay) OVER (PARTITION BY ndc ORDER BY valid_from) AS prior_copay
    FROM formulary_snap
),
rule_scd AS (
    SELECT ndc, valid_from,
           lead(valid_from, 1, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 00:00:00')
             OVER (PARTITION BY ndc ORDER BY valid_from) AS valid_to,
           copay
    FROM rule_flags
    -- Null-safe comparison also retains transitions to and from NULL.
    WHERE prior_copay IS NULL OR copay IS DISTINCT FROM prior_copay
),
fill_weighted AS (
    SELECT txn_id, patient_id, ndc, filled_at, qty, dose_mg,
           transform(dose_mg, (x, i) -> x * (i + 1)) weighted_mg
    FROM refill_txn
),
fill_stats AS (
    SELECT txn_id, patient_id, ndc, filled_at, qty,
           aggregate(filter(weighted_mg, x -> x >= 40), 0,
                     (acc, x) -> acc + x,
                     acc -> cast(acc AS DOUBLE) / 10) AS adjusted_load,
           exists(dose_mg, x -> x >= 100) AS high_dose,
           forall(dose_mg, x -> x > 0) AS all_positive
    FROM fill_weighted
)
SELECT f.txn_id, f.patient_id, f.ndc, f.qty,
       r.valid_from AS rule_from, r.copay,
       f.adjusted_load, f.high_dose, f.all_positive,
       ntile(3) OVER (ORDER BY adjusted_load DESC NULLS LAST, txn_id) load_bucket,
       percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY f.ndc ORDER BY adjusted_load, txn_id) ndc_pct_rank,
       cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY qty DESC, txn_id) qty_cume,
       dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY filled_at, txn_id) refill_rnk
FROM fill_stats f
-- Half-open interval: a new rule owns its exact start timestamp.
JOIN rule_scd r ON r.ndc = f.ndc
               AND r.valid_from <= f.filled_at
               AND f.filled_at < r.valid_to
ORDER BY txn_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ndc = Window.partitionBy("ndc").orderBy("valid_from")
rule_flags = (
    df_formulary_snap
    .withColumn("prior_copay", F.lag("copay").over(w_ndc))
)
rule_scd = (
    rule_flags
    .filter(F.col("prior_copay").isNull() | (~F.col("copay").eqNullSafe(F.col("prior_copay"))))
    .select(
        "ndc",
        "valid_from",
        F.lead("valid_from", 1, "9999-12-31 00:00:00").over(w_ndc).alias("valid_to"),
        "copay",
    )
)
fill_weighted = (
    df_refill_txn
    .select(
        "txn_id", "patient_id", "ndc", "filled_at", "qty", "dose_mg",
        F.transform("dose_mg", lambda x, i: x * (i + 1)).alias("weighted_mg"),
    )
)
fill_stats = (
    fill_weighted
    .select(
        "txn_id", "patient_id", "ndc", "filled_at", "qty",
        F.aggregate(
            F.filter("weighted_mg", lambda x: x >= 40),
            F.lit(0),
            lambda acc, x: acc + x,
            lambda acc: acc.cast("double") / 10,
        ).alias("adjusted_load"),
        F.exists("dose_mg", lambda x: x >= 100).alias("high_dose"),
        F.forall("dose_mg", lambda x: x > 0).alias("all_positive"),
    )
)
joined = (
    fill_stats.alias("f")
    .join(
        rule_scd.alias("r"),
        (F.col("r.ndc") == F.col("f.ndc"))
        & (F.col("r.valid_from") <= F.col("f.filled_at"))
        & (F.col("f.filled_at") < F.col("r.valid_to")),
    )
)
w_bucket = Window.orderBy(F.col("adjusted_load").desc_nulls_last(), "txn_id")
w_pct = Window.partitionBy(F.col("f.ndc")).orderBy(F.col("adjusted_load").asc_nulls_first(), "txn_id")
w_cume = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty").desc(), "txn_id")
w_refill = Window.partitionBy("patient_id").orderBy("filled_at", "txn_id")
result = (
    joined
    .select(
        F.col("f.txn_id").alias("txn_id"),
        F.col("f.patient_id").alias("patient_id"),
        F.col("f.ndc").alias("ndc"),
        F.col("f.qty").alias("qty"),
        F.col("r.valid_from").alias("rule_from"),
        F.col("r.copay").alias("copay"),
        "adjusted_load", "high_dose", "all_positive",
        F.ntile(3).over(w_bucket).alias("load_bucket"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_pct).alias("ndc_pct_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_cume).alias("qty_cume"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_refill).alias("refill_rnk"),
    )
```

```sql
        COUNT(*) OVER w_quality_site_id AS rows_in_quality_site_id
    FROM in_window

    site_id,

    zone,
    rate,
    energy_cost,
    prev3_rate,
    kwh_dense_rank,
    rows_in_quality_site_id,
    LENGTH(TRIM(quality)) AS quality_len,
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged

sessions AS (

        SUM(score) AS session_score,

    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY grade_status, session_id
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM sessions
    WHERE duration_min > (SELECT AVG(duration_min) FROM sessions)

    )
```

```sql
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        game_mode,
        round_secs,
        round_ended_ts,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', round_ended_ts) AS round_ended_ts_month
    FROM game_titles
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous round_ended_ts_month per game_mode
    SELECT *, LAG(round_ended_ts_month) OVER (PARTITION BY game_mode ORDER BY round_ended_ts_month, id) AS prev_round_ended_ts_month
    FROM scoped_game_titles
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_round_ended_ts_month IS NULL OR round_ended_ts_month > prev_round_ended_ts_month + INTERVAL 2 HOURS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY game_mode ORDER BY round_ended_ts_month, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS raw_burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        game_mode,
        raw_burst_id,
        MIN(round_ended_ts_month) AS session_start,
        MAX(round_ended_ts_month) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(round_ended_ts_month)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(round_ended_ts_month))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY game_mode, raw_burst_id
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM per_session
    WHERE events > (SELECT AVG(events) FROM per_session)
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        QUARTER(session_end) AS session_end_quarter,
        COALESCE(game_mode, 'UNKNOWN') AS game_mode_or_unknown,
        CONCAT(game_mode, '#', CAST(raw_burst_id AS STRING)) AS game_mode_ref
    FROM screened
    WHERE events < 4
)
SELECT
    game_mode,
    duration_min,
    COALESCE(game_mode_or_unknown, 'UNKNOWN') AS game_mode_or_unknown_or_unknown,
    ROUND(duration_min * 1.5, 2) AS duration_min_adj
FROM annotated
ORDER BY duration_min_adj DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_game_titles = (
    df_game_titles
    .select(
        "id",
        "game_mode",
        "round_secs",
        "round_ended_ts",
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("round_ended_ts")).alias("round_ended_ts_month"),
    )
)

with_prev = scoped_game_titles.withColumn("prev_round_ended_ts_month", F.lag("round_ended_ts_month").over(Window.partitionBy("game_mode").orderBy("round_ended_ts_month", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_round_ended_ts_month").isNull() | (F.col("round_ended_ts_month") > F.col("prev_round_ended_ts_month") + F.expr("INTERVAL 2 HOURS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("raw_burst_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("game_mode").orderBy("round_ended_ts_month", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("game_mode", "raw_burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("round_ended_ts_month").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("round_ended_ts_month").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),

    )
)

screened = (
    per_session
    .crossJoin(per_session.agg(F.avg("events").alias("overall_avg_events")))
    .filter(F.col("events") > F.col("overall_avg_events"))
    .drop("overall_avg_events")
)

annotated = (
    screened
    .filter(F.col("events") < 4)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.quarter(F.col("session_end")).alias("session_end_quarter"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("game_mode"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("game_mode_or_unknown"),
        F.concat(F.col("game_mode"), F.lit("#"), F.col("raw_burst_id").cast("string")).alias("game_mode_ref"),
    )
)

result = (
    annotated
    .select(
        "game_mode",
        "duration_min",
        F.coalesce(F.col("game_mode_or_unknown"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("game_mode_or_unknown_or_unknown"),
        F.round(F.col("duration_min") * 1.5, 2).alias("duration_min_adj"),
```

```sql
WITH l_monthly AS (
    -- L rows per fixture_day_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', fixture_day) AS fixture_day_month, COUNT(*) AS l_count, SUM(jersey_number) AS l_total_jersey_number
    FROM training_loads
    WHERE fixture_result = 'L'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', fixture_day)
),
d_monthly AS (
    -- D rows per fixture_day_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', fixture_day) AS fixture_day_month, COUNT(*) AS d_count, SUM(jersey_number) AS d_total_jersey_number
    FROM training_loads
    WHERE fixture_result = 'D'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', fixture_day)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.fixture_day_month, b.fixture_day_month) AS fixture_day_month,
    COALESCE(a.l_count, 0) AS l_count,
    COALESCE(a.l_total_jersey_number, 0) AS l_total_jersey_number,
    COALESCE(b.d_count, 0) AS d_count,
    b.d_total_jersey_number,
    COALESCE(a.l_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.d_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM l_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN d_monthly b
  ON a.fixture_day_month = b.fixture_day_month
ORDER BY fixture_day_month
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

l_monthly = (
    df_training_loads
    .filter(F.col("fixture_result") == "L")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "fixture_day").alias("fixture_day_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("l_count"),
        F.sum("jersey_number").alias("l_total_jersey_number"),
    )
)

d_monthly = (
    df_training_loads
    .filter(F.col("fixture_result") == "D")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "fixture_day").alias("fixture_day_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("d_count"),
        F.sum("jersey_number").alias("d_total_jersey_number"),
    )
)

result = (
    l_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(d_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.fixture_day_month") == F.col("b.fixture_day_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.fixture_day_month"), F.col("b.fixture_day_month")).alias("fixture_day_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.l_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("l_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.l_total_jersey_number"), F.lit(0)).alias("l_total_jersey_number"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.d_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("d_count"),
        F.col("b.d_total_jersey_number"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.l_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.d_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
```

```sql
    from bounds
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

bounds = df_power_plant_turbines_log.agg(
    F.min("inspected_on").alias("first_day"),
    F.max("inspected_on").alias("last_day"),
)

spine = bounds.select(
    F.explode(F.sequence("first_day", "last_day", F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAY"))).alias("report_date")

daily = (
    df_power_plant_turbines_log
```

```sql
    -- One row per active day, including days without a delivery report.
    SELECT r.ad_id, r.campaign, d.report_dt
    FROM ad_registry r
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(r.start_dt, r.end_dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) d AS report_dt
    WHERE r.is_enabled
),
filled AS (
    SELECT c.ad_id, c.campaign, c.report_dt,
           LAST(s.cum_imps, TRUE) OVER (
               PARTITION BY c.ad_id ORDER BY c.report_dt
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cum_imps,
           LAST(s.cum_clicks, TRUE) OVER (
               PARTITION BY c.ad_id ORDER BY c.report_dt
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cum_clicks
    FROM calendar c
    LEFT JOIN ad_daily_stats s
      ON s.ad_id = c.ad_id AND s.report_dt = c.report_dt
),
long_stats AS (
    -- STACK retains the leading NULLs before an ad's first report.
    SELECT f.ad_id, f.campaign, f.report_dt, metric_name, metric_value
    FROM filled f
    LATERAL VIEW STACK(2, 'impressions', f.cum_imps, 'clicks', f.cum_clicks) u
      AS metric_name, metric_value
),
ad_quality AS (
    SELECT ad_id,
           -- Index i aligns each click count with its hourly impression count.
           ROUND(AVG(AGGREGATE(
               TRANSFORM(hourly_clicks, (x, i) ->
                   CASE WHEN ELEMENT_AT(hourly_imps, i + 1) >= 100 AND x >= 0
                        THEN x ELSE 0 END),
               CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + x,
               acc -> acc / SIZE(hourly_clicks)
           )), 2) AS avg_valid_clicks,
           MAX(SIZE(FILTER(hourly_imps, x -> x >= 100))) AS peak_qualified_hours,
           BOOL_OR(EXISTS(hourly_clicks, x -> x >= 3)) AS engaged,
           BOOL_AND(FORALL(hourly_clicks, x -> x >= 0)) AS counts_valid,
           MAX(ELEMENT_AT(TRANSFORM_VALUES(
               MAP_FILTER(device_clicks, (k, v) -> v >= 2),
               (k, v) -> v * 10), 'mobile')) AS mobile_score
    FROM ad_daily_stats
    GROUP BY ad_id
)
SELECT l.ad_id, l.campaign, l.metric_name,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.metric_value) AS p50_value,
       q.avg_valid_clicks, q.peak_qualified_hours, q.engaged,
       q.counts_valid, q.mobile_score
FROM long_stats l
JOIN ad_quality q ON q.ad_id = l.ad_id
GROUP BY l.ad_id, l.campaign, l.metric_name, q.avg_valid_clicks,
         q.peak_qualified_hours, q.engaged, q.counts_valid, q.mobile_score
ORDER BY l.ad_id, l.metric_name
```

```python
calendar = (
    df_ad_registry
    .filter(F.col("is_enabled"))
    .select(
        "ad_id",
        "campaign",
        F.explode(F.sequence(F.col("start_dt"), F.col("end_dt"), F.expr("INTERVAL '1' DAY"))).alias("report_dt"),
    )
)

w_fill = (
    Window.partitionBy("c.ad_id")
    .orderBy("c.report_dt")
    .rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
)
filled = (
    calendar.alias("c")
    .join(
        df_ad_daily_stats.alias("s"),
        (F.col("s.ad_id") == F.col("c.ad_id")) & (F.col("s.report_dt") == F.col("c.report_dt")),

    )
    .select(
        F.col("c.ad_id").alias("ad_id"),
        "c.campaign",
        "c.report_dt",
        F.last(F.col("s.cum_imps"), ignorenulls=True).over(w_fill).alias("cum_imps"),
        F.last(F.col("s.cum_clicks"), ignorenulls=True).over(w_fill).alias("cum_clicks"),
    )
)

long_stats = (

    .withColumn(
        "metric",
        F.explode(F.array(
            F.struct(F.lit("impressions").alias("metric_name"), F.col("cum_imps").alias("metric_value")),
            F.struct(F.lit("clicks").alias("metric_name"), F.col("cum_clicks").alias("metric_value")),
        )),
    )
    .select("ad_id", "campaign", "report_dt", "metric.metric_name", "metric.metric_value")

    F.col("hourly_clicks"),
    lambda x, i: F.when((F.element_at(F.col("hourly_imps"), i + 1) >= 100) & (x >= 0), x).otherwise(F.lit(0)),
)

    .groupBy("ad_id")

            lambda acc, x: acc + x,
```

```python
    .withColumn("prev_valid_from", F.lag("valid_from").over(w_dock))
```

```sql
    JOIN library_members m ON m.member_id = l.member_id
),
tagged AS (
    -- index-aware genre tags plus array metrics per loan
    SELECT p.*, p.profile.contact.email AS contact_email,
           transform(p.genres, (g, i) -> concat(upper(g), '#', cast(i + 1 AS STRING))) AS genre_tags,
           filter(p.genres, g -> length(g) > 5) AS long_genres,
           exists(p.genres, g -> g = 'mystery') AS has_mystery,
           aggregate(p.renewal_gaps, 0, (acc, x) -> acc + x, acc -> nullif(acc, 0)) AS total_gap_days
    FROM profiled p
),
fine_unpivot AS (

    UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (fine_amount FOR fine_kind IN (fine_paid AS paid, fine_waived AS waived))
),
fine_stats AS (

    FROM fine_unpivot fu

    GROUP BY t.member_id
),
member_stats AS (

    SELECT t.member_id, t.member_type,
           count(*) AS loan_rows,
           count(t.contact_email) AS emails_on_file,
           sum(CASE WHEN t.returned_on IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_loans,
           sum(size(t.long_genres)) AS long_genre_cnt,
           max(t.total_gap_days) AS worst_gap,
           max(t.has_mystery) AS reads_mystery,
           sum(CASE WHEN t.newsletter_txt = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS newsletter_yes

),
```

```sql
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.site_id,
        a.read_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_12h,
        SUM(b.voltage) AS prior_voltage_12h
    FROM core_craters a
    LEFT JOIN core_craters b
      ON b.site_id = a.site_id
     AND b.read_at < a.read_at
     AND b.read_at >= a.read_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per site_id
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        prior_rows_12h,
        prior_voltage_12h
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY prior_voltage_12h DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM covered
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach site attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.site_id,
        s.read_at,
        s.prior_rows_12h,
        s.prior_voltage_12h,
        si.tariff AS site_tariff,
        si.zone AS site_zone,
        si.eastern_crescent AS site_commissioned_on
    FROM deduped s
    LEFT JOIN satellites_v2 si ON si.id = s.site_id
),
summary AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        YEAR(read_at) AS read_at_year,
        ROUND(AVG(prior_rows_12h), 2) AS avg_prior_rows_12h,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY YEAR(read_at)
)
SELECT
    read_at_year,
    avg_prior_rows_12h,
    n_rows,
    GREATEST(read_at_year, n_rows) AS greatest_read_at_year_n_rows
FROM summary
ORDER BY greatest_read_at_year_n_rows DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

covered = (
    df_core_craters.alias("a")
    .join(

        (F.col("b.site_id") == F.col("a.site_id"))
        & (F.col("b.read_at") < F.col("a.read_at"))
        & (F.col("b.read_at") >= F.col("a.read_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.site_id", "a.read_at")
    .agg(
```

```sql
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status_peak) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id, adjuster_id)) AS distinct_status_in_policy_id_adjuster_id,
        SUM(claimed_amount_adj) OVER (ORDER BY claim_date DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_claimed_amount_adj
    FROM prepared

without_matches AS (

        approved_amount_vs_policy_id_adjuster_id_avg,
        last_known_approved_amount,
        distinct_status_in_policy_id_adjuster_id,
        running_claimed_amount_adj
    FROM (
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.d3_avg_sprint_kmh, 0) AS d3_avg_sprint_kmh,
```

```python
with_windows = (

    .select(
```
