```sql
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY sec_tap_media ORDER BY visited_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
store_kiosk_stats AS (
    -- Per-bus_stop delis metrics
    SELECT
        bus_stop_no,
        MAX(visited_ts) AS last_store_kiosk_visited_ts,
        MAX(visited_ts) AS last_store_kiosk_visited_ts_2,
        MIN(visited_ts) AS first_store_kiosk_visited_ts
    FROM delis
    GROUP BY bus_stop_no
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach delis metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        st.last_store_kiosk_visited_ts,
        st.last_store_kiosk_visited_ts_2,
        st.first_store_kiosk_visited_ts
    FROM sessionized s
    LEFT JOIN store_kiosk_stats st ON st.bus_stop_no = s.bus_stop_no
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per sec_tap_media
    SELECT
        id,

        session_no,
        last_store_kiosk_visited_ts,
        last_store_kiosk_visited_ts_2,
        first_store_kiosk_visited_ts
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sec_tap_media ORDER BY stop_seq DESC, id DESC) AS rn
        FROM summarized_rows
    ) ranked
```

```sql
    SELECT campaign_id,
           MAX_BY(backer_id, amount) AS top_backer,
           MIN_BY(pledge_id, pledged_at) AS first_pledge_id,
           COUNT_IF(status = 'failed') AS failed_cnt,
           BOOL_OR(meets_min) AS any_meets_min,
           BOOL_OR(pledge_changed) AS tier_repriced,
           MAX(trailing_7d_amount) AS peak_7d_amount
    FROM matched
    GROUP BY campaign_id
),
pivoted AS (
    -- Payment-method breakdown with two aggregates per method
    SELECT *
    FROM (SELECT campaign_id, payment_method, pledge_id, amount FROM matched) m
    PIVOT (
        COUNT(pledge_id) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total
        FOR payment_method IN ('card', 'paypal', 'bank')
    )
)
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, s.top_backer, s.first_pledge_id, s.failed_cnt,
       s.any_meets_min, s.tier_repriced, s.peak_7d_amount,
       ROUND(s.peak_7d_amount / c.goal, 4) AS peak_pct_of_goal,
       p.card_n, p.card_total, p.paypal_n, p.paypal_total, p.bank_n, p.bank_total
FROM campaigns c
JOIN stats s ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
JOIN pivoted p ON p.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
ORDER BY c.campaign_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_tier = Window.partitionBy("campaign_id").orderBy("valid_from")

tier_windows = (
    df_reward_tiers
    .select(
        "campaign_id",
        "tier_name",
        "min_pledge",
        "valid_from",
        F.coalesce(
            F.lead("valid_from", 1).over(w_tier),
            F.lit("9999-12-31 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"),
        ).alias("valid_to"),
        (~F.col("min_pledge").eqNullSafe(F.lag("min_pledge").over(w_tier))).alias("pledge_changed"),
    )
)

w_roll = (
    Window.partitionBy("p.campaign_id")
    .orderBy(F.col("p.pledged_at").cast("long"))
    .rangeBetween(-7 * 86400, 0)
)

matched = (
    df_pledges.alias("p")
    .join(
        tier_windows.alias("t"),
        (F.col("t.campaign_id") == F.col("p.campaign_id"))
        & (F.col("p.pledged_at") >= F.col("t.valid_from"))
        & (F.col("p.pledged_at") < F.col("t.valid_to")),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "p.campaign_id",
        "p.pledge_id",
        "p.backer_id",
        "p.amount",
        "p.pledged_at",
        "p.status",
        "p.payment_method",
        (F.col("p.amount") >= F.col("t.min_pledge")).alias("meets_min"),
        F.col("t.pledge_changed"),
        F.sum("p.amount").over(w_roll).alias("trailing_7d_amount"),
    )
)

stats = (
    matched
    .groupBy("campaign_id")
    .agg(
        F.max_by("backer_id", "amount").alias("top_backer"),
        F.min_by("pledge_id", "pledged_at").alias("first_pledge_id"),
        F.count_if(F.col("status") == "failed").alias("failed_cnt"),
        F.bool_or("meets_min").alias("any_meets_min"),
        F.bool_or("pledge_changed").alias("tier_repriced"),
        F.max("trailing_7d_amount").alias("peak_7d_amount"),
    )
)

pivoted = (
    matched
    .select("campaign_id", "payment_method", "pledge_id", "amount")
    .groupBy("campaign_id")
    .pivot("payment_method", ["card", "paypal", "bank"])
    .agg(
        F.count("pledge_id").alias("n"),
        F.sum("amount").alias("total"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_campaigns.alias("c")
    .join(stats.alias("s"), "campaign_id")
    .join(pivoted.alias("p"), "campaign_id")
    .select(
        "c.campaign_id",
        "c.campaign_name",
        "s.top_backer",
        "s.first_pledge_id",
        "s.failed_cnt",
        "s.any_meets_min",
        "s.tier_repriced",
        "s.peak_7d_amount",
        F.round(F.col("s.peak_7d_amount") / F.col("c.goal"), 4).alias("peak_pct_of_goal"),
        "p.card_n",
        "p.card_total",
        "p.paypal_n",
        "p.paypal_total",
        "p.bank_n",
        "p.bank_total",
    )
    .orderBy("c.campaign_id")
)
```

```sql
    FROM pantries

    WHERE loan_state = 'owned'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', polar_switche)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.opens_on_month, b.opens_on_month) AS opens_on_month,
    COALESCE(a.borrowed_count, 0) AS borrowed_count,
    COALESCE(a.borrowed_total_created_year, 0) AS borrowed_total_created_year,
    COALESCE(b.owned_count, 0) AS owned_count,
    b.presse_code,
    COALESCE(a.borrowed_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.owned_count, 0) AS borrowed_count_minus_owned_count
FROM borrowed_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN owned_monthly b
  ON a.opens_on_month = b.opens_on_month
ORDER BY opens_on_month
```

```python
    df_pantries
    .filter(F.col("loan_state") == "borrowed")

    )

    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.opens_on_month"), F.col("b.opens_on_month")).alias("opens_on_month"),

)
```
```sql
SELECT
```

```sql
    last_last_reading_read_at,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_readings = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("site_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        F.date_trunc("week", F.col("read_at")).alias("read_at_week"),
    )
)

reading_stats = (
    df_meter_readings
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("read_at").alias("last_reading_read_at"),
        F.count("*").alias("reading_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("reading_count_2"),
    )
)

summarized_rows = (
    valid_readings.alias("s")
    .join(reading_stats.alias("m"), F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "m.last_reading_read_at",
        F.coalesce(F.col("m.reading_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("reading_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("m.reading_count_2"), F.lit(0)).alias("reading_count_2"),
    )

w_read_at_week_month_site_id = Window.partitionBy(F.month("read_at_week"), "site_id")
metrics = (

    .select(

        "read_at",
        "reading_count",
        "reading_count_2",
        F.first("reading_count", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("reading_count").orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_reading_count"),
        F.max("reading_count_2").over(Window.partitionBy("reading_count").orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(-1, -1)).alias("reading_count_2_max_1_prior"),
        F.round(F.col("voltage") / F.nullif(F.sum("voltage").over(w_read_at_week_month_site_id), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("voltage_share_of_read_at_week_month_site_id"),
        F.last("last_reading_read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("reading_count").orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_last_reading_read_at"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "read_at",
        "reading_count",
        "reading_count_2",
        "first_known_reading_count",
        "reading_count_2_max_1_prior",
        "voltage_share_of_read_at_week_month_site_id",
        "last_last_reading_read_at",
        (F.col("read_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")).alias("read_at_plus_1d"),
        F.abs(F.col("reading_count_2") - 4).alias("reading_count_2_distance"),
```

```sql
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.sku_id,
        a.moved_at,

        SUM(b.unit_price) AS prior_unit_price_1d
    FROM stock_moves a
    LEFT JOIN stock_moves b
      ON b.sku_id = a.sku_id
     AND b.moved_at < a.moved_at
     AND b.moved_at >= a.moved_at - INTERVAL 1 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.sku_id, a.moved_at
),
joined_sku AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.sku_id,
        s.moved_at,
        s.prior_rows_1d,
        sk.unit_cost AS sku_unit_cost
    FROM covered s
    JOIN skus sk ON sk.id = s.sku_id
)
SELECT
    id,
    moved_at,
    prior_rows_1d,
    sku_unit_cost,
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', moved_at) AS moved_at_day
FROM joined_sku
ORDER BY moved_at
```

```python
        "left",
```

```python
        "session_mins",
        "session_started_at",
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized
```

```sql
    COALESCE(v.audio_scores, ARRAY()) AS audio_scores,
    TRANSFORM_VALUES(v.gallery_minutes, (gallery, minutes) -> LEAST(minutes, 90)) AS capped_minutes,

    ) AS audio_score,

    FORALL(s.audio_scores, score -> score BETWEEN 0 AND 10) AS valid_audio
  FROM scored s
```

```python
    .select(
        "v.visit_id",
        "v.member_id",
        "v.visit_day",
        "v.party_size",
        F.coalesce(F.col("v.audio_scores"), F.array().cast("array<int>")).alias("audio_scores"),
        F.transform_values(F.col("v.gallery_minutes"), lambda gallery, minutes: F.least(minutes, F.lit(90))).alias("capped_minutes"),
        F.map_filter(F.col("v.gallery_minutes"), lambda gallery, minutes: minutes >= 30).alias("focused_minutes"),
    )
)

scored = (
    normalized.alias("n")
    .select(
        "n.*",
        F.transform(F.col("n.audio_scores"), lambda score, idx: score * (idx + 1)).alias("weighted_scores"),
        F.element_at(F.col("n.capped_minutes"), F.lit("ancient_art")).alias("ancient_art_minutes"),

    .groupBy("m.member_id", "m.member_name", "m.tier")
    .agg(

        F.count_if(F.col("x.party_size") >= 4).alias("group_visits"),
```

```sql
        event_at,
        event_type,

    FROM ticket_events

with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event_at per actor

    FROM valid
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR event_at > prev_event_at + INTERVAL 90 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        actor,
        burst_id,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(event_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY actor, burst_id
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    event_count,
    burst_id,
    MAX(event_count) AS max_event_count,
    MIN(session_end) AS first_session_end,
    SUM(CASE WHEN actor = 'customer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_actor_customer
FROM per_session
```

```python
        "event_type",
        "actor",

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_event_at").isNull() | (F.col("event_at") > F.col("prev_event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
```

```python
w_adjuster_id_claim_date_month = Window.partitionBy("adjuster_id", F.date_trunc("month", "claim_date"))

    .select(

        "claim_date",
        "claim_type",
        "claimed_amount",
        "approved_amount",
        "reported_at",
        "claim_type_prefix",
```

```python
    .groupBy("artist_id")
    .agg(
```

```sql
    -- Green rows per campus_id
    SELECT campus_id, COUNT(*) AS green_count, SUM(score_percent) AS green_total_score_percent
    FROM kettles_log
    WHERE house_label = 'Green'
    GROUP BY campus_id
),
blue_by_campus AS (
    -- Blue rows per campus_id
    SELECT campus_id, COUNT(*) AS blue_count, ROUND(AVG(score_percent), 2) AS blue_avg_score_percent
    FROM kettles_log
    WHERE house_label = 'Blue'
    GROUP BY campus_id
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.campus_id, b.campus_id) AS campus_id,
    COALESCE(a.green_count, 0) AS green_count,
    COALESCE(a.green_total_score_percent, 0) AS green_total_score_percent,
    COALESCE(b.blue_count, 0) AS blue_count,
    b.blue_avg_score_percent,
    COALESCE(a.green_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.blue_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM green_by_campus a
FULL OUTER JOIN blue_by_campus b
  ON a.campus_id = b.campus_id
ORDER BY campus_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

green_by_campus = (
    df_kettles_log
    .filter(F.col("house_label") == "Green")
    .groupBy("campus_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("green_count"),
        F.sum("score_percent").alias("green_total_score_percent"),
    )
)

blue_by_campus = (
    df_kettles_log
    .filter(F.col("house_label") == "Blue")
    .groupBy("campus_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("blue_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("score_percent"), 2).alias("blue_avg_score_percent"),
    )
)

result = (
    green_by_campus.alias("a")
    .join(blue_by_campus.alias("b"), F.col("a.campus_id") == F.col("b.campus_id"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.campus_id"), F.col("b.campus_id")).alias("campus_id"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.green_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("green_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.green_total_score_percent"), F.lit(0)).alias("green_total_score_percent"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.blue_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("blue_count"),
        F.col("b.blue_avg_score_percent"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.green_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.blue_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("campus_id")
)
```

```sql
WITH matched AS (
    -- Events that happened while the ticket was open
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.river_pedal,
        e.event_at,
        e.event_type,
        t.priority,
        t.agent_id,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(e.event_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(t.opened_at)) / 3600, 2) AS hours_since_open
    FROM aerials e
    JOIN podcast_cockpits t
      ON t.id = e.river_pedal
     AND e.event_at >= t.opened_at
     AND e.event_at <= COALESCE(t.closed_at, t.opened_at + INTERVAL 3 DAYS)
),
scored AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT *, QUARTER(event_at) AS event_at_quarter
    FROM matched
    WHERE agent_id <= 8
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    river_pedal,
    priority,
    agent_id,
    hours_since_open,
    event_at_quarter
FROM scored
WHERE agent_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY priority, event_at_quarter
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

matched = (
    df_aerials.alias("e")
    .join(
        df_podcast_cockpits.alias("t"),
        (F.col("t.id") == F.col("e.river_pedal"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") >= F.col("t.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") <= F.coalesce(F.col("t.closed_at"), F.col("t.opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS"))),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.river_pedal",
        "e.event_at",
        "e.event_type",
        "t.priority",

scored = (

    .select(
```

```python
    .join(team_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.team") == F.col("s.team"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.level") > F.col("g.avg_level"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_level",
        F.round(F.col("s.level") - F.col("g.avg_level"), 2).alias("level_minus_avg"),

)

latest_per_key = (
    compared
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("team").orderBy(F.col("avg_level").desc(), F.col("id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

joined_ranges = (
    df_meter_readings.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_meter_readings.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.site_id") == F.col("a.site_id"))
        & (F.col("b.read_at") < F.col("a.read_at"))
        & (F.col("b.read_at") >= F.col("a.read_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.site_id", "a.read_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_7d"),
        F.sum("b.voltage").alias("prior_voltage_7d"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    joined_ranges
    .groupBy("site_id", "prior_rows_7d")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("prior_rows_7d"), 2).alias("avg_prior_rows_7d"),
        F.min("read_at").alias("first_read_at"),
        F.min("prior_rows_7d").alias("min_prior_rows_7d"),
        F.round(F.avg("prior_voltage_7d"), 2).alias("avg_prior_voltage_7d"),
        F.max("read_at").alias("last_read_at"),

w_min_prior_rows_7d_site_id_by = Window.partitionBy("min_prior_rows_7d", "site_id").orderBy(F.col("first_read_at").desc(), "site_id", "prior_rows_7d")

    .withColumn("prev_avg_prior_rows_7d", F.lag("avg_prior_rows_7d").over(w_min_prior_rows_7d_site_id_by))
)

reading_stats = (
    df_meter_readings
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("reading_count"))
)

with_stats = (
    metrics.alias("s")
    .join(reading_stats.alias("m"), F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("m.reading_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("reading_count"),

result = (
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN policy_id_stats g ON g.policy_id = s.policy_id

ranked AS (

scored AS (

        cnt_distinct_policy_ids_bucket_avg_distinct_stat,
        ABS(distinct_policy_ids - 5) AS distinct_policy_ids_distance,
        FLOOR(cnt / 2) * 2 AS cnt_bucket,
```

```python
filtered = (
    df_tbl_telescopes
    .filter(F.col("approved_amount") > 492.6)
    .select(
        "id",
        "policy_id",
        "adjuster_id",
        "claim_date",
        "claim_type",
        "claimed_amount",
        "approved_amount",
        "status",
        "reported_at",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("claim_type"))).alias("claim_type_len"),
        F.round(F.col("claimed_amount") * 0.9, 2).alias("claimed_amount_adj"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("status")), 1, 4).alias("status_prefix"),
    )
)

policy_id_stats = (
    filtered
    .groupBy("policy_id")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("claimed_amount", 0.5).alias("median_claimed_amount"))
)

vs_group = (
    filtered.alias("s")
    .join(policy_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.policy_id") == F.col("s.policy_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.claimed_amount") >= F.col("g.median_claimed_amount"))
    .select(

        "g.median_claimed_amount",
        F.round(F.col("s.claimed_amount") - F.col("g.median_claimed_amount"), 2).alias("claimed_amount_minus_median"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    vs_group
    .groupBy("claim_type_len")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("status").alias("distinct_status"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.countDistinct("policy_id").alias("distinct_policy_ids"),
    )
)

labeled = (
    rollup_base
    .withColumn("distinct_policy_ids_bucket", F.floor(F.col("distinct_policy_ids") / 2) * 2)
)

w_cnt_distinct_policy_ids_buck = Window.partitionBy("cnt", "distinct_policy_ids_bucket")
ranked = (

)

scored = (
    ranked
    .select(

        "distinct_policy_ids",
        "cnt_distinct_policy_ids_bucket_max_distinct_stat",
        "cnt_distinct_policy_ids_bucket_avg_distinct_stat",
        F.abs(F.col("distinct_policy_ids") - 5).alias("distinct_policy_ids_distance"),
        (F.floor(F.col("cnt") / 2) * 2).alias("cnt_bucket"),
        (F.col("distinct_status") + F.col("claim_type_len")).alias("distinct_status_plus_claim_type_len"),

)

result = (

    .select(

        "cnt_distinct_policy_ids_bucket_avg_distinct_stat",
        "distinct_policy_ids_distance",
```

```sql
    SELECT e.*,
           LAG(distance_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY driver_id ORDER BY effective_at, revision) AS previous_rate
    FROM rate_events e
),
rate_periods AS (
    -- Remove repeated snapshots, then close each validity interval.
    SELECT driver_id, effective_at AS valid_from, distance_rate,
           LEAD(effective_at, 1, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 00:00:00')
             OVER (PARTITION BY driver_id ORDER BY effective_at, revision) AS valid_to
    FROM rate_changes
    WHERE distance_rate IS DISTINCT FROM previous_rate
),
trip_features AS (
    SELECT t.trip_id, t.driver_id, t.completed_at, t.leg_distances_km,
           ARRAY_SORT(ARRAYS_ZIP(t.leg_distances_km, t.leg_minutes),
               (l, r) -> CASE WHEN l.leg_distances_km < r.leg_distances_km THEN -1
                              WHEN l.leg_distances_km > r.leg_distances_km THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sorted_legs
    FROM driver_trips t
    WHERE t.trip_status = 'COMPLETED'
),
missing_exports AS (
    SELECT trip_id FROM driver_trips WHERE trip_status = 'COMPLETED'
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT trip_id FROM payout_exports
)
SELECT m.trip_id, f.driver_id, f.completed_at, r.distance_rate,
       CAST(ROUND(AGGREGATE(TRANSFORM(SLICE(f.sorted_legs, 1, 2), x -> x.leg_distances_km),
                            CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + x)
                  * CAST(r.distance_rate AS DOUBLE), 2) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS first_two_payout,
       CASE WHEN SIZE(f.sorted_legs) > 0
            THEN ELEMENT_AT(f.sorted_legs, -1).leg_distances_km END AS longest_leg_km,
       ARRAY_POSITION(f.leg_distances_km,
                      CASE WHEN SIZE(f.sorted_legs) > 0
                           THEN ELEMENT_AT(f.sorted_legs, -1).leg_distances_km END) AS longest_leg_position,
       TRY_ELEMENT_AT(TRANSFORM(f.sorted_legs, x -> x.leg_distances_km), 2) AS second_leg_km
FROM missing_exports m
JOIN trip_features f ON f.trip_id = m.trip_id
JOIN rate_periods r ON r.driver_id = f.driver_id
                   AND r.valid_from <= f.completed_at
                   AND f.completed_at < r.valid_to
ORDER BY m.trip_id
```

```python
w_rate = Window.partitionBy("driver_id").orderBy("effective_at", "revision")
rate_changes = (
    df_rate_events.alias("e")
    .select("e.*", F.lag("distance_rate").over(w_rate).alias("previous_rate"))
)
rate_periods = (
    rate_changes
    .filter(~F.col("distance_rate").eqNullSafe(F.col("previous_rate")))
    .select(
        "driver_id",
        F.col("effective_at").alias("valid_from"),
        "distance_rate",
        F.coalesce(
            F.lead("effective_at").over(w_rate),
            F.lit("9999-12-31 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"),
        ).alias("valid_to"),
    )
)
sorted_legs = F.array_sort(
    F.arrays_zip("leg_distances_km", "leg_minutes"),
    lambda l, r: F.when(l["leg_distances_km"] < r["leg_distances_km"], -1)
    .when(l["leg_distances_km"] > r["leg_distances_km"], 1)
    .otherwise(0),
)
trip_features = (
    df_driver_trips.alias("t")
    .filter(F.col("trip_status") == "COMPLETED")
    .select(
        "trip_id", "driver_id", "completed_at", "leg_distances_km",
        sorted_legs.alias("sorted_legs"),
    )
)
missing_exports = (
    df_driver_trips
    .filter(F.col("trip_status") == "COMPLETED")
    .select("trip_id")
    .exceptAll(df_payout_exports.select("trip_id"))
)
first_two_distance = F.aggregate(
    F.transform(
        F.slice(F.col("f.sorted_legs"), 1, 2),
        lambda x: x["leg_distances_km"],
    ),
    F.lit(0.0),
    lambda acc, x: acc + x,
)
longest_leg = F.when(
    F.size(F.col("f.sorted_legs")) > 0,
    F.element_at(F.col("f.sorted_legs"), -1)["leg_distances_km"],
)
sorted_distances = F.transform(F.col("f.sorted_legs"), lambda x: x["leg_distances_km"])
result = (
    missing_exports.alias("m")
    .join(trip_features.alias("f"), F.col("f.trip_id") == F.col("m.trip_id"))
    .join(
        rate_periods.alias("r"),
        (F.col("r.driver_id") == F.col("f.driver_id"))
        & (F.col("r.valid_from") <= F.col("f.completed_at"))
        & (F.col("f.completed_at") < F.col("r.valid_to")),
    )
    .select(
        "m.trip_id", "f.driver_id", "f.completed_at", "r.distance_rate",
        F.round(first_two_distance * F.col("r.distance_rate").cast("double"), 2)
        .cast("decimal(10,2)").alias("first_two_payout"),
        longest_leg.alias("longest_leg_km"),
        F.array_position(F.col("f.leg_distances_km"), longest_leg).alias("longest_leg_position"),
        F.try_element_at(sorted_distances, F.lit(2)).alias("second_leg_km"),
    )
    .orderBy("m.trip_id")
)
```

```sql
WITH scored AS (
    SELECT r.*,
           filter(competency_scores, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AS valid_scores
    FROM stg_interview_reviews r
),
weighted AS (
    -- Position zero has the largest weight.
    SELECT s.*,
           transform(valid_scores, (x, i) -> x * (size(valid_scores) - i)) AS weighted_scores
    FROM scored s
),
review_metrics AS (
    SELECT w.requisition_id, w.candidate_id, w.submitted_at,
           w.valid_scores, w.weighted_scores, di.department,
           aggregate(
               weighted_scores, CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + x,
               acc -> round(acc / nullif(size(valid_scores) * (size(valid_scores) + 1) / 2, 0), 2)
           ) AS weighted_score,
           exists(valid_scores, x -> x = 5) AS has_excellent,
           forall(competency_scores, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AS rubric_complete
    FROM weighted w
    JOIN dim_interviewers di
      ON di.interviewer_id = w.interviewer_id AND di.is_active
),
session_metrics AS (
    -- A gap of more than 50 minutes starts a new feedback session.
    SELECT requisition_id, candidate_id, department,
           session_window(submitted_at, '50 minutes') AS review_window,
           count(*) AS review_count,
           round(avg(weighted_score), 2) AS session_score,
           sum(CASE WHEN has_excellent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excellent_reviews,
           sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(rubric_complete, FALSE) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS incomplete_reviews
    FROM review_metrics
    GROUP BY requisition_id, candidate_id, department, session_window(submitted_at, '50 minutes')
)
SELECT q.job_family,
       s.department,
       s.review_window.start AS session_start,
       s.review_window.end AS session_end,
       count(DISTINCT s.candidate_id) AS candidates_assessed,
       count(*) AS review_sessions,
       round(avg(s.session_score), 2) AS avg_session_score,
       sum(s.excellent_reviews) AS excellent_reviews,
       sum(s.incomplete_reviews) AS incomplete_reviews
FROM session_metrics s
JOIN dim_requisitions q ON q.requisition_id = s.requisition_id
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY job_family, department, session_start
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

scored = (
    df_stg_interview_reviews
    .select(
        "*",
        F.filter(
            F.col("competency_scores"),
            lambda x: x.isNotNull() & x.between(1, 5),
        ).alias("valid_scores"),
    )
)

weighted = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.transform(
            F.col("valid_scores"),
            lambda x, i: x * (F.size("valid_scores") - i),
        ).alias("weighted_scores"),
    )
)

denominator = F.when(
    F.size("valid_scores") > 0,
    F.size("valid_scores") * (F.size("valid_scores") + 1) / 2,
)
review_metrics = (
    weighted.alias("w")
    .join(
        df_dim_interviewers.alias("di"),
        (F.col("di.interviewer_id") == F.col("w.interviewer_id")) & F.col("di.is_active"),
    )
    .select(
        "w.requisition_id",
        "w.candidate_id",
        "w.submitted_at",
        "w.valid_scores",
        "w.weighted_scores",
        "di.department",
        F.aggregate(
            F.col("weighted_scores"),
            F.lit(0.0),
            lambda acc, x: acc + x,
            lambda acc: F.round(acc / denominator, 2),
        ).alias("weighted_score"),
        F.exists(F.col("valid_scores"), lambda x: x == 5).alias("has_excellent"),
        F.forall(
            F.col("competency_scores"),
            lambda x: x.isNotNull() & x.between(1, 5),
        ).alias("rubric_complete"),
    )
)

session_metrics = (
    review_metrics
    .groupBy(

        "department",

    .agg(

        F.round(F.avg("weighted_score"), 2).alias("session_score"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("has_excellent"), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("excellent_reviews"),
        F.sum(
            F.when(F.coalesce(F.col("rubric_complete"), F.lit(False)), 0).otherwise(1)
        ).alias("incomplete_reviews"),
    )
)

joined = (
    session_metrics.alias("s")
    .join(df_dim_requisitions.alias("q"), F.col("q.requisition_id") == F.col("s.requisition_id"))
    .select(
        "q.job_family",
        "s.department",

        F.col("s.review_window.end").alias("session_end"),

        "s.session_score",
        "s.excellent_reviews",
        "s.incomplete_reviews",

result = (

    .groupBy("job_family", "department", "session_start", "session_end")

        F.count("*").alias("review_sessions"),
        F.round(F.avg("session_score"), 2).alias("avg_session_score"),
        F.sum("excellent_reviews").alias("excellent_reviews"),
        F.sum("incomplete_reviews").alias("incomplete_reviews"),
    )
    .orderBy("job_family", "department", "session_start")
)
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS harbor_flagon
    FROM flagged
),
scored AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(TRIM(term)) AS term_len,
        starts_session - harbor_flagon AS starts_session_minus_session_id
    FROM sessionized
    WHERE starts_session BETWEEN 0 AND 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    student_id,
    course_id,
    term,
    score,
    enrolled_at,
    prev_enrolled_at,
    starts_session,
```

```python
    )
)

with_prev = base.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("course_id").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))
```

```sql
      AND collected_date >= DATE '2024-08-27'
),
specimen_kind_stats AS (
    -- Avg conc_ng_ml per specimen_kind
    SELECT specimen_kind, AVG(conc_ng_ml) AS avg_conc_ng_ml
    FROM valid_assay_runs
    GROUP BY specimen_kind
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_conc_ng_ml,
        ROUND(s.conc_ng_ml - g.avg_conc_ng_ml, 2) AS conc_ng_ml_minus_avg
    FROM valid_assay_runs s
    JOIN specimen_kind_stats g ON g.specimen_kind = s.specimen_kind
    WHERE s.conc_ng_ml > g.avg_conc_ng_ml
),
assay_run_stats AS (
    -- Per-specimen fleets_snapshot metrics
    SELECT
        specimen_id,
        SUM(reagent_cost) AS total_assay_run_reagent_cost,

    FROM fleets_snapshot

),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach fleets_snapshot metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        a.total_assay_run_reagent_cost,
        a.last_assay_run_collected_date,
        COALESCE(a.assay_run_count, 0) AS assay_run_count
    FROM outliers s
    LEFT JOIN assay_run_stats a ON a.specimen_id = s.specimen_id
),
combined_details_specimen AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT s.*, sp.conc_ng_ml AS specimen_conc_ng_ml
    FROM profiled s
    JOIN bronze_mines sp ON sp.id = s.specimen_id AND sp.conc_ng_ml <= 470.7
)

    assay_run_count,
    specimen_id,
```

```python
    .filter((F.col("instrument_make") == "Agilent") & (F.col("collected_date") >= F.lit("2024-08-27").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "specimen_id",
        "instrument_make",
        "specimen_kind",
        "conc_ng_ml",
        "is_urgent",
    )
)

specimen_kind_stats = (
    valid_assay_runs
    .groupBy("specimen_kind")
    .agg(F.avg("conc_ng_ml").alias("avg_conc_ng_ml"))
)

outliers = (
    valid_assay_runs.alias("s")
    .join(specimen_kind_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.specimen_kind") == F.col("s.specimen_kind"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.conc_ng_ml") > F.col("g.avg_conc_ng_ml"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_conc_ng_ml",
        F.round(F.col("s.conc_ng_ml") - F.col("g.avg_conc_ng_ml"), 2).alias("conc_ng_ml_minus_avg"),

    .join(assay_run_stats.alias("a"), F.col("a.specimen_id") == F.col("s.specimen_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "a.total_assay_run_reagent_cost",
        "a.last_assay_run_collected_date",

    .join(df_bronze_mines.alias("sp"), (F.col("sp.id") == F.col("s.specimen_id")) & (F.col("sp.conc_ng_ml") <= 470.7), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("sp.conc_ng_ml").alias("specimen_conc_ng_ml"))
)

result = (
    combined_details_specimen
    .groupingSets(
        [["assay_run_count", "specimen_id", "is_urgent"], ["assay_run_count"]],
        "assay_run_count", "specimen_id", "is_urgent",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_moves = (

w_warehouse_id_operator = Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id", "operator")
w_sku_id_warehouse_id_by_unit = Window.partitionBy("sku_id", "warehouse_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc(), "id")
sequenced = (

        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id", "move_type_len").orderBy("moved_at")).alias("moved_at_rank"),
        F.min("move_type_len").over(Window.partitionBy("warehouse_id", "operator")).alias("warehouse_id_operator_min_move_type_len"),
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (

        session_id,
        MIN(read_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(read_at) AS session_end,

        SUM(voltage) AS session_voltage,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min

enriched_site AS (

        s.session_id,
        s.session_end,
        s.event_count,
        s.duration_min,
        si.tariff AS site_tariff,
        si.site_name
    FROM per_session s
    JOIN sites si ON si.id = s.site_id
)
SELECT

    session_end,

    duration_min,

    site_name,

FROM enriched_site
```

```python
scoped = (
    df_meter_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.when(F.col("voltage") >= 237.5, "A").when(F.col("voltage") >= 222.6, "B").otherwise("C").alias("voltage_tier"),
    )
)

with_prev = scoped.withColumn("prev_read_at", F.lag("read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("read_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_read_at").isNull() | (F.col("read_at") > F.col("prev_read_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("read_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("site_id", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("read_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("read_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.sum("voltage").alias("session_voltage"),

        "event_count",
        "duration_min",
```

```sql
           COUNT(*) OVER (

               RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '7' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

    SELECT member_id,

    FROM daily
),

        GROUP BY member_id, island_key
    ) s
    GROUP BY member_id

           TRANSFORM(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(e.duration_min)), (x, i) -> x + i) AS adj_durations,

    FROM enriched e
```

```python
        F.aggregate(
            F.sort_array(F.collect_list("e.duration_min")),
            F.lit(0),
            lambda acc, x: acc + F.coalesce(x, F.lit(0)),
            lambda acc: acc * 2,

        F.exists(F.sort_array(F.collect_list("e.duration_min")), lambda x: x >= F.lit(60)).alias("had_long_visit"),
```

```sql
    FROM claims

    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', claim_date)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.claim_date_month, b.claim_date_month) AS claim_date_month,
    COALESCE(a.rejected_count, 0) AS rejected_count,
    a.rejected_avg_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(b.paid_count, 0) AS paid_count,
    COALESCE(b.paid_total_claimed_amount, 0) AS paid_total_claimed_amount,
    COALESCE(a.rejected_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.paid_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM rejected_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN paid_monthly b
  ON a.claim_date_month = b.claim_date_month
ORDER BY claim_date_month
```

```sql
               WHEN l.offset_min > r.offset_min THEN 1
               WHEN l.stop_id < r.stop_id THEN -1
               WHEN l.stop_id > r.stop_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ordered_plan,
           TRANSFORM(ARRAY_SORT(stop_plan, (l, r) -> CASE
               WHEN l.offset_min < r.offset_min THEN -1
               WHEN l.offset_min > r.offset_min THEN 1
               WHEN l.stop_id < r.stop_id THEN -1
               WHEN l.stop_id > r.stop_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), x -> x.stop_id) AS stop_ids
    FROM route_patterns
),
stop_summary AS (
    SELECT route_id, direction_id,
           MAX_BY(p.stop.stop_id, p.pos) AS terminal_stop,
           BOOL_AND(p.stop.accessible) AS fully_accessible,
           COUNT_IF(p.stop.offset_min >= 10) AS long_hop_count
    FROM ordered_patterns
    LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE_OUTER(ordered_plan) p AS pos, stop
    GROUP BY ALL
),
journey_arrays AS (
    SELECT route_id, direction_id, TO_DATE(tapped_at) AS service_date,
           ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_LIST(NAMED_STRUCT(

               (l, r) -> CASE

                   WHEN l.tapped_at > r.tapped_at THEN 1
                   WHEN l.tap_seq < r.tap_seq THEN -1

           COUNT_IF(valid_fare) AS valid_taps,
           COUNT(tap_id) FILTER (WHERE (NOT valid_fare) OR fare_paid = 0.00) AS flagged_taps,
           BOOL_OR(NOT valid_fare) AS has_invalid,
           BOOL_AND(fare_paid > 0.00) AS all_paid,
           MAX_BY(boarded_stop, tapped_at) AS latest_stop,
           MIN_BY(boarded_stop, tapped_at) AS earliest_stop
    FROM tap_events
    GROUP BY CUBE(route_id, direction_id, TO_DATE(tapped_at))
    HAVING GROUPING_ID() IN (0, 1)
)
SELECT s.route_id, s.direction_id, s.service_date, s.group_level,
       valid_taps, flagged_taps, has_invalid, all_paid,
       latest_stop, earliest_stop, terminal_stop, fully_accessible, long_hop_count,
       SLICE(ARRAYS_ZIP(TRANSFORM(j.ordered_taps, x -> x.stop_id),
                        TRANSFORM(j.ordered_taps, x -> x.tap_seq)), 1, 2) AS opening_trace,
       ELEMENT_AT(p.stop_ids, -1) AS planned_terminal,
       ARRAY_POSITION(p.stop_ids, s.latest_stop) AS latest_stop_position,
       TRY_ELEMENT_AT(p.stop_ids, CAST(ARRAY_POSITION(p.stop_ids, s.latest_stop) + 1 AS INT)) AS next_planned_stop
FROM stats s
LEFT JOIN stop_summary z USING (route_id, direction_id)
LEFT JOIN ordered_patterns p USING (route_id, direction_id)
LEFT JOIN journey_arrays j USING (route_id, direction_id, service_date)
ORDER BY s.route_id, s.direction_id, s.service_date DESC NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

plan_order = lambda l, r: (F.when(l.offset_min < r.offset_min, -1)
    .when(l.offset_min > r.offset_min, 1)
    .when(l.stop_id < r.stop_id, -1)
    .when(l.stop_id > r.stop_id, 1).otherwise(0))
ordered_patterns = (
    df_route_patterns
    .select("route_id", "direction_id", F.array_sort("stop_plan", plan_order).alias("ordered_plan"))
    .withColumn("stop_ids", F.transform("ordered_plan", lambda x: x.stop_id))
)
stop_summary = (
    ordered_patterns
    .select("route_id", "direction_id", F.posexplode_outer("ordered_plan").alias("pos", "stop"))
    .groupBy("route_id", "direction_id")
    .agg(
        F.max_by("stop.stop_id", "pos").alias("terminal_stop"),
        F.bool_and("stop.accessible").alias("fully_accessible"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("stop.offset_min") >= 10, 1)).alias("long_hop_count"),
    )
)
tap_order = lambda l, r: (F.when(l.tapped_at < r.tapped_at, -1)
    .when(l.tapped_at > r.tapped_at, 1)
    .when(l.tap_seq < r.tap_seq, -1)
    .when(l.tap_seq > r.tap_seq, 1).otherwise(0))
journey_arrays = (
    df_tap_events
    .withColumn("service_date", F.to_date("tapped_at"))
    .groupBy("route_id", "direction_id", "service_date")
    .agg(F.array_sort(F.collect_list(F.struct(
        F.col("tap_id").alias("tap_seq"), F.col("boarded_stop").alias("stop_id"), "tapped_at"
    )), tap_order).alias("ordered_taps"))
)
stats = (
    df_tap_events
    .withColumn("service_date", F.to_date("tapped_at"))
    .cube("route_id", "direction_id", "service_date")
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id("route_id", "direction_id", "service_date").alias("group_level"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("valid_fare"), 1)).alias("valid_taps"),
        F.count(F.when((~F.col("valid_fare")) | (F.col("fare_paid") == 0), "tap_id")).alias("flagged_taps"),
        F.bool_or(~F.col("valid_fare")).alias("has_invalid"),
        F.bool_and(F.col("fare_paid") > 0).alias("all_paid"),
        F.max_by("boarded_stop", "tapped_at").alias("latest_stop"),
        F.min_by("boarded_stop", "tapped_at").alias("earliest_stop"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("group_level").isin(0, 1))
)
trace = F.arrays_zip(
    F.transform("j.ordered_taps", lambda x: x.stop_id),
    F.transform("j.ordered_taps", lambda x: x.tap_seq),
)
next_index = (F.array_position("p.stop_ids", F.col("s.latest_stop")) + 1).cast("int")
result = (
    stats.alias("s")
    .join(stop_summary.alias("z"), ["route_id", "direction_id"], "left")
    .join(ordered_patterns.alias("p"), ["route_id", "direction_id"], "left")
    .join(journey_arrays.alias("j"), ["route_id", "direction_id", "service_date"], "left")
    .select(
        "s.route_id", "s.direction_id", "s.service_date", "group_level",
        "valid_taps", "flagged_taps", "has_invalid", "all_paid", "latest_stop", "earliest_stop",
        "terminal_stop", "fully_accessible", "long_hop_count",
        F.slice(trace, 1, 2).alias("opening_trace"),
        F.element_at("p.stop_ids", -1).alias("planned_terminal"),
        F.array_position("p.stop_ids", F.col("s.latest_stop")).alias("latest_stop_position"),
        F.try_element_at("p.stop_ids", next_index).alias("next_planned_stop"),
    )
    .orderBy("s.route_id", "s.direction_id", F.col("s.service_date").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

```sql
)
```

```python
    df_ad_serving_daily
    .filter(F.col("conversions") > 0)
    .select("campaign_id", "placement_id")
    .distinct()
)

w_activity = Window.partitionBy("dly.campaign_id", "dly.placement_id").orderBy("dly.activity_date")
stamped = (
    df_ad_serving_daily.alias("dly")
    .join(
        eligible_pairs.alias("elg"),
        (F.col("elg.campaign_id") == F.col("dly.campaign_id"))
        & (F.col("elg.placement_id") == F.col("dly.placement_id")),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(

    .filter(F.col("active_days") >= 2)
```

```sql
    ) changed

    FROM eligible_fills ef
    JOIN terms_scd tm

)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_terms = Window.partitionBy("acct_id", "drug_id").orderBy("valid_from")
terms_scd = (
    df_drug_terms
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("valid_from").over(w_terms).alias("prev_valid_from"),
        F.lag("copay").over(w_terms).alias("prev_copay"),
        F.lag("max_qty").over(w_terms).alias("prev_max_qty"),
    )
    .filter(
        F.col("prev_valid_from").isNull()
        | (~F.col("copay").eqNullSafe(F.col("prev_copay")))
        | (~F.col("max_qty").eqNullSafe(F.col("prev_max_qty")))
    )
    .select(
        "acct_id",
        "drug_id",
        "valid_from",
        F.lead("valid_from", 1, "9999-12-31 00:00:00").over(w_terms).alias("valid_to"),
        "copay",
        "max_qty",
    )
)

eligible_fills = (
    df_rx_txn.alias("rx")
    .join(df_acct_registry.alias("acct"), F.col("acct.acct_id") == F.col("rx.acct_id"), "left_semi")
    .join(
        df_acct_registry.alias("blocked"),
        (F.col("blocked.acct_id") == F.col("rx.acct_id")) & (F.col("blocked.acct_status") == "SUSPENDED"),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .select("rx.*")
)

fill_metrics = (
    eligible_fills.alias("ef")
    .join(
        terms_scd.alias("tm"),
        (F.col("tm.acct_id") == F.col("ef.acct_id"))
        & (F.col("tm.drug_id") == F.col("ef.drug_id"))
        & (F.col("tm.valid_from") <= F.col("ef.fill_ts"))
        & (F.col("ef.fill_ts") < F.col("tm.valid_to")),
    )
    .select(
        "ef.*",
        "tm.copay",
        "tm.max_qty",
        F.transform("ef.day_marks", lambda x, i: x + i).alias("indexed_marks"),
        F.aggregate(
            F.filter("ef.day_marks", lambda x: x > 0),
            F.lit(0),
            lambda acc, x: acc + x,
            lambda acc: acc,
        ).alias("positive_day_total"),
        F.exists("ef.day_marks", lambda x: x < 0).alias("has_negative"),
        F.forall("ef.day_marks", lambda x: x <= 90).alias("marks_within_limit"),

    .agg(F.lit(1).cast("bigint").alias("grp_id"), *metric_aggs)

grand_totals = (

)
result = (
    detail_totals.unionByName(acct_totals).unionByName(grand_totals)
    .orderBy(F.col("grp_id").desc(), F.col("acct_id").asc_nulls_last(), F.col("drug_id").asc_nulls_last())
```

```sql
    v.member_id,

    MAP_FILTER(v.gallery_minutes, (gallery, minutes) -> minutes >= 30) AS focused_minutes
  FROM museum_visits v
  WHERE v.visit_day BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28'
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    n.*,
    -- Later audio chapters receive a larger positional weight.
    TRANSFORM(n.audio_scores, (score, idx) -> score * (idx + 1)) AS weighted_scores,
    ELEMENT_AT(n.capped_minutes, 'ancient_art') AS ancient_art_minutes,
    SIZE(MAP_KEYS(n.focused_minutes)) AS focused_gallery_count
  FROM normalized n
),
visit_metrics AS (

    s.*,

      FILTER(s.weighted_scores, score -> score >= 6),
      CAST(0 AS DOUBLE),
      (acc, score) -> acc + score,
      total -> ROUND(total / 10.0, 2)
    ) AS audio_score,
    EXISTS(s.weighted_scores, score -> score >= 24) AS deep_listening,
    FORALL(s.audio_scores, score -> score BETWEEN 0 AND 10) AS valid_audio
  FROM scored s
)
SELECT

  m.member_name,
  m.tier,

  BOOL_AND(x.valid_audio) AS all_audio_valid,
  -- The visit id tie-breaker makes the maximum deterministic.
  MAX_BY(x.visit_id, STRUCT(x.audio_score, x.visit_id)) AS top_audio_visit_id,
  MIN_BY(x.visit_id, x.visit_day) AS first_visit_id,
  SUM(x.focused_gallery_count) AS focused_gallery_total,
  ROUND(AVG(x.ancient_art_minutes), 1) AS avg_ancient_art_minutes
FROM membership_roster m

WHERE m.active AND m.tier IN ('patron', 'supporter')
```

```python
    )
)

w_claim_type_adjuster_id = Window.partitionBy("claim_type", "adjuster_id")
with_windows = (
    combined_details_policy
    .select(

        F.max("approved_amount").over(w_claim_type_adjuster_id).alias("claim_type_adjuster_id_max_approved_amount"),
        F.round(F.avg("approved_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("claimed_amount_per_approved_amount").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("approved_amount_avg_4"),
        F.max("approved_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("status")).alias("status_max_approved_amount"),
```

```sql
           CAST(CEIL(c.duration_sec / 60.0) AS INT) AS billable_minutes,
           CAST(greatest(CEIL(c.duration_sec / 60.0) - p.included_minutes, 0) AS INT) AS overage_minutes,
           -- Preserve the commercial ordering of each plan's add-ons.
           transform(p.add_ons, (x, i) -> named_struct(
               'addon_slot', i + 1,
               'addon_code', x.feature_code,
               'addon_price', x.monthly_price
           )) AS indexed_add_ons,
           aggregate(c.quality_samples, 0, (acc, x) -> acc + x,
                     acc -> round(acc / size(c.quality_samples), 2)) AS avg_quality,
           size(filter(c.quality_samples, x -> x >= 70)) AS good_sample_count,
           exists(c.quality_samples, x -> x < 50) AS has_severe_drop,
           forall(c.quality_samples, x -> x >= 40) AS all_samples_healthy
    FROM stg_call_records c
    JOIN dim_rate_plans p ON p.plan_code = c.plan_code
),
addon_rows AS (
    SELECT s.call_id, s.subscriber_id, s.plan_code, s.plan_name,
           s.billable_minutes, s.overage_minutes, s.avg_quality,
           s.good_sample_count, s.has_severe_drop, s.all_samples_healthy,
           a.addon.addon_slot, a.addon.addon_code, a.addon.addon_price
    FROM call_features s
    LATERAL VIEW explode_outer(s.indexed_add_ons) a AS addon
)
SELECT a.call_id, a.subscriber_id, a.plan_code, a.plan_name,
       a.addon_slot, a.addon_code, a.addon_price,
       a.billable_minutes, a.overage_minutes, a.avg_quality,
       a.good_sample_count, a.has_severe_drop, a.all_samples_healthy,
       -- P_PLUS has a NULL restriction, making nonmatches UNKNOWN here.
       CASE WHEN a.addon_code NOT IN (
           SELECT r.blocked_feature
           FROM stg_plan_restrictions r
           WHERE r.plan_code = a.plan_code
       ) THEN 'allowed' ELSE 'blocked_or_unknown' END AS not_in_decision,
       CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM stg_plan_restrictions r
           WHERE r.plan_code = a.plan_code
             AND r.blocked_feature = a.addon_code
       ) THEN 'allowed' ELSE 'blocked' END AS not_exists_decision
FROM addon_rows a
ORDER BY a.call_id, a.addon_slot NULLS LAST, a.addon_code NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

call_features = (
    df_stg_call_records.alias("c")
    .join(df_dim_rate_plans.alias("p"), F.col("c.plan_code") == F.col("p.plan_code"))
    .select(
        F.col("c.call_id"),
        F.col("c.subscriber_id"),
        F.col("c.plan_code"),
        F.col("p.plan_name"),
        F.ceil(F.col("c.duration_sec").cast("double") / 60).cast("int").alias("billable_minutes"),
        F.greatest(
            F.ceil(F.col("c.duration_sec").cast("double") / 60) - F.col("p.included_minutes"),
            F.lit(0),
        ).cast("int").alias("overage_minutes"),
        F.transform(
            F.col("p.add_ons"),
            lambda x, i: F.struct(
                (i + 1).alias("addon_slot"),
                x["feature_code"].alias("addon_code"),
                x["monthly_price"].alias("addon_price"),
            ),
        ).alias("indexed_add_ons"),
        F.aggregate(
            F.col("c.quality_samples"),
            F.lit(0),
            lambda acc, x: acc + x,
            lambda acc: F.round(acc / F.size(F.col("c.quality_samples")), 2),
        ).alias("avg_quality"),
        F.size(F.filter(F.col("c.quality_samples"), lambda x: x >= 70)).alias("good_sample_count"),
        F.exists(F.col("c.quality_samples"), lambda x: x < 50).alias("has_severe_drop"),
        F.forall(F.col("c.quality_samples"), lambda x: x >= 40).alias("all_samples_healthy"),
    )
)

addon_rows = (
    call_features
    .select("*", F.explode_outer(F.col("indexed_add_ons")).alias("addon"))
    .select(
        "call_id", "subscriber_id", "plan_code", "plan_name",
        "billable_minutes", "overage_minutes", "avg_quality",
        "good_sample_count", "has_severe_drop", "all_samples_healthy",
        F.col("addon.addon_slot").alias("addon_slot"),
        F.col("addon.addon_code").alias("addon_code"),
        F.col("addon.addon_price").alias("addon_price"),
    )
)

restriction_lists = (
    df_stg_plan_restrictions
    .groupBy("plan_code")
    .agg(
        F.collect_list("blocked_feature").alias("blocked_features"),
        (F.count(F.lit(1)) > F.count("blocked_feature")).alias("has_null_restriction"),
    )
)

matched = F.coalesce(
    F.exists(F.col("blocked_features"), lambda x: x == F.col("addon_code")),
    F.lit(False),
)
has_null_restriction = F.coalesce(F.col("has_null_restriction"), F.lit(False))
not_in_allowed = (
    F.when(matched, F.lit(False))
    .when(has_null_restriction, F.lit(None).cast("boolean"))
    .otherwise(F.lit(True))
)
not_exists_allowed = ~matched

result = (
    addon_rows.alias("a")
    .join(restriction_lists.alias("r"), F.col("a.plan_code") == F.col("r.plan_code"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("a.call_id"), F.col("a.subscriber_id"), F.col("a.plan_code"), F.col("a.plan_name"),
        F.col("a.addon_slot"), F.col("a.addon_code"), F.col("a.addon_price"),
        F.col("a.billable_minutes"), F.col("a.overage_minutes"), F.col("a.avg_quality"),
        F.col("a.good_sample_count"), F.col("a.has_severe_drop"), F.col("a.all_samples_healthy"),
        F.when(not_in_allowed, F.lit("allowed")).otherwise(F.lit("blocked_or_unknown")).alias("not_in_decision"),
        F.when(not_exists_allowed, F.lit("allowed")).otherwise(F.lit("blocked")).alias("not_exists_decision"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("call_id"), F.col("addon_slot").asc_nulls_last(), F.col("addon_code").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

```sql
    FROM stock_moves

        st.id AS move_id,

        st.qty AS move_qty
    FROM scoped s
    JOIN stock_moves st ON st.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
),
warehouse_id_stats AS (
    -- Median move_qty per warehouse_id
    SELECT warehouse_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(move_qty, 0.5) AS median_move_qty
    FROM detail_rows
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_move_qty,
        ROUND(s.move_qty - g.median_move_qty, 2) AS move_qty_minus_median
    FROM detail_rows s
    JOIN warehouse_id_stats g ON g.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
    WHERE s.move_qty >= g.median_move_qty
),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY operator ORDER BY median_move_qty) AS median_move_qty_dense_rank,
        MIN(median_move_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY operator ORDER BY median_move_qty, id, move_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS min_median_move_qty_so_far,
        LAG(move_qty, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY operator ORDER BY median_move_qty, id, move_id) AS prev2_move_qty,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', moved_at)) AS rows_in_moved_at_month
    FROM vs_group
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT (long to wide)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT move_id, operator, move_qty
    FROM metrics
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(move_qty) AS max_v, COUNT(move_qty) AS n
    FOR operator IN ('op_dew', 'op_bee', 'op_eve')
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped = (
    df_stock_moves
    .filter(F.col("operator").isin("op_dew", "op_chan"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "warehouse_id",
        "sku_id",
        "moved_at",
        "operator",
        "unit_price",
        F.round(F.col("unit_price") / F.nullif(F.col("qty"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("unit_price_per_qty"),
    )
)

detail_rows = (
    scoped.alias("s")
    .join(df_stock_moves.alias("st"), F.col("st.warehouse_id") == F.col("s.warehouse_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.warehouse_id",
        "s.sku_id",
        "s.moved_at",
        "s.operator",
        "s.unit_price",
        F.col("st.id").alias("move_id"),
        F.col("st.sku_id").alias("move_sku_id"),
        F.col("st.qty").alias("move_qty"),
    )
)

        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "moved_at"))).alias("rows_in_moved_at_month"),
    )
```

```sql
    SELECT *
```

```sql
    -- Previous round_ended_ts per drop_tier
    SELECT *, LAG(round_ended_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY drop_tier ORDER BY round_ended_ts, id) AS prev_round_ended_ts
    FROM scoped_player_profiles
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_round_ended_ts IS NULL OR round_ended_ts > prev_round_ended_ts + INTERVAL 2 HOURS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev

    FROM flagged

    FROM sessionized

ranked AS (

    FROM per_session
```

```sql
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_filed_at IS NULL OR filed_at > prev_filed_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY cover_kind ORDER BY filed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (

        cover_kind,
        session_id,
        MIN(filed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(filed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(filed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(filed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min

with_trends AS (
```

```sql
    FROM stores
    WHERE opened_date > TO_DATE('2023-03-09')

kept_keys AS (

    FROM filtered
    EXCEPT

reconciled AS (

    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.city = k.city

metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        sqft,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft NULLS LAST) AS sqft_cume_dist,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft_filled NULLS FIRST) AS sqft_filled_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sqft DESC) AS sqft_dense_rank
    FROM reconciled
),
metrics_stores AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        city,
        region,
        sqft_filled_rank,
        COUNT(sqft_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY region, city) AS region_count_sqft_dense_rank
    FROM metrics
    WHERE city IN ('Bangkok', 'Berlin')
),
stats AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN sqft_filled_rank >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS sqft_filled_rank_tier,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(region)) AS region_list,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(region)) AS region_list_2,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(sqft_filled_rank, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS sqft_filled_rank_quartiles
    FROM metrics_stores
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN sqft_filled_rank >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
)
SELECT
    sqft_filled_rank_tier,
    region_list,
    region_list_2
FROM stats;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_stores
    .filter((F.col("opened_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-09"))) & F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("sqft", F.lit(0)).alias("sqft_filled"),
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_region"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    filtered
    .select("id", "city")
    .subtract(
        df_stores
        .filter(F.col("region") != "Central")

    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (

    .select(

        "store_name",
        "city",
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY track_id ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged

session_summary AS (

        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized

),
derived AS (

    SELECT
        track_id,
        session_no,
        session_start,
        session_end,
        n_events,
        session_ms_played,
        n_events + duration_min AS n_events_plus_duration_min
    FROM session_summary
    WHERE track_id IS NOT NULL
)

    session_start,
    session_end,
```

```sql
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_approved_amount,
        ROUND(s.approved_amount - g.max_approved_amount, 2) AS approved_amount_minus_max

),
```

```sql
    FROM fct_hold_requests

),
hold_metrics AS (

    SELECT member_id, s.metric_name, s.metric_value

        'cancellations', cancelled_requests

)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_frescoes_v2.alias("e")
    .join(
        df_tbl_basins.alias("t"),
        (F.col("t.id") == F.col("e.sensor_code"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") >= F.col("t.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") <= F.coalesce(F.col("t.closed_at"), F.col("t.opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 2 DAYS"))),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.sensor_code",
        "e.event_at",
        "e.event_type",
        "t.priority",
        "t.agent_id",
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("e.event_at") - F.unix_timestamp("t.opened_at")) / 3600, 2).alias("gyroscope_score"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("event_type"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("event_type_or_unknown"),
    )

with_windows = (

    .select(

        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "gyroscope_score",
        "event_type_or_unknown",

    )
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .crossJoin(with_windows.agg(F.max("first_hours_since_open").alias("overall_max_first_hours_since_open")))
    .filter(F.col("first_hours_since_open") < F.col("overall_max_first_hours_since_open"))
    .drop("overall_max_first_hours_since_open")
)

result = (
    filtered
    .groupBy("event_type")
    .pivot("event_type_or_unknown", ["assigned", "UNKNOWN"])
    .agg(F.avg("gyroscope_score"))
```

```sql
    -- one row per check-in, plus rolling 7-day visit count
    SELECT ci.checkin_id,
           ci.member_id,
           ci.checkin_at,
           ci.duration_min,
           WIDTH_BUCKET(ci.duration_min, 0, 100, 5) AS dur_bucket,
           COUNT(*) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ci.member_id
               ORDER BY ci.checkin_at
               RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '7' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS visits_last_7d
    FROM checkins ci
),
daily AS (
    -- distinct visit days per member
    SELECT DISTINCT member_id, CAST(checkin_at AS DATE) AS visit_day
    FROM checkins
),
islands AS (
    -- consecutive days share DATE_SUB(day, rn)
    SELECT member_id,
           visit_day,
           DATE_SUB(visit_day, CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY visit_day) AS INT)) AS island_key
    FROM daily
),
best_streak AS (
    SELECT member_id, MAX(streak_len) AS best_streak
    FROM (
        SELECT member_id, island_key, COUNT(*) AS streak_len
        FROM islands
        GROUP BY member_id, island_key
    ) s
    GROUP BY member_id
),
member_stats AS (
    SELECT e.member_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_checkins,

           ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1e0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 4) AS share_of_checkins,
           TRANSFORM(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(e.duration_min)), (x, i) -> x + i) AS adj_durations,
           AGGREGATE(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(e.duration_min)), 0, (acc, x) -> acc + COALESCE(x, 0), acc -> acc * 2) AS double_total,
           EXISTS(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(e.duration_min)), x -> x >= 60) AS had_long_visit,
           FORALL(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(e.duration_min)), x -> x IS NULL OR x < 120) AS all_under_2h
    FROM enriched e
    GROUP BY e.member_id
)
```

```python
w_day = Window.partitionBy("member_id").orderBy("visit_day")
w_all = Window.rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)

enriched = (
    df_checkins.alias("ci")
    .select(
        "ci.checkin_id",
        "ci.member_id",
        "ci.checkin_at",
        "ci.duration_min",
        F.width_bucket(F.col("ci.duration_min"), F.lit(0), F.lit(100), F.lit(5)).alias("dur_bucket"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_roll).alias("visits_last_7d"),
    )
)

daily = (
    df_checkins
    .select("member_id", F.col("checkin_at").cast("date").alias("visit_day"))
    .distinct()
)

islands = (
    daily
    .select(
        "member_id",
        "visit_day",
        F.date_sub(F.col("visit_day"), F.row_number().over(w_day).cast("int")).alias("island_key"),
    )
)

best_streak = (
    islands
    .groupBy("member_id", "island_key")
    .agg(F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("streak_len"))
    .groupBy("member_id")
    .agg(F.max("streak_len").alias("best_streak"))
)

member_stats_base = (
    enriched.alias("e")
    .groupBy("e.member_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("total_checkins"),
        F.max("e.visits_last_7d").alias("peak_weekly_load"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("e.dur_bucket") >= 4, F.lit(1)).otherwise(F.lit(0))).alias("long_visits"),
        F.transform(F.sort_array(F.collect_list("e.duration_min")), lambda x, i: x + i).alias("adj_durations"),
        F.aggregate(
            F.sort_array(F.collect_list("e.duration_min")),
            F.lit(0),
            lambda acc, x: acc + F.coalesce(x, F.lit(0)),
            lambda acc: acc * 2,
        ).alias("double_total"),
        F.exists(F.sort_array(F.collect_list("e.duration_min")), lambda x: x >= F.lit(60)).alias("had_long_visit"),
        F.forall(F.sort_array(F.collect_list("e.duration_min")), lambda x: x.isNull() | (x < F.lit(120))).alias("all_under_2h"),
    )
)

member_stats = (
    member_stats_base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("total_checkins") * F.lit(1.0) / F.sum("total_checkins").over(w_all), 4).alias("share_of_checkins"),
    )
)

dur_ge45 = (
    df_checkins.alias("ci")
    .filter(F.col("ci.duration_min") >= 45)
    .select(F.col("ci.branch"))
    .distinct()
)

matched = (
    df_gym_members
    .join(dur_ge45, df_gym_members["home_branch"] == dur_ge45["branch"], "left_semi")
    .select("member_id", F.lit(1).alias("is_matched"))
)

sub_flags = (
    dur_ge45
    .agg(F.coalesce(F.max(F.when(F.col("branch").isNull(), F.lit(1))), F.lit(0)).alias("has_null"))
)

result = (
    df_gym_members.alias("m")
    .join(member_stats.alias("ms"), "member_id", "left")
    .join(best_streak.alias("bs"), "member_id", "left")
    .join(matched.alias("mt"), "member_id", "left")
    .crossJoin(sub_flags)
    .select(
        "member_id",
        "member_name",
        "home_branch",
        "total_checkins",
        "peak_weekly_load",
        "long_visits",
        "share_of_checkins",
        "best_streak",
        "adj_durations",
        "double_total",
        "had_long_visit",
        "all_under_2h",
        # Spark rewrites NOT IN as a null-aware anti join: with NULLs on the
        # build side (or a NULL probe key) the row never survives -> FALSE
        F.when(F.col("is_matched").isNotNull(), F.lit(False))
         .when(F.col("home_branch").isNull(), F.lit(False))
         .when(F.col("has_null") == 1, F.lit(False))
         .otherwise(F.lit(True)).alias("excluded_by_not_in"),
        F.col("is_matched").isNull().alias("excluded_by_not_exists"),
    )
    .orderBy("member_id")
)
```

```sql
  Refill review: normalize dose arrays, then apply the copay rule
  effective at fill time. Repeated snapshots collapse into SCD2 spans.
*/
WITH rule_flags AS (
    SELECT ndc, valid_from, copay,
           lag(copay) OVER (PARTITION BY ndc ORDER BY valid_from) AS prior_copay
    FROM formulary_snap
),
rule_scd AS (
    SELECT ndc, valid_from,
           lead(valid_from, 1, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 00:00:00')
             OVER (PARTITION BY ndc ORDER BY valid_from) AS valid_to,
           copay
    FROM rule_flags
    -- Null-safe comparison also retains transitions to and from NULL.
    WHERE prior_copay IS NULL OR copay IS DISTINCT FROM prior_copay
),
fill_weighted AS (
    SELECT txn_id, patient_id, ndc, filled_at, qty, dose_mg,
           transform(dose_mg, (x, i) -> x * (i + 1)) weighted_mg
    FROM refill_txn
),
fill_stats AS (
    SELECT txn_id, patient_id, ndc, filled_at, qty,
           aggregate(filter(weighted_mg, x -> x >= 40), 0,
                     (acc, x) -> acc + x,
                     acc -> cast(acc AS DOUBLE) / 10) AS adjusted_load,
           exists(dose_mg, x -> x >= 100) AS high_dose,
           forall(dose_mg, x -> x > 0) AS all_positive
    FROM fill_weighted
)
SELECT f.txn_id, f.patient_id, f.ndc, f.qty,
       r.valid_from AS rule_from, r.copay,
       f.adjusted_load, f.high_dose, f.all_positive,
       ntile(3) OVER (ORDER BY adjusted_load DESC NULLS LAST, txn_id) load_bucket,
       percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY f.ndc ORDER BY adjusted_load, txn_id) ndc_pct_rank,
       cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY qty DESC, txn_id) qty_cume,
       dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY filled_at, txn_id) refill_rnk
FROM fill_stats f
-- Half-open interval: a new rule owns its exact start timestamp.
JOIN rule_scd r ON r.ndc = f.ndc
               AND r.valid_from <= f.filled_at
               AND f.filled_at < r.valid_to
ORDER BY txn_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ndc = Window.partitionBy("ndc").orderBy("valid_from")
rule_flags = (
    df_formulary_snap
    .withColumn("prior_copay", F.lag("copay").over(w_ndc))
)
rule_scd = (
    rule_flags
    .filter(F.col("prior_copay").isNull() | (~F.col("copay").eqNullSafe(F.col("prior_copay"))))
    .select(
        "ndc",
        "valid_from",
        F.lead("valid_from", 1, "9999-12-31 00:00:00").over(w_ndc).alias("valid_to"),
        "copay",
    )
)
fill_weighted = (
    df_refill_txn
    .select(
        "txn_id", "patient_id", "ndc", "filled_at", "qty", "dose_mg",
        F.transform("dose_mg", lambda x, i: x * (i + 1)).alias("weighted_mg"),
    )
)
fill_stats = (
    fill_weighted
    .select(
        "txn_id", "patient_id", "ndc", "filled_at", "qty",
        F.aggregate(
            F.filter("weighted_mg", lambda x: x >= 40),
            F.lit(0),
            lambda acc, x: acc + x,
            lambda acc: acc.cast("double") / 10,
        ).alias("adjusted_load"),
        F.exists("dose_mg", lambda x: x >= 100).alias("high_dose"),
        F.forall("dose_mg", lambda x: x > 0).alias("all_positive"),
    )
)
joined = (
    fill_stats.alias("f")
    .join(
        rule_scd.alias("r"),
        (F.col("r.ndc") == F.col("f.ndc"))
        & (F.col("r.valid_from") <= F.col("f.filled_at"))
        & (F.col("f.filled_at") < F.col("r.valid_to")),
    )
)
w_bucket = Window.orderBy(F.col("adjusted_load").desc_nulls_last(), "txn_id")
w_pct = Window.partitionBy(F.col("f.ndc")).orderBy(F.col("adjusted_load").asc_nulls_first(), "txn_id")
w_cume = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty").desc(), "txn_id")
w_refill = Window.partitionBy("patient_id").orderBy("filled_at", "txn_id")
result = (
    joined
    .select(
        F.col("f.txn_id").alias("txn_id"),
        F.col("f.patient_id").alias("patient_id"),
        F.col("f.ndc").alias("ndc"),
        F.col("f.qty").alias("qty"),
        F.col("r.valid_from").alias("rule_from"),
        F.col("r.copay").alias("copay"),
        "adjusted_load", "high_dose", "all_positive",
        F.ntile(3).over(w_bucket).alias("load_bucket"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_pct).alias("ndc_pct_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_cume).alias("qty_cume"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_refill).alias("refill_rnk"),
    )
    .orderBy("txn_id")
)
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("s.greatest_progress_percent_crew_size") > F.col("g.avg_greatest_progress_percent_crew_size"))
    .select(

        "g.avg_greatest_progress_percent_crew_size",

    )
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
        a.student_id,
        a.enrolled_at,

        SUM(b.score) AS prior_score_7d
    FROM cyclones a
    LEFT JOIN cyclones b
      ON b.student_id = a.student_id
     AND b.enrolled_at < a.enrolled_at
     AND b.enrolled_at >= a.enrolled_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.student_id, a.enrolled_at
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach student attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.student_id,
        s.prior_score_7d,
        st.is_international AS student_is_international,
        st.gpa AS student_gpa
    FROM covered s
    JOIN maple_casks st ON st.id = s.student_id
    WHERE st.gpa < 3.3
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY student_is_international ORDER BY student_gpa DESC, id), 3) AS indigo_scroll,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY student_is_international ORDER BY student_gpa DESC) AS summit_ref
    FROM enriched
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(prior_score_7d - AVG(prior_score_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id, student_is_international), 2) AS prior_score_7d_vs_student_id_student_is_internat,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY student_is_international, summit_ref ORDER BY indigo_scroll, id) AS student_gpa_cume_dist_decile
    FROM with_windows
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    student_id,
    student_is_international,
    GROUPING(student_id) AS is_total_student_id,
    MIN(prior_score_7d) AS min_prior_score_7d,
    SUM(student_gpa_cume_dist_decile) FILTER (WHERE student_is_international = FALSE) AS student_gpa_cume_dist_decile_student_is_internat,
    ROUND(AVG(indigo_scroll), 2) AS avg_student_gpa_cume_dist
FROM sequenced
GROUP BY CUBE(student_id, student_is_international)
ORDER BY student_id NULLS LAST, student_is_international NULLS LAST
```

```python
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") >= F.col("a.enrolled_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.student_id", "a.enrolled_at")
```

```sql
    select min(commissioned_on) as first_day, max(commissioned_on) as last_day
    from power_plant_turbines_log
),
spine as (
    select explode(sequence(first_day, last_day, interval 1 day)) as cal_day
    from bounds
),
daily as (
    select commissioned_on as cal_day, sum(voltage_kv) as voltage_kv_total
    from power_plant_turbines_log
    where commissioned_on is not null
    group by commissioned_on
)
select s.cal_day,
       d.voltage_kv_total,
       last(d.voltage_kv_total, true) over (order by s.cal_day rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as voltage_kv_filled

order by s.cal_day
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

bounds = df_power_plant_turbines_log.agg(
    F.min("commissioned_on").alias("first_day"),
    F.max("commissioned_on").alias("last_day"),
)

spine = bounds.select(
    F.explode(F.sequence("first_day", "last_day", F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAY"))).alias("cal_day")
)

daily = (
    df_power_plant_turbines_log
    .filter(F.col("commissioned_on").isNotNull())
    .groupBy(F.col("commissioned_on").alias("cal_day"))
    .agg(F.sum("voltage_kv").alias("voltage_kv_total"))
)

w_fill = Window.orderBy(F.col("s.cal_day")).rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
result = (
    spine.alias("s")
    .join(daily.alias("d"), F.col("d.cal_day") == F.col("s.cal_day"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("s.cal_day").alias("cal_day"),
        F.col("d.voltage_kv_total"),
        F.last(F.col("d.voltage_kv_total"), ignorenulls=True).over(w_fill).alias("voltage_kv_filled"),
    )
    .orderBy("cal_day")
)
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.agilent_count, 0) AS agilent_count,
    b.agilent_total_well_count,
    COALESCE(a.thermo_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.agilent_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM thermo_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN agilent_monthly b
  ON a.run_started_at_month = b.run_started_at_month
ORDER BY run_started_at_month
```

```sql
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter chalets
    SELECT
        id,
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        closed_at,
        priority,
        channel
    FROM chalets
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous closed_at per agent_id
    SELECT *, LAG(closed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id ORDER BY closed_at, id) AS quill_flag
    FROM cleaned
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN quill_flag IS NULL OR closed_at > quill_flag + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id ORDER BY closed_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        agent_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(closed_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(closed_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(requester_id) AS session_requester_id,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(closed_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(closed_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY agent_id, session_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    agent_id,
    session_id,
    session_end,
    events,
    session_requester_id,
    duration_min
FROM session_summary
ORDER BY session_end DESC, duration_min DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_chalets
    .select(
        "id",
        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
    )
)

with_prev = cleaned.withColumn("quill_flag", F.lag("closed_at").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id").orderBy("closed_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("quill_flag").isNull() | (F.col("closed_at") > F.col("quill_flag") + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id").orderBy("closed_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

session_summary = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("agent_id", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("closed_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("closed_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.sum("requester_id").alias("session_requester_id"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("closed_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("closed_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    session_summary
    .select(
        "agent_id",
        "session_id",
        "session_end",
        "events",
        "session_requester_id",
        "duration_min",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("session_end").desc(), F.col("duration_min").desc())
```

```python
    .select(
```

```python
        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "opened_at",
        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "csat",
        "tags",
        F.array_join(F.array_sort(F.col("tags")), ",").alias("tags_text"),
    )
)

combined_details = (
    valid.alias("s")
    .join(df_support_agents.alias("su"), F.col("su.id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.requester_id",
        "s.agent_id",
        "s.closed_at",
        "s.priority",
        "s.channel",
        "s.csat",
        "s.tags_text",
        "su.agent_name",
        F.col("su.team").alias("agent_team"),
        F.col("su.hired_on").alias("agent_hired_on"),
    )
)

w_agent_id_csat = Window.partitionBy("agent_id", "csat")
metrics = (
    combined_details
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("requester_id").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("closed_at"))).alias("closed_at_year_sum_requester_id"),

        F.round(F.avg("csat").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id", "csat")), 2).alias("agent_id_csat_avg_csat"),
        F.lead("csat", 3).over(Window.orderBy("closed_at", "id")).alias("next3_csat"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("csat", F.year("closed_at")).orderBy(F.col("closed_at").desc())), 3).alias("closed_at_cume_dist"),
        F.max("csat").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("closed_at"))).alias("closed_at_year_max_csat"),

        F.lag("agent_hired_on").over(Window.orderBy("closed_at", "id")).alias("prev_agent_hired_on"),

        F.nth_value("csat", 2).over(Window.orderBy("closed_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_csat"),
        F.last("requester_id").over(Window.partitionBy("csat", F.year("closed_at")).orderBy(F.col("closed_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_requester_id"),

w_csat_priority = Window.partitionBy("csat", "priority")
sequenced = (
```

```sql
        ARRAY_MIN(tier_prices) AS lowest_price,
        AGGREGATE(tier_prices, CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, p) -> acc + p, acc -> ROUND(acc / SIZE(tier_prices), 2)) AS avg_tier_price
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE plan IN ('enterprise', 'basic', 'starter')
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    plan,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'starter' THEN 1 END) AS starter_count,
```

```python
combined_details_policy = (

    .join(df_policies.alias("p"), F.col("p.id") == F.col("s.policy_id"), "inner")
    .join(df_policyholders.alias("po"), F.col("po.id") == F.col("p.holder_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("p.holder_id") >= 10)
    .select(

        "s.claim_type",

        F.col("p.holder_id").alias("policy_holder_id"),

)

windowed = (
    combined_details_policy
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("holder_risk_score", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("policy_id").orderBy("approved_amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_holder_risk_score"),

        F.size(F.collect_set("claim_type").over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_id", "policy_id"))).alias("distinct_claim_type_in_adjuster_id_policy_id"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("policy_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("policy_premium").desc())).alias("policy_premium_rank"),
```
