```sql
/*
  Refill review: normalize dose arrays, then apply the copay rule
  effective at fill time. Repeated snapshots collapse into SCD2 spans.
*/
WITH rule_flags AS (
    SELECT ndc, valid_from, copay,
           lag(copay) OVER (PARTITION BY ndc ORDER BY valid_from) AS prior_copay
    FROM formulary_snap
),
rule_scd AS (
    SELECT ndc, valid_from,
           lead(valid_from, 1, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 00:00:00')
             OVER (PARTITION BY ndc ORDER BY valid_from) AS valid_to,
           copay
    FROM rule_flags
    -- Null-safe comparison also retains transitions to and from NULL.
    WHERE prior_copay IS NULL OR copay IS DISTINCT FROM prior_copay
),
fill_weighted AS (
    SELECT txn_id, patient_id, ndc, filled_at, qty, dose_mg,
           transform(dose_mg, (x, i) -> x * (i + 1)) weighted_mg
    FROM refill_txn
),
fill_stats AS (
    SELECT txn_id, patient_id, ndc, filled_at, qty,
           aggregate(filter(weighted_mg, x -> x >= 40), 0,
                     (acc, x) -> acc + x,
                     acc -> cast(acc AS DOUBLE) / 10) AS adjusted_load,
           exists(dose_mg, x -> x >= 100) AS high_dose,
           forall(dose_mg, x -> x > 0) AS all_positive
    FROM fill_weighted
)
SELECT f.txn_id, f.patient_id, f.ndc, f.qty,
       r.valid_from AS rule_from, r.copay,
       f.adjusted_load, f.high_dose, f.all_positive,
       ntile(3) OVER (ORDER BY adjusted_load DESC NULLS LAST, txn_id) load_bucket,
       percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY f.ndc ORDER BY adjusted_load, txn_id) ndc_pct_rank,
       cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY qty DESC, txn_id) qty_cume,
       dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY filled_at, txn_id) refill_rnk
FROM fill_stats f
-- Half-open interval: a new rule owns its exact start timestamp.
JOIN rule_scd r ON r.ndc = f.ndc
               AND r.valid_from <= f.filled_at
               AND f.filled_at < r.valid_to
ORDER BY txn_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ndc = Window.partitionBy("ndc").orderBy("valid_from")
rule_flags = (
    df_formulary_snap
    .withColumn("prior_copay", F.lag("copay").over(w_ndc))
)
rule_scd = (
    rule_flags
    .filter(F.col("prior_copay").isNull() | (~F.col("copay").eqNullSafe(F.col("prior_copay"))))
    .select(
        "ndc",
        "valid_from",
        F.lead("valid_from", 1, "9999-12-31 00:00:00").over(w_ndc).alias("valid_to"),
        "copay",
    )
)
fill_weighted = (
    df_refill_txn
    .select(
        "txn_id", "patient_id", "ndc", "filled_at", "qty", "dose_mg",
        F.transform("dose_mg", lambda x, i: x * (i + 1)).alias("weighted_mg"),
    )
)
fill_stats = (
    fill_weighted
    .select(
        "txn_id", "patient_id", "ndc", "filled_at", "qty",
        F.aggregate(
            F.filter("weighted_mg", lambda x: x >= 40),
            F.lit(0),
            lambda acc, x: acc + x,
            lambda acc: acc.cast("double") / 10,
        ).alias("adjusted_load"),
        F.exists("dose_mg", lambda x: x >= 100).alias("high_dose"),
        F.forall("dose_mg", lambda x: x > 0).alias("all_positive"),
    )
)
joined = (
    fill_stats.alias("f")
    .join(
        rule_scd.alias("r"),
        (F.col("r.ndc") == F.col("f.ndc"))
        & (F.col("r.valid_from") <= F.col("f.filled_at"))
        & (F.col("f.filled_at") < F.col("r.valid_to")),
    )
)
w_bucket = Window.orderBy(F.col("adjusted_load").desc_nulls_last(), "txn_id")
w_pct = Window.partitionBy(F.col("f.ndc")).orderBy(F.col("adjusted_load").asc_nulls_first(), "txn_id")
w_cume = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty").desc(), "txn_id")
w_refill = Window.partitionBy("patient_id").orderBy("filled_at", "txn_id")
result = (
    joined
    .select(
        F.col("f.txn_id").alias("txn_id"),
        F.col("f.patient_id").alias("patient_id"),
        F.col("f.ndc").alias("ndc"),
        F.col("f.qty").alias("qty"),
        F.col("r.valid_from").alias("rule_from"),
        F.col("r.copay").alias("copay"),
        "adjusted_load", "high_dose", "all_positive",
        F.ntile(3).over(w_bucket).alias("load_bucket"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_pct).alias("ndc_pct_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_cume).alias("qty_cume"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_refill).alias("refill_rnk"),
    )
    .orderBy("txn_id")
```
```sql
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_willow_girders
    .filter(F.col("crop_kind") == "rice")
    .select(
        "id",
        "season_tag",
        "crop_kind",
        "soil_ph",
        "germination_pct",
        "is_organic",
        F.when(F.col("season_tag").isin("dry", "cool"), "group_a").when(F.col("season_tag") == "wet", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("season_tag_group"),
    )
)

season_tag_stats = (
    base
    .groupBy("season_tag")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("soil_ph", 0.5).alias("median_soil_ph"))
)

above_average = (
    base.alias("s")
    .join(season_tag_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.season_tag") == F.col("s.season_tag"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.soil_ph") >= F.col("g.median_soil_ph"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.median_soil_ph",
        F.round(F.col("s.soil_ph") - F.col("g.median_soil_ph"), 2).alias("soil_ph_minus_median"),
    )
)

sequenced = (
    above_average
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("soil_ph_minus_median", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("median_soil_ph", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_soil_ph_minus_median"),
        F.max("soil_ph_minus_median").over(Window.partitionBy("season_tag")).alias("season_tag_max_soil_ph_minus_median"),

        F.lag("germination_pct", 1, 0).over(Window.orderBy("median_soil_ph", "id")).alias("prev_germination_pct"),
    )
)

result = (
    sequenced
    .groupBy("season_tag")
    .pivot("season_tag_group", ["other", "group_b"])
    .agg(F.count("soil_ph_minus_median"))
    .orderBy("season_tag")
```

```sql
WITH policy_scd AS (
    -- Discard no-op snapshots, retaining initial and changed bands.
    SELECT app_id, valid_from,
           LEAD(valid_from, 1, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 00:00:00')
             OVER (PARTITION BY app_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS valid_to,
           review_band
    FROM (
        SELECT v.*, LAG(review_band) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_band
        FROM app_review_policies v
    ) v
    WHERE prev_band IS DISTINCT FROM review_band
),
daily AS (
    SELECT app_id, metric_date,
           COALESCE(LAST(download_cnt, TRUE) OVER (
             PARTITION BY app_id ORDER BY metric_date
             ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS dl_cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT s.app_id, s.metric_date, m.download_cnt
        FROM (
            SELECT app_id,
                   EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(MIN(metric_date), MAX(metric_date), INTERVAL '1' DAY)) AS metric_date
            FROM app_daily_metrics
            GROUP BY app_id
        ) s
        LEFT JOIN app_daily_metrics m
          ON m.app_id = s.app_id AND m.metric_date = s.metric_date
    ) j
),
streaks AS (
    -- Consecutive active days share the same date/row-number island key.
    SELECT app_id, MIN(metric_date) AS streak_start, MAX(metric_date) AS streak_end,
           COUNT(*) AS active_days, SUM(dl_cnt) AS streak_downloads
    FROM (
        SELECT app_id, metric_date, dl_cnt,
               DATE_SUB(metric_date, CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                 PARTITION BY app_id ORDER BY metric_date) AS INT)) AS island_key
        FROM daily
        WHERE dl_cnt >= 100
    ) a
    GROUP BY app_id, island_key
),
rated AS (
    SELECT f.*, p.review_band
    FROM (
        SELECT m.app_id, m.metric_date, rating_evt.event_ts AS rating_at,
               rating_evt.stars, rating_evt.country
        FROM app_daily_metrics m
        LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(m.rating_events) rv AS rating_pos, rating_evt
    ) f
    JOIN policy_scd p
      ON p.app_id = f.app_id
     AND p.valid_from <= f.rating_at
     AND f.rating_at < p.valid_to
)
SELECT s.app_id, s.streak_start, s.streak_end, s.active_days, s.streak_downloads,
       COUNT(r.stars) AS rating_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.stars <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_rating_cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(r.stars), 2) AS avg_rating,
       MAX(CASE WHEN r.review_band = 'strict' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS strict_hit
FROM streaks s
LEFT JOIN rated r
  ON r.app_id = s.app_id AND r.metric_date BETWEEN s.streak_start AND s.streak_end
GROUP BY s.app_id, s.streak_start, s.streak_end, s.active_days, s.streak_downloads
ORDER BY s.app_id, s.streak_start
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_policy = Window.partitionBy("app_id").orderBy("valid_from")
policy_scd = (
    df_app_review_policies
    .withColumn("prev_band", F.lag("review_band").over(w_policy))
    .filter(~F.col("prev_band").eqNullSafe(F.col("review_band")))
    .select(
        "app_id", "valid_from",
        F.lead("valid_from", 1, "9999-12-31 00:00:00").over(w_policy).alias("valid_to"),
        "review_band",
    )
)

spine = (
    df_app_daily_metrics
    .groupBy("app_id")
    .agg(F.min("metric_date").alias("min_dt"), F.max("metric_date").alias("max_dt"))
    .select("app_id", F.explode(F.sequence("min_dt", "max_dt", F.expr("INTERVAL '1' DAY"))).alias("metric_date"))
)
joined = (
    spine.alias("s")
    .join(df_app_daily_metrics.alias("m"), (F.col("s.app_id") == F.col("m.app_id")) & (F.col("s.metric_date") == F.col("m.metric_date")), "left")
    .select("s.app_id", "s.metric_date", "m.download_cnt")
)
w_daily = Window.partitionBy("app_id").orderBy("metric_date").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
daily = joined.select("app_id", "metric_date", F.coalesce(F.last("download_cnt", ignorenulls=True).over(w_daily), F.lit(0)).alias("dl_cnt"))

w_active = Window.partitionBy("app_id").orderBy("metric_date")
streaks = (
    daily
    .filter(F.col("dl_cnt") >= 100)
    .withColumn("island_key", F.date_sub("metric_date", F.row_number().over(w_active).cast("int")))
    .groupBy("app_id", "island_key")
    .agg(
        F.min("metric_date").alias("streak_start"),
        F.max("metric_date").alias("streak_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("active_days"),
        F.sum("dl_cnt").alias("streak_downloads"),
    )
)

rated = (
    df_app_daily_metrics.alias("m")
    .select("m.app_id", "m.metric_date", F.posexplode("m.rating_events").alias("rating_pos", "rating_evt"))
    .select("app_id", "metric_date", F.col("rating_evt.event_ts").alias("rating_at"), "rating_evt.stars", "rating_evt.country")
    .alias("r")
    .join(policy_scd.alias("p"), (F.col("p.app_id") == F.col("r.app_id")) & (F.col("p.valid_from") <= F.col("r.rating_at")) & (F.col("r.rating_at") < F.col("p.valid_to")))
    .select("r.*", "p.review_band")

result = (

    .groupBy("s.app_id", "s.streak_start", "s.streak_end", "s.active_days", "s.streak_downloads")
    .agg(
```

```sql
        MIN(approved_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id) AS policy_id_min_approved_amount
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_all_by_reported_at AS (ORDER BY reported_at DESC NULLS FIRST, id)
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per adjuster_id, status
    SELECT
        id,
        policy_id,
        adjuster_id,
        claim_date,
        claim_type,
        claimed_amount,
        approved_amount,
        status,
        reported_at,
        reported_at_quartile,
        policy_id_max_approved_amount,
        prev3_claim_date,
        policy_id_min_approved_amount
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,

line_level_claims AS (
```

```sql
with test_rollup as (

    from ci_test_batches tb

    group by tb.txn_id

run_window as (
    select pr.acct_id,
           pr.txn_id,
           pr.pipeline_id,
           pr.started_at,
           pr.run_status,
           tr.suite_qty,
           tr.failed_qty,
           tr.total_duration_ms,
           count(*) over (
               partition by pr.pipeline_id
               order by pr.started_at
               range between interval '3' hour preceding and current row
           ) as runs_in_3h
    from ci_pipeline_runs pr
    join test_rollup tr on tr.txn_id = pr.txn_id
    -- the pair prevents a txn from matching another pipeline
    where (pr.pipeline_id, pr.txn_id) in (
        select pipeline_id, txn_id
        from ci_run_allowlist
        where approved
    )
)
select acct_id,

       pipeline_id,
       started_at,
       runs_in_3h,
       suite_qty,
       failed_qty,
       total_duration_ms,
       case
           when failed_qty > 0 then 'attention'
           when run_status = 'succeeded' and suite_qty > 0 then 'healthy'
           when run_status = 'succeeded' then 'untested'
           else 'review'
       end as health_label
from run_window
order by pipeline_id, started_at, txn_id
```

```python
        F.coalesce(F.sum("duration_ms"), F.lit(0)).alias("total_duration_ms"),
```

```sql
           COUNT_IF(late_flag = 1) AS late_qty,
           BOOL_OR(renew_qty > 1) AS multi_renew_flag,

    FROM loan_base

           PARTITION BY l.member_id ORDER BY l.loan_date
           RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '14' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

LEFT SEMI JOIN hold_members h ON h.member_id = l.member_id
LEFT ANTI JOIN member_acct a
```

```sql
                   WHEN a.amount > b.amount THEN -1
                   WHEN a.amount < b.amount THEN 1
                   WHEN a.offer_id < b.offer_id THEN -1
                   WHEN a.offer_id > b.offer_id THEN 1
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_day = Window.partitionBy("listing_id").orderBy("snapshot_date")
active_days = (
    df_stg_listing_days
    .filter(F.col("status") == "active")
    .select(
        "listing_id",
        "snapshot_date",
        "asking_price",
        F.array_position(F.col("tags"), "garden").alias("garden_position"),
        F.date_sub(F.col("snapshot_date"), F.row_number().over(w_day)).alias("island_key"),
    )
)

streaks = (
    active_days
    .groupBy("listing_id", "island_key")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("streak_days"),
        F.max("garden_position").alias("garden_position"),
    )
)

activity = (
    streaks
    .groupBy("listing_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("streak_days").alias("longest_active_streak"),
        F.max("garden_position").alias("garden_position"),
    )
)

def offer_order(a, b):
    return (
        F.when(a.amount > b.amount, -1)
        .when(a.amount < b.amount, 1)
        .when(a.offer_id < b.offer_id, -1)
        .when(a.offer_id > b.offer_id, 1)
        .otherwise(0)
    )

offer_rollup = (
    df_stg_offers
    .groupBy("listing_id")
    .agg(
        F.array_sort(
            F.collect_list(F.struct("offer_id", "amount", "submitted_on", "terms")),
            offer_order,
        ).alias("sorted_offers")
    )
)

blocked = df_fct_agent_flags.filter(F.col("review_state") == "blocked")
blocked_nonnull = blocked.filter(F.col("agent_id").isNotNull()).select("agent_id").dropDuplicates()
blocked_stats = blocked.agg(F.sum(F.when(F.col("agent_id").isNull(), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("null_agent_rows"))
passes_not_in = (
    F.when(F.col("bf.agent_id").isNotNull(), F.lit(False))
    .when(F.col("bs.null_agent_rows") > 0, F.lit(False))
    .when(F.col("l.agent_id").isNull(), F.lit(None).cast("boolean"))
    .otherwise(F.lit(True))
)
screened = (
    df_dim_listings.alias("l")
    .join(df_stg_offers.alias("o"), F.col("o.listing_id") == F.col("l.listing_id"), "left_semi")
    .join(
        df_stg_listing_days.alias("d"),
        (F.col("d.listing_id") == F.col("l.listing_id")) & (F.col("d.status") == "withdrawn"),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .crossJoin(blocked_stats.alias("bs"))
    .join(blocked_nonnull.alias("bf"), F.col("bf.agent_id") == F.col("l.agent_id"), "left")
    .select("l.*", passes_not_in.alias("passes_not_in"), F.col("bf.agent_id").isNull().alias("passes_not_exists"))
)

result = (
    screened.alias("s")
    .join(activity.alias("a"), F.col("a.listing_id") == F.col("s.listing_id"))
    .join(offer_rollup.alias("r"), F.col("r.listing_id") == F.col("s.listing_id"))
    .select(
        "s.listing_id",
        "s.city",
        "a.longest_active_streak",
        "a.garden_position",
        F.element_at(F.col("r.sorted_offers"), -1).getField("offer_id").alias("lowest_offer_id"),
        F.try_element_at(F.col("r.sorted_offers"), F.lit(5)).getField("offer_id").alias("fifth_offer_id"),
        F.arrays_zip(F.slice("r.sorted_offers", 1, 2), F.slice("r.sorted_offers", 2, 2)).alias("offer_matchups"),
        "s.passes_not_in",
        "s.passes_not_exists",
    )
    .orderBy("s.listing_id")
)
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized
```

```python
    .select(
```

```python
        "r.failure_risk_score", "r.fatigue_events", "r.max_signal_count",
        "r.filtered_signal_total", "r.max_risk_score",
        "p.SUCCESS_attempts", "p.FAILURE_failures", "p.CHALLENGE_attempts",
```

```sql
WITH recent_plays AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        listener_id,
        track_id,
        played_at,
        is_skipped,
        source,
        CONCAT_WS(' / ', device, source) AS device_source_label,
        CASE WHEN source IN ('radio', 'playlist') THEN 'group_a' WHEN source = 'album' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS source_group,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(source), 1, 3) AS source_prefix
    FROM plays
    WHERE listener_id IS NOT NULL
),
annotated AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT *, DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', played_at) AS days_since_played_at
    FROM recent_plays
),
source_group_stats AS (
    -- Max days_since_played_at per source_group
    SELECT source_group, MAX(days_since_played_at) AS max_days_since_played_at
    FROM annotated
    GROUP BY source_group
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_days_since_played_at,
        ROUND(s.days_since_played_at - g.max_days_since_played_at, 2) AS days_since_played_at_minus_max
    FROM annotated s
    JOIN source_group_stats g ON g.source_group = s.source_group
    WHERE s.days_since_played_at = g.max_days_since_played_at
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(max_days_since_played_at) OVER (PARTITION BY is_skipped, track_id ORDER BY days_since_played_at_minus_max, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_max_days_since_played_at,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_all_by_played_at, 3) AS played_at_percent_rank
    FROM compared
    WINDOW w_all_by_played_at AS (ORDER BY played_at ASC, id)
)
SELECT
    source_group,
    source,
    SUM(max_days_since_played_at) AS total_max_days_since_played_at,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(source)) AS source_list
FROM with_trends
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((source_group, source), (source_group))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent_plays = (
    df_plays
    .filter(F.col("listener_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "listener_id",
        "track_id",
        "played_at",
        "is_skipped",
        "source",
        F.concat_ws(" / ", F.col("device"), F.col("source")).alias("device_source_label"),
        F.when(F.col("source").isin("radio", "playlist"), "group_a").when(F.col("source") == "album", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("source_group"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("source")), 1, 3).alias("source_prefix"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    recent_plays
    .select(
        "*",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("played_at")).alias("days_since_played_at"),
    )
)

source_group_stats = (
    annotated
    .groupBy("source_group")
    .agg(F.max("days_since_played_at").alias("max_days_since_played_at"))
)

compared = (
    annotated.alias("s")
    .join(source_group_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.source_group") == F.col("s.source_group"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.days_since_played_at") == F.col("g.max_days_since_played_at"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_days_since_played_at",
        F.round(F.col("s.days_since_played_at") - F.col("g.max_days_since_played_at"), 2).alias("days_since_played_at_minus_max"),
    )
)

w_all_by_played_at = Window.orderBy("played_at", "id")
with_trends = (
    compared
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("max_days_since_played_at").over(Window.partitionBy("is_skipped", "track_id").orderBy("days_since_played_at_minus_max", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_max_days_since_played_at"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_all_by_played_at), 3).alias("played_at_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_trends
    .groupingSets(
        [["source_group", "source"], ["source_group"]],
        "source_group", "source",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("max_days_since_played_at").alias("total_max_days_since_played_at"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("source")).alias("source_list"),
    )
)
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number

combined_details AS (
```

```sql
WITH phone_monthly AS (
    -- phone rows per played_at_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', played_at) AS played_at_month, COUNT(*) AS phone_count, SUM(ms_played) AS phone_total_ms_played
    FROM plays
    WHERE device = 'phone'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', played_at)
),
desktop_monthly AS (
    -- desktop rows per played_at_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', played_at) AS played_at_month, COUNT(*) AS desktop_count, SUM(ms_played) AS desktop_total_ms_played
    FROM plays
    WHERE device = 'desktop'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', played_at)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.played_at_month, b.played_at_month) AS played_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.phone_count, 0) AS phone_count,
    COALESCE(a.phone_total_ms_played, 0) AS phone_total_ms_played,
    COALESCE(b.desktop_count, 0) AS desktop_count,
    COALESCE(b.desktop_total_ms_played, 0) AS desktop_total_ms_played,
    COALESCE(a.phone_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.desktop_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM phone_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN desktop_monthly b
  ON a.played_at_month = b.played_at_month
ORDER BY played_at_month
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

phone_monthly = (
    df_plays
    .filter(F.col("device") == "phone")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "played_at").alias("played_at_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("phone_count"),
        F.sum("ms_played").alias("phone_total_ms_played"),
    )
)

desktop_monthly = (
    df_plays
    .filter(F.col("device") == "desktop")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "played_at").alias("played_at_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("desktop_count"),
        F.sum("ms_played").alias("desktop_total_ms_played"),
    )
)

result = (
    phone_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(desktop_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.played_at_month") == F.col("b.played_at_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.played_at_month"), F.col("b.played_at_month")).alias("played_at_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.phone_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("phone_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.phone_total_ms_played"), F.lit(0)).alias("phone_total_ms_played"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.desktop_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("desktop_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.desktop_total_ms_played"), F.lit(0)).alias("desktop_total_ms_played"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.phone_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.desktop_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("net_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("played_at_month")
)
```

```sql
WITH call_features AS (
    SELECT c.call_id, c.subscriber_id, c.plan_code, p.plan_name,
           CAST(CEIL(c.duration_sec / 60.0) AS INT) AS billable_minutes,
           CAST(greatest(CEIL(c.duration_sec / 60.0) - p.included_minutes, 0) AS INT) AS overage_minutes,
           -- Preserve the commercial ordering of each plan's add-ons.
           transform(p.add_ons, (x, i) -> named_struct(
               'addon_slot', i + 1,
               'addon_code', x.feature_code,
               'addon_price', x.monthly_price
           )) AS indexed_add_ons,
           aggregate(c.quality_samples, 0, (acc, x) -> acc + x,
                     acc -> round(acc / size(c.quality_samples), 2)) AS avg_quality,
           size(filter(c.quality_samples, x -> x >= 70)) AS good_sample_count,
           exists(c.quality_samples, x -> x < 50) AS has_severe_drop,
           forall(c.quality_samples, x -> x >= 40) AS all_samples_healthy
    FROM stg_call_records c
    JOIN dim_rate_plans p ON p.plan_code = c.plan_code
),
addon_rows AS (
    SELECT s.call_id, s.subscriber_id, s.plan_code, s.plan_name,

           s.good_sample_count, s.has_severe_drop, s.all_samples_healthy,
           a.addon.addon_slot, a.addon.addon_code, a.addon.addon_price
    FROM call_features s
    LATERAL VIEW explode_outer(s.indexed_add_ons) a AS addon
)
SELECT a.call_id, a.subscriber_id, a.plan_code, a.plan_name,
       a.addon_slot, a.addon_code, a.addon_price,

           FROM stg_plan_restrictions r
           WHERE r.plan_code = a.plan_code

       CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM stg_plan_restrictions r
           WHERE r.plan_code = a.plan_code
```

```python
    df_ticket_events
    .filter(F.col("actor") == "system")
    .select(

        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
```

```sql
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', played_at) AS played_at_month, COUNT(*) AS phone_count, ROUND(AVG(ms_played), 2) AS phone_avg_ms_played
    FROM plays

    FROM plays

)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.played_at_month, b.played_at_month) AS played_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.phone_count, 0) AS phone_count,
    COALESCE(a.phone_avg_ms_played, 0) AS phone_avg_ms_played,
    COALESCE(b.speaker_count, 0) AS speaker_count,
    COALESCE(b.speaker_total_ms_played, 0) AS speaker_total_ms_played,
    COALESCE(a.phone_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.speaker_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM phone_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN speaker_monthly b
  ON a.played_at_month = b.played_at_month
ORDER BY played_at_month
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

zero = F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)")
map_stage = (
    df_change_order_log.alias("c")
    .join(df_construction_projects.alias("p"), F.col("p.project_id") == F.col("c.project_id"))
    .filter(F.col("c.status").isin("approved", "pending"))
    .select(
        "c.*",
        "p.project_name",
        F.map_concat(
            F.transform_values(
                F.transform_keys(
                    F.map_filter(F.col("c.adjustments"), lambda k, v: v.isNotNull() & (v != 0)),
                    lambda k, v: F.lower(k),
                ),
                lambda k, v: F.round(v * F.lit("1.10").cast("decimal(3,2)"), 2),
            ),
            F.col("p.standard_adjustments"),
        ).alias("merged_adjustments"),
    )
)

def price_lines(lines):
    return F.transform(lines, lambda x, i: F.struct(
        (i + 1).alias("line_no"),
        x["cost_code"].alias("cost_code"),
        (x["quantity"] * x["unit_rate"]).cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("extended"),
    ))

priced_lines = price_lines(F.col("line_items"))
priced = (
    map_stage
    .select(
        "*",
        priced_lines.alias("priced_lines"),
        F.aggregate(
            priced_lines,
            zero,
            lambda acc, x: (acc + F.coalesce(x["extended"], zero)).cast("decimal(12,2)"),
            lambda acc: acc + F.coalesce(F.element_at(F.col("merged_adjustments"), "contingency"), zero),
        ).cast("decimal(14,2)").alias("change_total"),
        F.exists(F.col("line_items"), lambda x: x["quantity"] >= 25).alias("bulk_work"),
        F.forall(F.col("line_items"), lambda x: x["unit_rate"].isNotNull()).alias("all_priced"),
        F.size(F.filter(F.col("line_items"), lambda x: x["quantity"] * x["unit_rate"] >= 1000)).alias("major_line_count"),
    )
)
expanded = priced.select(
    "project_id", "change_id",
    F.posexplode_outer("line_items").alias("line_pos", "item"),
)
line_rollup = (
    expanded
    .groupBy("project_id", "change_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.col("item.cost_code")).alias("priced_line_count"),
        F.array_join(F.array_sort(F.filter(F.collect_set(F.col("item.cost_code")), lambda x: x.isNotNull())), " > ").alias("cost_code_path"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_list(F.struct(
            (F.col("line_pos") + 1).alias("line_no"),
            F.col("item.cost_code").alias("cost_code"),
            F.size(F.col("item.notes")).alias("note_count"),
        ))).alias("line_details"),
    )
)
result = (
    priced.alias("p")
    .join(line_rollup.alias("r"), ["project_id", "change_id"])
    .select(
        "project_id", "project_name", "change_id", "status", "change_total",
        "bulk_work", "all_priced", "major_line_count", "priced_line_count",
        "cost_code_path",
        F.array_sort(F.map_keys("merged_adjustments")).alias("adjustment_keys"),
        F.map_values("merged_adjustments").alias("adjustment_values"),
        "line_details",
    )
    .orderBy("project_id", "change_id")
)
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("gross_tonnage") < 144607)

        "id",
        "vessel_id",
        "crew_role",
        "vessel_flag",
        "reefer_temp",
        "built_on",
        "is_reefer",
        F.date_format(F.col("built_on"), "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("built_on_label"),
    )
)

with_parent_vessel = (
    recent_voyages.alias("s")
    .join(df_vessels.alias("v"), (F.col("v.id") == F.col("s.vessel_id")) & (~F.array_contains(F.col("v.cert_tags"), "ISPS")), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.vessel_id",
        "s.crew_role",
        "s.reefer_temp",
        "s.is_reefer",
        F.col("v.is_reefer").alias("vessel_is_reefer"),
        F.col("v.berthed_at").alias("vessel_berthed_at"),
    )
)

w_vessel_is_reefer_by_reefer_t = Window.partitionBy("vessel_is_reefer").orderBy("reefer_temp", "id")
w_crew_role = Window.partitionBy("crew_role")
w_all_by_vessel_berthed_at = Window.orderBy(F.col("vessel_berthed_at").desc(), "id")
metrics = (
    with_parent_vessel
    .select(
        "id",
        "vessel_id",
        "crew_role",
        "reefer_temp",
        "is_reefer",
        "vessel_is_reefer",
        "vessel_berthed_at",

        F.lag("reefer_temp", 2).over(w_vessel_is_reefer_by_reefer_t).alias("prev2_reefer_temp"),
        F.first("vessel_berthed_at").over(Window.partitionBy("vessel_is_reefer").orderBy("reefer_temp", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_vessel_berthed_at"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_crew_role).alias("rows_in_crew_role"),
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("vessel_berthed_at").desc())).alias("vessel_berthed_at_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("is_reefer", "vessel_is_reefer").orderBy(F.col("reefer_temp").desc(), "id")).alias("reefer_temp_dense_rank"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("vessel_id").over(Window.partitionBy("crew_role"))).alias("distinct_vessel_id_in_crew_role"),
        (F.col("reefer_temp") - F.lag("reefer_temp").over(w_all_by_vessel_berthed_at)).alias("reefer_temp_change"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("vessel_berthed_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("vessel_berthed_at").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("vessel_berthed_at").desc(), "id")))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_vessel_berthed_at"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("vessel_berthed_at").desc(), "id")).alias("vessel_berthed_at_tercile"),
        F.round(F.avg("reefer_temp").over(w_crew_role), 2).alias("crew_role_avg_reefer_temp"),
        F.max("reefer_temp").over(Window.partitionBy("crew_role")).alias("crew_role_max_reefer_temp"),
        F.sum("reefer_temp").over(Window.partitionBy("is_reefer", "vessel_is_reefer").orderBy(F.col("reefer_temp").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_reefer_temp"),
    )
)

first_rows = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("reefer_temp_dense_rank") <= 5)
    .drop("reefer_temp_dense_rank")
)

w_vessel_id_vessel_berthed_at = Window.partitionBy("vessel_id", "vessel_berthed_at_tercile")
with_windows = (
    first_rows
    .select(
        "id",
        "vessel_id",

        "is_reefer",

        "vessel_berthed_at",

        F.sum("vessel_berthed_at_tercile").over(w_vessel_id_vessel_berthed_at).alias("vessel_id_vessel_berthed_at_tercile_sum_vessel_b"),

        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("vessel_id", "vessel_berthed_at_tercile")).alias("rows_in_vessel_id_vessel_berthed_at_tercile"),
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY daypart ORDER BY spot_aired_at_init_base, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged

annotated AS (

        ROUND(session_no - AVG(session_no) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(session_start_date), session_no), 2) AS session_no_vs_session_start_date_year_session_no,
```

```sql
    FROM profiled

    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        term,

)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
```

```python
in_window = (
    df_meter_readings.alias("a")

        & (F.col("b.read_at") < F.col("a.read_at"))
        & (F.col("b.read_at") >= F.col("a.read_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),

)

    .filter(F.col("next_prior_rows_3d") < 5)
    .select(

        F.round(F.col("read_at_percent_rank") * 0.9, 2).alias("read_at_percent_rank_adj"),
        (F.floor(F.col("prior_voltage_3d") / 250) * 250).alias("prior_voltage_3d_bucket"),
        F.quarter(F.col("read_at")).alias("read_at_quarter"),
    )
)

        "read_at",
        "prior_rows_3d",
        "prior_rows_3d_site_id_sum_prior_rows_3d",

        "next_prior_rows_3d",
```

```sql
    FROM stats
```

```sql
    FROM call_features s

           FROM stg_plan_restrictions r
           WHERE r.plan_code = a.plan_code
       ) THEN 'allowed' ELSE 'blocked_or_unknown' END AS not_in_decision,
       CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM stg_plan_restrictions r
           WHERE r.plan_code = a.plan_code
             AND r.blocked_feature = a.addon_code
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

call_features = (
    df_stg_call_records.alias("c")
    .join(df_dim_rate_plans.alias("p"), F.col("c.plan_code") == F.col("p.plan_code"))
    .select(
        F.col("c.call_id"),
        F.col("c.subscriber_id"),
        F.col("c.plan_code"),
        F.col("p.plan_name"),
        F.ceil(F.col("c.duration_sec").cast("double") / 60).cast("int").alias("billable_minutes"),
        F.greatest(
            F.ceil(F.col("c.duration_sec").cast("double") / 60) - F.col("p.included_minutes"),
            F.lit(0),
        ).cast("int").alias("overage_minutes"),
        F.transform(
            F.col("p.add_ons"),
            lambda x, i: F.struct(
                (i + 1).alias("addon_slot"),
                x["feature_code"].alias("addon_code"),
                x["monthly_price"].alias("addon_price"),
            ),
        ).alias("indexed_add_ons"),
        F.aggregate(
            F.col("c.quality_samples"),
            F.lit(0),
            lambda acc, x: acc + x,
            lambda acc: F.round(acc / F.size(F.col("c.quality_samples")), 2),
        ).alias("avg_quality"),
        F.size(F.filter(F.col("c.quality_samples"), lambda x: x >= 70)).alias("good_sample_count"),
        F.exists(F.col("c.quality_samples"), lambda x: x < 50).alias("has_severe_drop"),
        F.forall(F.col("c.quality_samples"), lambda x: x >= 40).alias("all_samples_healthy"),
    )
)

addon_rows = (
    call_features
    .select("*", F.explode_outer(F.col("indexed_add_ons")).alias("addon"))
    .select(
        "call_id", "subscriber_id", "plan_code", "plan_name",
        "billable_minutes", "overage_minutes", "avg_quality",
        "good_sample_count", "has_severe_drop", "all_samples_healthy",
        F.col("addon.addon_slot").alias("addon_slot"),
        F.col("addon.addon_code").alias("addon_code"),
        F.col("addon.addon_price").alias("addon_price"),
    )
)

restriction_lists = (
    df_stg_plan_restrictions
    .groupBy("plan_code")
    .agg(
        F.collect_list("blocked_feature").alias("blocked_features"),
        (F.count(F.lit(1)) > F.count("blocked_feature")).alias("has_null_restriction"),
    )
)

matched = F.coalesce(
    F.exists(F.col("blocked_features"), lambda x: x == F.col("addon_code")),
    F.lit(False),
)
has_null_restriction = F.coalesce(F.col("has_null_restriction"), F.lit(False))
not_in_allowed = (
    F.when(matched, F.lit(False))
    .when(has_null_restriction, F.lit(None).cast("boolean"))
    .otherwise(F.lit(True))
)
not_exists_allowed = ~matched

result = (
    addon_rows.alias("a")
    .join(restriction_lists.alias("r"), F.col("a.plan_code") == F.col("r.plan_code"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("a.call_id"), F.col("a.subscriber_id"), F.col("a.plan_code"), F.col("a.plan_name"),
        F.col("a.addon_slot"), F.col("a.addon_code"), F.col("a.addon_price"),
        F.col("a.billable_minutes"), F.col("a.overage_minutes"), F.col("a.avg_quality"),
        F.col("a.good_sample_count"), F.col("a.has_severe_drop"), F.col("a.all_samples_healthy"),
        F.when(not_in_allowed, F.lit("allowed")).otherwise(F.lit("blocked_or_unknown")).alias("not_in_decision"),
        F.when(not_exists_allowed, F.lit("allowed")).otherwise(F.lit("blocked")).alias("not_exists_decision"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("call_id"), F.col("addon_slot").asc_nulls_last(), F.col("addon_code").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

```sql
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
```

```python
    df_rotor_decoders

        "status",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        "shipping_fee",

latest = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("status", "store_id").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)

        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "amount",
        "order_date_plus_months",

    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & F.col("order_date_plus_months").between("2023-07-01", "2024-07-01"))
    .withColumn("months_order_date_to_order_date_plus_months", F.round((F.datediff("order_date_plus_months", "order_date") / 30), 1))
)

scored = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",

        F.count("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("order_date_plus_months", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count_amount_lo"),

        F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("order_date_plus_months", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_sum_amount"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("status") == "CANCELLED")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "amount",
        "order_date_plus_months",
        "months_order_date_to_order_date_plus_months",
        "running_max_amount",
        "running_min_amount",

        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "RETURNED", 1)).alias("returned_count"),
```

```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.site_id,
        a.read_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS weathervane_ref,
        SUM(b.voltage) AS urban_corridor
    FROM archers a
    LEFT JOIN archers b
      ON b.site_id = a.site_id
     AND b.read_at < a.read_at
     AND b.read_at >= a.read_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at
),
per_group AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        weathervane_ref,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at) AS shutter_tally,
        site_id,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(urban_corridor, 0.5) AS median_prior_voltage_12h,
        ROUND(AVG(weathervane_ref), 2) AS avg_prior_rows_12h
    FROM in_window
    WHERE urban_corridor > 306.2
    GROUP BY weathervane_ref, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at), site_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT weathervane_ref, shutter_tally, site_id
FROM per_group
ORDER BY shutter_tally DESC, weathervane_ref DESC
```

```python
    df_archers.alias("a")

        & (F.col("b.read_at") >= F.col("a.read_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.site_id", "a.read_at")
```

```sql
    SELECT h.dock_id, h.rate_cents, h.valid_from,

               OVER (PARTITION BY h.dock_id ORDER BY h.valid_from) AS valid_to

           count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.bike_id ORDER BY p.started_at

    FROM prepared p

           coalesce(CASE WHEN size(s.sorted_trace) > 0 THEN element_at(s.sorted_trace, -1).dock END = s.end_dock_id, FALSE) AS trace_closed,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

schema = "STRUCT<device:STRUCT<firmware:STRING>,trace:ARRAY<STRUCT<dock:STRING,at:TIMESTAMP,battery:INT>>>"
prepared = (
    df_bike_rentals.alias("r")
    .filter(F.col("rental_status") == "COMPLETED")
    .withColumn("parsed", F.from_json("payload_json", schema))
    .withColumn("firmware", F.coalesce(F.col("parsed.device.firmware"), F.get_json_object("payload_json", "$.device.firmware")))
    .withColumn("duration_min", ((F.unix_timestamp("ended_at") - F.unix_timestamp("started_at")) / 60).cast("int"))
    .select("rental_id", "bike_id", "start_dock_id", "end_dock_id", "started_at", "duration_min", "parsed", "firmware")
)
w_dock = Window.partitionBy("dock_id").orderBy("valid_from")
h = (
    df_dock_rate_history
    .withColumn("prev_valid_from", F.lag("valid_from").over(w_dock))
    .withColumn("prev_rate", F.lag("rate_cents").over(w_dock))
    .withColumn("prev_status", F.lag("dock_status").over(w_dock))
)
rate_versions = (
    h.filter(F.col("prev_valid_from").isNull() | ~F.col("prev_rate").eqNullSafe(F.col("rate_cents")) | ~F.col("prev_status").eqNullSafe(F.col("dock_status")))
    .withColumn("valid_to", F.coalesce(F.lead("valid_from").over(w_dock), F.lit("9999-12-31 00:00:00").cast("timestamp")))
    .select("dock_id", "rate_cents", "valid_from", "valid_to")
)
scored = (
    prepared
    .withColumn("sorted_trace", F.array_sort("parsed.trace", lambda l, r: F.when(l.getField("at") < r.getField("at"), -1).when(l.getField("at") > r.getField("at"), 1).otherwise(0)))
    .withColumn("recent_bike_rentals", F.expr("count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY bike_id ORDER BY started_at RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '2' HOURS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)"))
)
matched = (
    scored.alias("s")
    .join(rate_versions.alias("v"), (F.col("v.dock_id") == F.col("s.start_dock_id")) & (F.col("v.valid_from") <= F.col("s.started_at")) & (F.col("s.started_at") < F.col("v.valid_to")))
    .withColumn("incomplete_trace", F.array_position(F.transform("sorted_trace", lambda x: x.getField("dock")), F.col("end_dock_id")) == 0)
    .withColumn("trace_closed", F.coalesce(F.when(F.size("sorted_trace") > 0, F.element_at("sorted_trace", -1).getField("dock")) == F.col("end_dock_id"), F.lit(False)))
    .withColumn("fifth_stop_low", F.try_element_at("sorted_trace", F.lit(5)).getField("battery") < 30)
    .withColumn("switch_count", F.size(F.filter(F.arrays_zip(F.slice("sorted_trace", 1, F.greatest(F.size("sorted_trace") - 1, F.lit(0))), F.slice("sorted_trace", 2, F.greatest(F.size("sorted_trace") - 1, F.lit(0)))), lambda leg: leg.getField("0").getField("dock") != leg.getField("1").getField("dock"))))
    .select("s.*", "v.rate_cents", "incomplete_trace", "trace_closed", "fifth_stop_low", "switch_count")
)
result = (
    matched.groupBy("start_dock_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rentals"),
        F.count_if(F.col("firmware") == "V2").alias("v2_rentals"),
        F.count_if(F.col("rate_cents") >= 100).alias("premium_rentals"),
        F.sum("rate_cents").alias("rate_cents_total"),
        F.max_by("rental_id", "duration_min").alias("longest_rental"),
        F.min_by("rental_id", "started_at").alias("first_rental"),
        F.bool_or("incomplete_trace").alias("any_incomplete_trace"),
        F.bool_and("trace_closed").alias("all_traces_closed"),
        F.bool_or("fifth_stop_low").alias("any_low_fifth_stop"),
        F.max("switch_count").alias("max_switches"),
        F.round(F.avg("recent_bike_rentals"), 2).alias("avg_recent_bike_load"),
    )
    .orderBy("start_dock_id")
)
```

```python
        "warehouse_id",
        "sku_id",
        "move_type",
        "qty",
        "unit_price",
    )
)

w_all_by_qty = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty").desc(), "id")
w_move_type = Window.partitionBy("move_type")
w_sku_id_by_qty_ties = Window.partitionBy("sku_id").orderBy(F.col("qty").asc_nulls_last())

sequenced = (
```

```sql
    WINDOW w_last_match_round_registered AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(last_match_round_registered_on_2), game_title_id)
),
leaders AS (
    -- Top 2 per group
    SELECT *
    FROM metrics
    WHERE ping_ms_dense_rank <= 2
      AND ping_ms <= 199
),
qualified AS (
    -- Rows that have matching toolkits
    SELECT s.*
    FROM leaders s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM toolkits l
            WHERE l.match_round_ref = s.id
        )
      AND s.ping_ms_dense_rank <= 8
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows with no matching toolkits
    SELECT s.*
    FROM qualified s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM toolkits l
            WHERE l.match_round_ref = s.id
              AND l.guild_rank IN ('leader', 'recruit')
              AND l.xp_points > 9004
        )
),
labeled AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        ping_ms,
        registered_on,
        gamer_tag,
        registered_on_year,
        ping_ms_filled,
        last_match_round_registered_on,
        match_round_count,
        match_round_count_vs_last_match_round_registered,
        rows_in_last_match_round_registered_on_2_month_g,
        ping_ms_dense_rank,
        CONCAT(gamer_tag, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS gamer_tag_ref
    FROM without_matches
    WHERE registered_on_year < 2026
)
SELECT
    id,
    ping_ms,
    gamer_tag,
    ping_ms_filled,
    last_match_round_registered_on,
    rows_in_last_match_round_registered_on_2_month_g,
    gamer_tag_ref,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', registered_on) AS days_since_registered_on
FROM labeled
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned_match_rounds = (
    df_cockpits
    .filter((F.col("ping_ms") < 199) & (F.col("drop_tier") == "legend"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "game_title_id",
        "drop_tier",
        "ping_ms",
        "registered_on",
        "gamer_tag",
        F.year(F.col("registered_on")).alias("registered_on_year"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("ping_ms"), F.lit(0)).alias("ping_ms_filled"),
    )
)

match_round_stats = (
    df_cockpits
    .groupBy("game_title_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("registered_on").alias("last_match_round_registered_on"),
        F.count("*").alias("match_round_count"),
        F.max("registered_on").alias("last_match_round_registered_on_2"),
    )
)

with_counts = (
    cleaned_match_rounds.alias("s")
    .join(match_round_stats.alias("m"), F.col("m.game_title_id") == F.col("s.game_title_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "m.last_match_round_registered_on",
        F.coalesce(F.col("m.match_round_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("match_round_count"),
        "m.last_match_round_registered_on_2",
    )
)

w_last_match_round_registered = Window.partitionBy(F.month("last_match_round_registered_on_2"), "game_title_id")
metrics = (
    with_counts
    .select(
        "id",
        "ping_ms",
        "registered_on",
        "gamer_tag",
        "registered_on_year",
        "ping_ms_filled",
        "last_match_round_registered_on",
        "match_round_count",
        F.round(F.col("match_round_count") - F.avg("match_round_count").over(w_last_match_round_registered), 2).alias("match_round_count_vs_last_match_round_registered"),
        F.max("registered_on_year").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("last_match_round_registered_on_2"), "game_title_id")).alias("last_match_round_registered_on_2_month_game_titl"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_last_match_round_registered).alias("rows_in_last_match_round_registered_on_2_month_g"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy("ping_ms", "id")).alias("ping_ms_dense_rank"),
    )
)

leaders = metrics.filter((F.col("ping_ms_dense_rank") <= 2) & (F.col("ping_ms") <= 199))

qualified = (
    leaders.alias("s")
    .join(df_toolkits.alias("l"), F.col("l.match_round_ref") == F.col("s.id"), "left_semi")
    .filter(F.col("ping_ms_dense_rank") <= 8)
)

without_matches = (
    qualified.alias("s")
    .join(df_toolkits.alias("l"), (F.col("l.match_round_ref") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("l.guild_rank").isin("leader", "recruit")) & (F.col("l.xp_points") > 9004), "left_anti")
)

labeled = (
    without_matches
    .filter(F.col("registered_on_year") < 2026)
    .select(
        "id",
        "ping_ms",
        "registered_on",
        "gamer_tag",
        "registered_on_year",
        "ping_ms_filled",
        "last_match_round_registered_on",
        "match_round_count",
        "match_round_count_vs_last_match_round_registered",
        "rows_in_last_match_round_registered_on_2_month_g",
        "ping_ms_dense_rank",
        F.concat(F.col("gamer_tag"), F.lit("#"), F.col("id").cast("string")).alias("gamer_tag_ref"),
    )
)

result = (
    labeled
    .select(
        "id",
        "ping_ms",
        "gamer_tag",
        "ping_ms_filled",
        "last_match_round_registered_on",
        "rows_in_last_match_round_registered_on_2_month_g",
        "gamer_tag_ref",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("registered_on")).alias("days_since_registered_on"),
    )
)
```

```sql
        MAX(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_mech ORDER BY CAST(promo_start_day_period AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) event_seq_max_30d
    FROM kept
    WHERE event_seq = 6
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY promo_mech ORDER BY visit_secs, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_last AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.promo_mech,
        s.promo_lift_pct,
        s.visit_secs,
        s.out_of_stock,
        s.promo_start_day_period,
        s.visit_secs_bucket,
        s.event_seq,
        s.running_event_seq,
        top1.visit_purpose,
        top1.restock_order_promo_start_day
    FROM with_windows_outlets s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.visit_purpose, c.promo_start_day AS restock_order_promo_start_day
            FROM restock_orders c
            WHERE c.outlet_no = s.id
            ORDER BY c.facings DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
with_latest AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        top1.outlet_format,
        top1.restock_quantity
    FROM with_last s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.outlet_format, c.restock_quantity
            FROM shelf_audits c
            WHERE c.outlet_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.restock_quantity DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN event_seq >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS event_seq_tier,
        outlet_format,
        CASE WHEN promo_lift_pct >= 42 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS promo_lift_pct_tier,
        (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(promo_start_day_period)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(promo_start_day_period))) / 60 AS span_minutes,
        (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(promo_start_day_period)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(promo_start_day_period))) / 60 AS duration_min,
        STDDEV_SAMP(visit_secs) AS visit_secs_stddev,
        SUM(CASE WHEN visit_purpose = 'training' THEN event_seq ELSE 0 END) AS training_event_seq,
        MIN(promo_start_day_period) AS first_promo_start_day_period
    FROM with_latest
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN event_seq >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, outlet_format, CASE WHEN promo_lift_pct >= 42 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END), (CASE WHEN event_seq >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, outlet_format), (CASE WHEN event_seq >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END))
)
SELECT
    outlet_format,
    promo_lift_pct_tier,
    span_minutes,
    training_event_seq,
    first_promo_start_day_period
FROM grouped;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("promo_mech").orderBy("visit_secs", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_outlets
    .filter(F.col("audit_result").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("promo_start_day_period", F.date_trunc("MONTH", "promo_start_day"))
    .withColumn("audit_result_group", F.when(F.col("audit_result").isin(["misplaced", "gap"]), "Core").otherwise("Other"))
    .withColumn("audit_result_clean", F.coalesce("audit_result", F.lit("DIRECT")))
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .withColumn("visit_secs_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("promo_mech").orderBy(F.col("visit_secs").desc(), "id")))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("promo_mech").orderBy(F.col("promo_lift_pct").desc(), "id")))
)

kept = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shelf_audits.alias("c"), (F.col("c.outlet_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.facings") != 15), "left_semi")
)

with_windows_outlets = (
    kept
    .filter(F.col("event_seq") == 6)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("event_seq").over(w_ordered).alias("running_event_seq"),
        F.max("event_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_mech").orderBy(F.col("promo_start_day_period").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)).alias("event_seq_max_30d"),
    )
)

with_last = (
    with_windows_outlets
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_restock_orders.alias("c"), (F.col("c.outlet_no") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.facings").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.promo_mech",
        "s.promo_lift_pct",
        "s.visit_secs",
        "s.out_of_stock",
        "s.promo_start_day_period",
        "s.visit_secs_bucket",
        "s.event_seq",
        "s.running_event_seq",
        F.col("c.visit_purpose"),
        F.col("c.promo_start_day").alias("restock_order_promo_start_day"),
    )
)

with_latest = (
    with_last
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shelf_audits.alias("c"), (F.col("c.outlet_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.restock_quantity").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.outlet_format"), F.col("c.restock_quantity"))
)

grouped = (
    with_latest
    .withColumn("event_seq_tier", F.when(F.col("event_seq") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .withColumn("promo_lift_pct_tier", F.when(F.col("promo_lift_pct") >= 42, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["event_seq_tier", "outlet_format", "promo_lift_pct_tier"], ["event_seq_tier", "outlet_format"], ["event_seq_tier"]],
        "event_seq_tier",
        "outlet_format",
        "promo_lift_pct_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("promo_start_day_period")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("promo_start_day_period"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("promo_start_day_period")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("promo_start_day_period"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
        F.stddev_samp("visit_secs").alias("visit_secs_stddev"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("visit_purpose") == "training", F.col("event_seq")).otherwise(0)).alias("training_event_seq"),
        F.min("promo_start_day_period").alias("first_promo_start_day_period"),
    )
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "outlet_format",
        "promo_lift_pct_tier",
        "span_minutes",
        "training_event_seq",
        "first_promo_start_day_period",
    )
)
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY grade_status ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged

    FROM session_summary
    WINDOW w_session_start_month_session AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start), session_no), w_session_end_month_by_session_2 AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(session_end) ORDER BY session_start ASC)
)
```

```python
        "term",
        "grade_status",

        F.concat_ws(" / ", F.col("term"), F.col("grade_status")).alias("term_grade_status_label"),
    )
)

with_prev = cleaned.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))

flagged = (

)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

session_summary = (

    .agg(

        F.max("enrolled_at").alias("session_end"),

w_session_end_month_by_session_2 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("session_end")).orderBy("session_start")
with_trends = (

    .select(

        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_session_end_month_by_session_2), 3).alias("session_start_percent_rank"),
```

```sql
    SELECT *
```

```sql
),
per_label AS (

    SELECT

        s.crew_role,

),
compared AS (

    WHERE s.teu_capacity > g.avg_teu_capacity
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM compared
    WHERE teu_capacity < (SELECT MAX(teu_capacity) FROM compared)
)
SELECT id, cert_tag, metric, metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT id, cert_tag, teu_capacity_minus_avg, avg_teu_capacity, freight_usd
    FROM without_matches
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR metric IN (teu_capacity_minus_avg AS m_teu_capacity_minus_avg, avg_teu_capacity AS avg_teu_capacity_v, freight_usd AS m_freight_usd)
```

```python
    base

        "crew_role",

        "freight_usd",
        "teu_capacity",
        "departed_on",
        "is_hazmat",
        F.explode_outer("cert_tags").alias("cert_tag"),
    )
)

voyage_state_stats = (
    per_label
    .groupBy("voyage_state")
    .agg(F.avg("teu_capacity").alias("avg_teu_capacity"))

compared = (
    per_label.alias("s")
    .join(voyage_state_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.voyage_state") == F.col("s.voyage_state"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.teu_capacity") > F.col("g.avg_teu_capacity"))

)

without_matches = (

    .select(
```

```python
        ).alias("sorted_cells"),
    )
)
prepared = (

    .select(

        F.when(F.size("sorted_cells") > 0, F.element_at("sorted_cells", -1)).alias("last_cell_v"),
        F.try_element_at("sorted_cells", F.lit(4)).alias("fourth_cell_v"),
```

```sql
    FROM with_details

cloud_region_stats AS (
    -- Avg page_ack_min_distance per cloud_region
    SELECT cloud_region, AVG(page_ack_min_distance) AS avg_page_ack_min_distance
    FROM annotated
    GROUP BY cloud_region

outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_page_ack_min_distance,
        ROUND(s.page_ack_min_distance - g.avg_page_ack_min_distance, 2) AS page_ack_min_distance_minus_avg
    FROM annotated s
    JOIN cloud_region_stats g ON g.cloud_region = s.cloud_region
    WHERE s.page_ack_min_distance > g.avg_page_ack_min_distance

            SELECT 1

        ROUND(vcpu_cnt / NULLIF(SUM(vcpu_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY deploy_result, cloud_region), 0), 4) AS vcpu_cnt_share_of_deploy_result_cloud_region,
```

```sql
    FROM flagged

sessions AS (

    FROM sessionized
```

```sql
        ROUND(AVG(rate) OVER (PARTITION BY tariff_group ORDER BY valid_to, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS rate_avg_2_prior,

derived AS (

        LAST_VALUE(rate) OVER (PARTITION BY valid_from_year, TO_DATE(valid_from) ORDER BY valid_from DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_rate
    FROM derived
```

```python
        "valid_to",

        F.when(F.col("tariff").isin("EV", "FLAT"), "group_a").when(F.col("tariff") == "TOU", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("tariff_group"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_rate = Window.partitionBy("dept", "cpt").orderBy("valid_from")
rate_scd = (
    df_bill_rate_hist
    .select(
        "dept", "cpt", "valid_from",
        F.coalesce(
            F.lead("valid_from", 1).over(w_rate),
            F.lit("9999-12-31 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"),
        ).alias("valid_to"),
        "rate", "reviewer",
        (~F.col("reviewer").eqNullSafe(F.lag("reviewer").over(w_rate))).alias("reviewer_changed"),
    )
)

prep = (
    df_hosp_admits.alias("o")
    .filter(
        ((F.col("acct_no").like("HSP-%")) | (F.col("acct_no").like("CLN-%")))
        & F.lower(F.col("dept")).like("%card%")
    )
)

def line_order(l, r):
    return (
        F.when(l.getField("amt") < r.getField("amt"), 1)
        .when(l.getField("amt") > r.getField("amt"), -1)
        .when(l.getField("line_id") < r.getField("line_id"), -1)
        .when(l.getField("line_id") > r.getField("line_id"), 1)
        .otherwise(0)
    )

expanded = (
    prep.alias("o")
    .select("o.*", F.posexplode(F.array_sort(F.col("lines"), line_order)).alias("line_pos", "line"))
)

last_diag_pair = F.element_at(
    F.arrays_zip(F.col("o.diag_codes"), F.array_sort(F.col("o.diag_codes"))), -1
).getItem("1")
result = (
    expanded.alias("o")
    .join(
        rate_scd.alias("c"),
        (F.col("c.dept") == F.col("o.dept"))
        & (F.col("c.cpt") == F.col("line.cpt"))
        & (F.col("c.valid_from") <= F.col("o.adm_ts"))
        & (F.col("o.adm_ts") < F.col("c.valid_to")),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        F.col("o.adm_id"),
        F.regexp_replace(F.col("o.acct_no"), "^([A-Z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)$", "$1/$2/$3").alias("acct_norm"),
        F.split_part(F.col("o.patient_ref"), F.lit("|"), F.lit(2)).alias("mrn"),
        F.str_to_map(F.col("o.meta_txt"), F.lit(","), F.lit(":")).getItem("payor").alias("payor"),
        F.parse_url(F.col("o.service_url"), F.lit("HOST")).alias("portal_host"),
        F.array_join(F.regexp_extract_all(F.col("o.note_tags"), F.lit("([a-z]+):([A-Z0-9-]+)"), 2), ",").alias("ref_list"),
        F.col("line.line_id"), F.col("line_pos"), F.col("line.cpt"), F.col("line.qty"),
        F.round(F.col("line.qty") * F.col("c.rate"), 2).cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("allowed_amt"),
        F.col("c.reviewer"), F.col("c.reviewer_changed"),
        F.array_position(F.col("o.diag_codes"), F.col("line.cpt")).alias("diag_pos"),
        F.try_element_at(F.col("o.diag_codes"), F.col("line_pos") + 2).alias("peer_diag"),
        F.when(F.size(F.col("o.diag_codes")) == 0, F.lit(None).cast("string"))
        .otherwise(last_diag_pair).alias("last_sorted_diag"),
        F.slice(F.col("o.diag_codes"), 1, 2).alias("diag_slice"),
    )
    .orderBy("adm_id", "line_pos")
)
```

```sql
sessionized AS (
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY listing_no ORDER BY gross_offer_made_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged

    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY listing_no, burst_id
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        event_count,
        listing_no,

        MIN(session_start) AS first_session_start,

        MAX(session_end) AS last_session_end
    FROM per_session
    GROUP BY event_count, listing_no
)

    event_count_to_burst_id_ratio,
    first_session_start,
```

```python
valid = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter((F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01 09:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("pressure") <= 1014))
    .withColumn("humidity_rounded", F.round("humidity", 0))
    .withColumn("status_bits_rounded", F.round("status_bits", 0))
)

scored = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("status_bits_rounded").between(24, 67))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")))
    .withColumn("humidity_share", F.round((F.col("humidity") / F.sum("humidity").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("reading_ts"), "device_code"))), 4))
    .withColumn("humidity_share_2", F.round((F.col("humidity") / F.sum("humidity").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code"))), 4))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("prev_status_bits", F.lag("status_bits", 2).over(w_part))
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("humidity_share_2").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code")).alias("device_code_min_humidity_share_2"),
        F.lead("temp_c", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("humidity_share", "id")).alias("next_temp_c"),
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.orderBy("humidity_share", "id")).alias("humidity_share_bucket"),
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("reading_ts"), "device_code").orderBy(F.col("humidity").desc())).alias("humidity_percent_rank"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("reading_ts"), "device_code").orderBy(F.col("prev_status_bits").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq_2"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits_rounded",
        "prev_status_bits",
        "device_code_min_humidity_share_2",
        "next_temp_c",
        "humidity_percent_rank",
        "event_seq_2",

)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("merchant")

    .select(

        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        F.concat_ws("/", "merchant", "txn_type").alias("merchant_txn_type_key"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("NONE")).alias("merchant_clean"),

)
```

```sql
WITH latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        discount_pct
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct DESC, id ASC) AS rank_in_group
        FROM promotions
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        e.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM latest e
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON COALESCE(e.channel, 'web') = pr.channel
       AND e.starts_on >= pr.starts_on
       AND e.starts_on < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL 30 DAYS
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        starts_on,
        discount_pct,
        promo_id,
        promo_code,
        COUNT(promotion_discount_pct) OVER w_recent AS promo_code_count_promotion_discount_pct,
        LAST_VALUE(channel) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY starts_on ASC, id ASC, promo_id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_channel,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist AS row_seq
    FROM matched
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY promo_code), w_hist AS (ORDER BY promotion_discount_pct ASC, id ASC, promo_id ASC)
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY row_seq DESC, id ASC, promo_id ASC) AS latest_rank
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    promo_code,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE promo_code = 'SPRING10') AS spring10_rows,
    ROUND(SUM(discount_pct) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN promo_code = 'VIP' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS discount_pct_per_vip
FROM deduped
GROUP BY 1
HAVING ROUND(SUM(discount_pct) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN promo_code = 'VIP' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) > 0;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("promo_code")
w_hist = Window.orderBy("promotion_discount_pct", "id", "promo_id")

latest = (
    df_promotions
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "channel", "starts_on", "discount_pct")
)

matched = (
    latest
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.coalesce(F.col("e.channel"), F.lit("web")) == F.col("pr.channel")) & (F.col("e.starts_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("e.starts_on") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(

        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),

        "starts_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "promo_id",
```

```python
flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "value"),
    )
)

flattened_attrs = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("status_code") < 410)
    .select(
        "service",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "value",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(2) != 0).cast("int").alias("flag_bit2"),
    )
)

base = (
    flattened_attrs
    .filter(F.col("status_code_high") != 2)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("flag_bit2") * 100), 2).alias("flag_bit2_adjusted"),
        F.round((F.col("status_code_high") / F.col("status_code")), 2).alias("status_code_high_per_status_code"),

)

        F.stddev_samp("status_code").alias("status_code_stddev"),

result = (
```

```sql
  counters forward, and compare delivery with hourly/device quality signals.

WITH calendar AS (
    -- One row per active day, including days without a delivery report.
    SELECT r.ad_id, r.campaign, d.report_dt
    FROM ad_registry r
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(r.start_dt, r.end_dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) d AS report_dt
    WHERE r.is_enabled
),
filled AS (
    SELECT c.ad_id, c.campaign, c.report_dt,
           LAST(s.cum_imps, TRUE) OVER (
               PARTITION BY c.ad_id ORDER BY c.report_dt
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cum_imps,
           LAST(s.cum_clicks, TRUE) OVER (
               PARTITION BY c.ad_id ORDER BY c.report_dt
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cum_clicks
    FROM calendar c
    LEFT JOIN ad_daily_stats s
      ON s.ad_id = c.ad_id AND s.report_dt = c.report_dt
),
long_stats AS (
    -- STACK retains the leading NULLs before an ad's first report.
    SELECT f.ad_id, f.campaign, f.report_dt, metric_name, metric_value
    FROM filled f
    LATERAL VIEW STACK(2, 'impressions', f.cum_imps, 'clicks', f.cum_clicks) u
      AS metric_name, metric_value
),
ad_quality AS (
    SELECT ad_id,
           -- Index i aligns each click count with its hourly impression count.
           ROUND(AVG(AGGREGATE(
               TRANSFORM(hourly_clicks, (x, i) ->
                   CASE WHEN ELEMENT_AT(hourly_imps, i + 1) >= 100 AND x >= 0
                        THEN x ELSE 0 END),
               CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + x,
               acc -> acc / SIZE(hourly_clicks)
           )), 2) AS avg_valid_clicks,
           MAX(SIZE(FILTER(hourly_imps, x -> x >= 100))) AS peak_qualified_hours,
           BOOL_OR(EXISTS(hourly_clicks, x -> x >= 3)) AS engaged,
           BOOL_AND(FORALL(hourly_clicks, x -> x >= 0)) AS counts_valid,
           MAX(ELEMENT_AT(TRANSFORM_VALUES(
               MAP_FILTER(device_clicks, (k, v) -> v >= 2),
               (k, v) -> v * 10), 'mobile')) AS mobile_score
    FROM ad_daily_stats
    GROUP BY ad_id
)
SELECT l.ad_id, l.campaign, l.metric_name,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.metric_value) AS p50_value,
       q.avg_valid_clicks, q.peak_qualified_hours, q.engaged,
       q.counts_valid, q.mobile_score
FROM long_stats l
JOIN ad_quality q ON q.ad_id = l.ad_id
GROUP BY l.ad_id, l.campaign, l.metric_name, q.avg_valid_clicks,
         q.peak_qualified_hours, q.engaged, q.counts_valid, q.mobile_score
ORDER BY l.ad_id, l.metric_name
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

calendar = (
    df_ad_registry
    .filter(F.col("is_enabled"))
    .select(
        "ad_id",
        "campaign",
        F.explode(F.sequence(F.col("start_dt"), F.col("end_dt"), F.expr("INTERVAL '1' DAY"))).alias("report_dt"),
    )
)

w_fill = (
    Window.partitionBy("c.ad_id")
    .orderBy("c.report_dt")
    .rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
)
filled = (
    calendar.alias("c")
    .join(
        df_ad_daily_stats.alias("s"),
        (F.col("s.ad_id") == F.col("c.ad_id")) & (F.col("s.report_dt") == F.col("c.report_dt")),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        F.col("c.ad_id").alias("ad_id"),
        "c.campaign",
        "c.report_dt",
        F.last(F.col("s.cum_imps"), ignorenulls=True).over(w_fill).alias("cum_imps"),
        F.last(F.col("s.cum_clicks"), ignorenulls=True).over(w_fill).alias("cum_clicks"),
    )
)

long_stats = (
    filled
    .withColumn(
        "metric",
        F.explode(F.array(
            F.struct(F.lit("impressions").alias("metric_name"), F.col("cum_imps").alias("metric_value")),
            F.struct(F.lit("clicks").alias("metric_name"), F.col("cum_clicks").alias("metric_value")),
        )),
    )
    .select("ad_id", "campaign", "report_dt", "metric.metric_name", "metric.metric_value")
)

adjusted_clicks = F.transform(
    F.col("hourly_clicks"),
    lambda x, i: F.when((F.element_at(F.col("hourly_imps"), i + 1) >= 100) & (x >= 0), x).otherwise(F.lit(0)),
)
ad_quality = (
    df_ad_daily_stats
    .groupBy("ad_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg(F.aggregate(
            adjusted_clicks,
            F.lit(0.0),
            lambda acc, x: acc + x,
            lambda acc: acc / F.size(F.col("hourly_clicks")),
        )), 2).alias("avg_valid_clicks"),
        F.max(F.size(F.filter(F.col("hourly_imps"), lambda x: x >= 100))).alias("peak_qualified_hours"),
        F.bool_or(F.exists(F.col("hourly_clicks"), lambda x: x >= 3)).alias("engaged"),
        F.bool_and(F.forall(F.col("hourly_clicks"), lambda x: x >= 0)).alias("counts_valid"),
        F.max(F.element_at(
            F.transform_values(
                F.map_filter(F.col("device_clicks"), lambda k, v: v >= 2),
                lambda k, v: v * 10,
            ),
            F.lit("mobile"),
        )).alias("mobile_score"),
    )
)

    long_stats
    .groupBy("ad_id", "campaign", "metric_name")
    .agg(F.expr("PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY metric_value)").alias("p50_value"))
```

```sql
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS key, attr_value

flattened_attrs AS (
    -- Semi-structured parsing
    SELECT
        id,
        key,
        CAST((status_code & 2) != 0 AS INT) AS has_fault,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high
    FROM lines
    WHERE key IN ('version', 'trace')
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        key,
        status_code_high,
        FIRST_VALUE(status_code_high, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY status_code_high, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_status_code_high,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY has_fault, id, key) AS has_fault_bucket,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY status_code_high DESC NULLS LAST) AS status_code_high_cume_dist,
        LAST_VALUE(has_fault) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY has_fault, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_has_fault,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY status_code_high DESC, id, key) AS seq_no_adj
    FROM flattened_attrs
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        key,
        first_known_status_code_high,
        has_fault_bucket,
        ROUND(has_fault_bucket * 100, 2) AS has_fault_bucket_adjusted,
        COALESCE(key, 'NONE') AS key_filled
    FROM scored
    WHERE seq_no_adj < 6
),
grouped AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN first_known_status_code_high >= 2 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS first_known_status_code_high_tier,
        key,
        MAX(has_fault_bucket) FILTER (WHERE key = 'region') AS region_max_has_fault_bucket,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(has_fault_bucket, 0.5) AS has_fault_bucket_p50,
        GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_id
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN first_known_status_code_high >= 2 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, key), (CASE WHEN first_known_status_code_high >= 2 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END), ())
)
SELECT has_fault_bucket_p50, grouping_id
FROM grouped
ORDER BY grouping_id NULLS FIRST;
```

```python
)

    lines
    .filter(F.col("key").isin(["version", "trace"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "key",
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(2) != 0).cast("int").alias("has_fault"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

scored = (
    flattened_attrs
    .select(
        "id",
        "key",
        "status_code_high",

        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("has_fault", "id", "key")).alias("has_fault_bucket"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").desc_nulls_last())).alias("status_code_high_cume_dist"),

    )

grouped = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("first_known_status_code_high_tier", F.when(F.col("first_known_status_code_high") >= 2, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
```
