```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_readings = (
    df_arctic_buggies
    .filter(F.col("site_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.month(F.col("read_at")).alias("read_at_month"),
    )
)

reading_stats = (
    df_arctic_buggies
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("voltage"), 2).alias("avg_reading_voltage"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("quality") == "OK", 1)).alias("reading_quality_count"),
    )
)

summarized_rows = (
    scoped_readings.alias("s")
    .join(reading_stats.alias("m"), F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "m.avg_reading_voltage",
        F.coalesce(F.col("m.reading_quality_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("reading_quality_count"),
    )
)

w_read_at_month_by_read_at_mon = Window.partitionBy("read_at_month").orderBy("read_at_month")
sequenced = (
    summarized_rows
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        "read_at_month",
        "avg_reading_voltage",
        F.last("avg_reading_voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("reading_quality_count", "read_at_month").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_avg_reading_voltage"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("reading_quality_count", "read_at_month").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id")).alias("read_at_dense_rank"),
        F.min("reading_quality_count").over(Window.partitionBy("reading_quality_count", "site_id")).alias("reading_quality_count_site_id_min_reading_qualit"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_read_at_month_by_read_at_mon).alias("read_at_month_dense_rank"),
    )
)

with_parent = (
    sequenced.alias("s")
    .join(df_indigo_rivets.alias("si"), F.col("si.id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("si.commissioned_on").alias("site_commissioned_on"))
)

reading_stats_2 = (
    df_arctic_buggies
    .groupBy("site_id")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("reading_count"))
)

profiled = (
    with_parent.alias("s")
    .join(reading_stats_2.alias("m"), F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("m.reading_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("reading_count"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    profiled
    .select(
        "id",
        "quality",
        "last_avg_reading_voltage",
        "reading_quality_count_site_id_min_reading_qualit",
        "site_commissioned_on",
        "reading_count",
        F.coalesce(F.col("avg_reading_voltage"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("thicket_mark"),
    )
)

without_matches = (
    tagged
    .crossJoin(tagged.agg(F.max("thicket_mark").alias("overall_max_avg_reading_voltage_filled")))
    .filter(F.col("thicket_mark") < F.col("overall_max_avg_reading_voltage_filled"))
    .drop("overall_max_avg_reading_voltage_filled")
)

result = (
    without_matches
    .select(
        "id",
        "quality",
        "site_commissioned_on",
        "reading_count",
        "thicket_mark",
        F.when(F.col("quality").isin("BAD", "OK"), "group_a").when(F.col("quality") == "EST", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("plateau_level"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("last_avg_reading_voltage"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("last_avg_reading_voltage_filled"),
```

```sql
    -- Filter viewer_panels
    SELECT
        id,
        daypart,
        rating_pts,
        share_percent,
        program_title,
        flag_is_live,
        IF(flag_is_live, 'yes', 'no') AS flag_is_live_label
    FROM viewer_panels
    WHERE daypart IS NOT NULL
      AND spot_aired_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-25 13:00:00'
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        rating_pts + share_percent AS rating_pts_plus_share_percent,
        CONCAT_WS(': ', flag_is_live_label, daypart) AS flag_is_live_label_daypart_label
    FROM recent
    WHERE flag_is_live_label = 'no'
),
qualified AS (
    -- Compare against the overall min
    SELECT *
    FROM annotated
    WHERE rating_pts > (SELECT MIN(rating_pts) FROM annotated)
),
derived AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        daypart,
        rating_pts,
        flag_is_live,
        flag_is_live_label,
        flag_is_live_label_daypart_label,
        FLOOR(share_percent / 10) * 10 AS share_percent_bucket,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(flag_is_live_label), 1, 3) AS flag_is_live_label_prefix
    FROM qualified
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    daypart,
    flag_is_live_label_daypart_label,
    share_percent_bucket
FROM derived
ORDER BY id, share_percent_bucket DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent = (
    df_viewer_panels
    .filter((F.col("daypart").isNotNull()) & (F.col("spot_aired_ts") >= F.lit("2025-01-25 13:00:00").cast("timestamp")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "daypart",
        "rating_pts",
        "share_percent",
        "program_title",
        "flag_is_live",
        F.when(F.col("flag_is_live"), "yes").otherwise("no").alias("flag_is_live_label"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    recent
    .filter(F.col("flag_is_live_label") == "no")
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("rating_pts") + F.col("share_percent")).alias("rating_pts_plus_share_percent"),
        F.concat_ws(": ", F.col("flag_is_live_label"), F.col("daypart")).alias("flag_is_live_label_daypart_label"),
    )
)

qualified = (
    annotated
    .crossJoin(annotated.agg(F.min("rating_pts").alias("overall_min_rating_pts")))
    .filter(F.col("rating_pts") > F.col("overall_min_rating_pts"))
    .drop("overall_min_rating_pts")
)

derived = (
    qualified
    .select(
        "id",
        "daypart",
        "rating_pts",
        "flag_is_live",
        "flag_is_live_label",
        "flag_is_live_label_daypart_label",
        (F.floor(F.col("share_percent") / 10) * 10).alias("share_percent_bucket"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("flag_is_live_label")), 1, 3).alias("flag_is_live_label_prefix"),
    )
)

result = (
    derived
    .select(
        "id",
        "daypart",
        "flag_is_live_label_daypart_label",
        "share_percent_bucket",
    )
    .orderBy("id", F.col("share_percent_bucket").desc())
)
```

```sql
 * The recruiter is resolved as of the completed onsite interview.
 */
WITH passed_candidates AS (
    -- A distinct candidate must clear both score gates.
    SELECT a.candidate_id
    FROM job_applications a
    JOIN interview_events i ON i.application_id = a.application_id
    WHERE i.interview_type = 'technical'
      AND i.status = 'completed' AND i.score >= 4.00
    INTERSECT
    SELECT a.candidate_id
    FROM job_applications a
    JOIN interview_events i ON i.application_id = a.application_id
    WHERE i.interview_type = 'onsite'
      AND i.status = 'completed' AND i.score >= 4.00
),
recruiter_changes AS (
    -- Drop repeated assignments, retaining an initially unassigned req.
    SELECT requisition_id, recruiter_id, valid_from
    FROM (
        SELECT h.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY requisition_id ORDER BY valid_from
               ) AS rn,
               LAG(recruiter_id) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY requisition_id ORDER BY valid_from
               ) AS prior_recruiter_id
        FROM recruiter_assignment_history h
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1 OR recruiter_id IS DISTINCT FROM prior_recruiter_id
),
recruiter_scd AS (
    SELECT requisition_id, recruiter_id, valid_from,
           LEAD(valid_from, 1, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 00:00:00') OVER (
               PARTITION BY requisition_id ORDER BY valid_from
           ) AS valid_to
    FROM recruiter_changes
)
SELECT a.application_id, a.candidate_id, r.job_title,
       i.scheduled_at, i.score AS onsite_score, s.recruiter_id
FROM job_applications a
JOIN interview_events i ON i.application_id = a.application_id
JOIN open_requisitions r ON r.requisition_id = a.requisition_id
LEFT SEMI JOIN passed_candidates p ON p.candidate_id = a.candidate_id
LEFT ANTI JOIN interview_events ns
    ON ns.application_id = a.application_id AND ns.status = 'no_show'
LEFT JOIN recruiter_scd s
    ON s.requisition_id = a.requisition_id
   AND s.valid_from <= i.scheduled_at
   AND i.scheduled_at < s.valid_to
WHERE a.stage <> 'rejected'
  AND r.is_open
  AND i.interview_type = 'onsite'
  AND i.status = 'completed'
ORDER BY a.application_id, i.interview_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

technical = (
    df_job_applications.alias("a")
    .join(df_interview_events.alias("i"), F.col("i.application_id") == F.col("a.application_id"))
    .filter((F.col("i.interview_type") == "technical") & (F.col("i.status") == "completed") & (F.col("i.score") >= 4.00))
    .select(F.col("a.candidate_id"))
)
onsite = (
    df_job_applications.alias("a")
    .join(df_interview_events.alias("i"), F.col("i.application_id") == F.col("a.application_id"))
    .filter((F.col("i.interview_type") == "onsite") & (F.col("i.status") == "completed") & (F.col("i.score") >= 4.00))
    .select(F.col("a.candidate_id"))
)
passed_candidates = technical.intersect(onsite)

w_history = Window.partitionBy("requisition_id").orderBy("valid_from")
recruiter_changes = (
    df_recruiter_assignment_history
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w_history))
    .withColumn("prior_recruiter_id", F.lag("recruiter_id").over(w_history))
    .filter((F.col("rn") == 1) | (~F.col("recruiter_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("prior_recruiter_id"))))

    .join(df_interview_events.alias("ns"), (F.col("ns.application_id") == F.col("a.application_id")) & (F.col("ns.status") == "no_show"), "left_anti")
    .join(recruiter_scd.alias("s"), (F.col("s.requisition_id") == F.col("a.requisition_id")) & (F.col("s.valid_from") <= F.col("i.scheduled_at")) & (F.col("i.scheduled_at") < F.col("s.valid_to")), "left")
    .filter((F.col("a.stage") != "rejected") & F.col("r.is_open") & (F.col("i.interview_type") == "onsite") & (F.col("i.status") == "completed"))
    .orderBy("a.application_id", "i.interview_id")
    .select("a.application_id", "a.candidate_id", "r.job_title", "i.scheduled_at", F.col("i.score").alias("onsite_score"), "s.recruiter_id")
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("promo_code").isin(["WELCOME5", "BUNDLE", "VIP"]))
    .withColumn("next_weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on", F.lead("weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on").over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("ends_on", "id")))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("ends_on", "id")))
```

```sql
/*
  Museum membership engagement review for January-February 2025.
  Audio chapters are weighted by position; gallery maps measure dwell time.
  The report compares full patron and supporter memberships only.
*/
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT
    v.visit_id,
    v.member_id,
    v.visit_day,
    v.party_size,
    -- Repair missing audio payloads without discarding the visit.
    COALESCE(v.audio_scores, ARRAY()) AS audio_scores,
    TRANSFORM_VALUES(v.gallery_minutes, (gallery, minutes) -> LEAST(minutes, 90)) AS capped_minutes,
    MAP_FILTER(v.gallery_minutes, (gallery, minutes) -> minutes >= 30) AS focused_minutes
  FROM museum_visits v
  WHERE v.visit_day BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28'
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    n.*,
    -- Later audio chapters receive a larger positional weight.
    TRANSFORM(n.audio_scores, (score, idx) -> score * (idx + 1)) AS weighted_scores,
    ELEMENT_AT(n.capped_minutes, 'ancient_art') AS ancient_art_minutes,
    SIZE(MAP_KEYS(n.focused_minutes)) AS focused_gallery_count
  FROM normalized n
),
visit_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    AGGREGATE(
      FILTER(s.weighted_scores, score -> score >= 6),
      CAST(0 AS DOUBLE),
      (acc, score) -> acc + score,
      total -> ROUND(total / 10.0, 2)
    ) AS audio_score,
    EXISTS(s.weighted_scores, score -> score >= 24) AS deep_listening,
    FORALL(s.audio_scores, score -> score BETWEEN 0 AND 10) AS valid_audio
  FROM scored s
)
SELECT
  m.member_id,
  m.member_name,
  m.tier,
  COUNT(*) AS visit_count,
  COUNT_IF(x.party_size >= 4) AS group_visits,
  BOOL_OR(x.deep_listening) AS any_deep_listening,
  BOOL_AND(x.valid_audio) AS all_audio_valid,
  -- The visit id tie-breaker makes the maximum deterministic.
  MAX_BY(x.visit_id, STRUCT(x.audio_score, x.visit_id)) AS top_audio_visit_id,
  MIN_BY(x.visit_id, x.visit_day) AS first_visit_id,
  SUM(x.focused_gallery_count) AS focused_gallery_total,
  ROUND(AVG(x.ancient_art_minutes), 1) AS avg_ancient_art_minutes
FROM membership_roster m
JOIN visit_metrics x ON x.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE m.active AND m.tier IN ('patron', 'supporter')
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.member_name, m.tier
ORDER BY m.tier, m.member_id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

normalized = (
    df_museum_visits.alias("v")
    .filter(F.col("v.visit_day").between(F.lit("2025-01-01").cast("date"), F.lit("2025-02-28").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "v.visit_id",
        "v.member_id",
        "v.visit_day",
        "v.party_size",
        F.coalesce(F.col("v.audio_scores"), F.array().cast("array<int>")).alias("audio_scores"),
        F.transform_values(F.col("v.gallery_minutes"), lambda gallery, minutes: F.least(minutes, F.lit(90))).alias("capped_minutes"),
        F.map_filter(F.col("v.gallery_minutes"), lambda gallery, minutes: minutes >= 30).alias("focused_minutes"),
    )
)

scored = (
    normalized.alias("n")
    .select(
        "n.*",
        F.transform(F.col("n.audio_scores"), lambda score, idx: score * (idx + 1)).alias("weighted_scores"),
        F.element_at(F.col("n.capped_minutes"), F.lit("ancient_art")).alias("ancient_art_minutes"),

    .groupBy("m.member_id", "m.member_name", "m.tier")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("visit_count"),
        F.count_if(F.col("x.party_size") >= 4).alias("group_visits"),
        F.bool_or(F.col("x.deep_listening")).alias("any_deep_listening"),
        F.bool_and(F.col("x.valid_audio")).alias("all_audio_valid"),
        F.max_by(F.col("x.visit_id"), F.struct(F.col("x.audio_score"), F.col("x.visit_id"))).alias("top_audio_visit_id"),
        F.min_by(F.col("x.visit_id"), F.col("x.visit_day")).alias("first_visit_id"),

        "any_deep_listening", "all_audio_valid", "top_audio_visit_id",
```

```sql
    FROM covered
```

```sql
  App-store streak report: fill missing daily downloads, find active-day
  islands, and attach the review policy effective at each rating.

WITH policy_scd AS (
    -- Discard no-op snapshots, retaining initial and changed bands.
    SELECT app_id, valid_from,
           LEAD(valid_from, 1, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 00:00:00')
             OVER (PARTITION BY app_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS valid_to,
           review_band
    FROM (
        SELECT v.*, LAG(review_band) OVER (PARTITION BY app_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_band
        FROM app_review_policies v
    ) v
    WHERE prev_band IS DISTINCT FROM review_band
),
daily AS (
    SELECT app_id, metric_date,
           COALESCE(LAST(download_cnt, TRUE) OVER (
             PARTITION BY app_id ORDER BY metric_date
             ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS dl_cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT s.app_id, s.metric_date, m.download_cnt
        FROM (
            SELECT app_id,
                   EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(MIN(metric_date), MAX(metric_date), INTERVAL '1' DAY)) AS metric_date
            FROM app_daily_metrics
            GROUP BY app_id
        ) s
        LEFT JOIN app_daily_metrics m
          ON m.app_id = s.app_id AND m.metric_date = s.metric_date
    ) j
),
streaks AS (
    -- Consecutive active days share the same date/row-number island key.
    SELECT app_id, MIN(metric_date) AS streak_start, MAX(metric_date) AS streak_end,
           COUNT(*) AS active_days, SUM(dl_cnt) AS streak_downloads
    FROM (
        SELECT app_id, metric_date, dl_cnt,
               DATE_SUB(metric_date, CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                 PARTITION BY app_id ORDER BY metric_date) AS INT)) AS island_key
        FROM daily
        WHERE dl_cnt >= 100
    ) a
    GROUP BY app_id, island_key
),
rated AS (
    SELECT f.*, p.review_band
    FROM (
        SELECT m.app_id, m.metric_date, rating_evt.event_ts AS rating_at,
               rating_evt.stars, rating_evt.country
        FROM app_daily_metrics m
        LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(m.rating_events) rv AS rating_pos, rating_evt
    ) f
    JOIN policy_scd p
      ON p.app_id = f.app_id
     AND p.valid_from <= f.rating_at
     AND f.rating_at < p.valid_to
)
SELECT s.app_id, s.streak_start, s.streak_end, s.active_days, s.streak_downloads,
       COUNT(r.stars) AS rating_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.stars <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_rating_cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(r.stars), 2) AS avg_rating,
       MAX(CASE WHEN r.review_band = 'strict' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS strict_hit
FROM streaks s
LEFT JOIN rated r
  ON r.app_id = s.app_id AND r.metric_date BETWEEN s.streak_start AND s.streak_end
GROUP BY s.app_id, s.streak_start, s.streak_end, s.active_days, s.streak_downloads
ORDER BY s.app_id, s.streak_start
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_policy = Window.partitionBy("app_id").orderBy("valid_from")
policy_scd = (
    df_app_review_policies
    .withColumn("prev_band", F.lag("review_band").over(w_policy))
    .filter(~F.col("prev_band").eqNullSafe(F.col("review_band")))
    .select(
        "app_id", "valid_from",
        F.lead("valid_from", 1, "9999-12-31 00:00:00").over(w_policy).alias("valid_to"),
        "review_band",
    )
)

spine = (
    df_app_daily_metrics
    .groupBy("app_id")
    .agg(F.min("metric_date").alias("min_dt"), F.max("metric_date").alias("max_dt"))
    .select("app_id", F.explode(F.sequence("min_dt", "max_dt", F.expr("INTERVAL '1' DAY"))).alias("metric_date"))
)
joined = (
    spine.alias("s")
    .join(df_app_daily_metrics.alias("m"), (F.col("s.app_id") == F.col("m.app_id")) & (F.col("s.metric_date") == F.col("m.metric_date")), "left")
    .select("s.app_id", "s.metric_date", "m.download_cnt")
)
w_daily = Window.partitionBy("app_id").orderBy("metric_date").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
daily = joined.select("app_id", "metric_date", F.coalesce(F.last("download_cnt", ignorenulls=True).over(w_daily), F.lit(0)).alias("dl_cnt"))

w_active = Window.partitionBy("app_id").orderBy("metric_date")
streaks = (
    daily
    .filter(F.col("dl_cnt") >= 100)
    .withColumn("island_key", F.date_sub("metric_date", F.row_number().over(w_active).cast("int")))
    .groupBy("app_id", "island_key")
    .agg(
        F.min("metric_date").alias("streak_start"),
        F.max("metric_date").alias("streak_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("active_days"),
        F.sum("dl_cnt").alias("streak_downloads"),
    )
)

rated = (
    df_app_daily_metrics.alias("m")
    .select("m.app_id", "m.metric_date", F.posexplode("m.rating_events").alias("rating_pos", "rating_evt"))
    .select("app_id", "metric_date", F.col("rating_evt.event_ts").alias("rating_at"), "rating_evt.stars", "rating_evt.country")
    .alias("r")
    .join(policy_scd.alias("p"), (F.col("p.app_id") == F.col("r.app_id")) & (F.col("p.valid_from") <= F.col("r.rating_at")) & (F.col("r.rating_at") < F.col("p.valid_to")))
    .select("r.*", "p.review_band")
)
result = (
    streaks.alias("s")
    .join(rated.alias("r"), (F.col("s.app_id") == F.col("r.app_id")) & (F.col("r.metric_date") >= F.col("s.streak_start")) & (F.col("r.metric_date") <= F.col("s.streak_end")), "left")
    .groupBy("s.app_id", "s.streak_start", "s.streak_end", "s.active_days", "s.streak_downloads")
    .agg(
        F.count("r.stars").alias("rating_cnt"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("r.stars") <= 2, 1).otherwise(0)).alias("low_rating_cnt"),
        F.round(F.avg("r.stars"), 2).alias("avg_rating"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("r.review_band") == "strict", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("strict_hit"),
    )
    .orderBy("app_id", "streak_start")
)
```

```python
        F.row_number().over(w_house_label_submitted_ts_hou).alias("rn_2"),

        F.nth_value("seat_count", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("house_label", F.year("submitted_ts_hour")).orderBy("seat_count", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_seat_count"),
```

```sql
metrics AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        policy_id,
        claimed_amount,
        approved_amount,
        product,
        NTILE(10) OVER w_all_by_claimed_amount AS claimed_amount_decile,
        SUM(claimed_amount) OVER w_policy_id_status AS policy_id_status_sum_claimed_amount,
        SUM(premium) OVER (ORDER BY claimed_amount ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_premium,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_all_by_claimed_amount, 3) AS claimed_amount_percent_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY claimed_amount ASC, id) AS claimed_amount_seq
    FROM covered
    WINDOW w_all_by_claimed_amount AS (ORDER BY claimed_amount ASC, id), w_policy_id_status AS (PARTITION BY policy_id, status)
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,

        FIRST_VALUE(claimed_amount_percent_rank) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY claimed_amount_seq, product ORDER BY claimed_amount_decile, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_claimed_amount_percent_rank,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(product) OVER (PARTITION BY claimed_amount_decile, claimed_amount_seq)) AS distinct_product_in_claimed_amount_decile_claime,
        ROUND(claimed_amount_seq / NULLIF(SUM(claimed_amount_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY claimed_amount_decile, claimed_amount_seq), 0), 4) AS claimed_amount_seq_share_of_claimed_amount_decil,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY claimed_amount_seq, claimed_amount_decile ORDER BY claimed_amount_percent_rank ASC) AS claimed_amount_percent_rank_dense_rank
    FROM metrics
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach balloons metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM balloons c WHERE c.policy_id = s.policy_id) AS claim_count,
        (SELECT ROUND(AVG(c.approved_amount), 2) FROM balloons c WHERE c.policy_id = s.policy_id) AS avg_claim_approved_amount,

    FROM with_trends s
```

```python
    df_balloons.alias("c")

        & F.col("c.claim_date").between(F.col("p.start_date"), F.coalesce(F.col("p.end_date"), F.lit("2099-12-31").cast("date"))),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "c.id",
        "c.policy_id",
        "c.claim_date",
        "c.claimed_amount",
        "c.status",
        "c.approved_amount",
        "p.product",
        "p.premium",
    )

w_policy_id_status = Window.partitionBy("policy_id", "status")
metrics = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "policy_id",
        "claimed_amount",
        "approved_amount",
        "product",
        F.ntile(10).over(w_all_by_claimed_amount).alias("claimed_amount_decile"),
        F.sum("claimed_amount").over(w_policy_id_status).alias("policy_id_status_sum_claimed_amount"),
        F.sum("premium").over(Window.orderBy("claimed_amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_premium"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_all_by_claimed_amount), 3).alias("claimed_amount_percent_rank"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("claimed_amount", "id")).alias("claimed_amount_seq"),
    )
)

with_trends = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("running_premium").over(Window.partitionBy("claimed_amount_seq", "product").orderBy("claimed_amount_decile", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_running_premium_so_far"),
        F.first("claimed_amount_percent_rank", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("claimed_amount_seq", "product").orderBy("claimed_amount_decile", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_claimed_amount_percent_rank"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("product").over(Window.partitionBy("claimed_amount_decile", "claimed_amount_seq"))).alias("distinct_product_in_claimed_amount_decile_claime"),
        F.round(F.col("claimed_amount_seq") / F.nullif(F.sum("claimed_amount_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("claimed_amount_decile", "claimed_amount_seq")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("claimed_amount_seq_share_of_claimed_amount_decil"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("claimed_amount_seq", "claimed_amount_decile").orderBy("claimed_amount_percent_rank")).alias("claimed_amount_percent_rank_dense_rank"),
```

```sql
        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_12h
    FROM plays a
    LEFT JOIN plays b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
detail_rows AS (
    -- One row per play
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.listener_id,
        s.played_at,
        s.prior_rows_12h,
        p.id AS play_id,
        p.ms_played AS play_ms_played,
        p.track_id AS play_track_id,
        p.is_skipped AS play_is_skipped,
        p.played_at AS play_played_at
    FROM covered s
    JOIN plays p ON p.listener_id = s.listener_id AND p.played_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-25 07:00:00'
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        play_id,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT play_track_id) AS distinct_play_track_ids
    FROM detail_rows
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    play_id,
    n_rows,
    distinct_play_track_ids,
    ROUND(n_rows / NULLIF(distinct_play_track_ids, 0), 3) AS n_rows_per_distinct_play_track_ids,
    ABS(distinct_play_track_ids - 6) AS distinct_play_track_ids_distance
FROM rollup_base
ORDER BY distinct_play_track_ids DESC, play_id
LIMIT 20
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

covered = (
    df_plays.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_plays.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.listener_id") == F.col("a.listener_id"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") < F.col("a.played_at"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") >= F.col("a.played_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.listener_id", "a.played_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_12h"),
        F.sum("b.ms_played").alias("prior_ms_played_12h"),
    )
)

detail_rows = (
    covered.alias("s")
    .join(df_plays.alias("p"), (F.col("p.listener_id") == F.col("s.listener_id")) & (F.col("p.played_at") >= F.lit("2025-01-25 07:00:00").cast("timestamp")), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.listener_id",
        "s.played_at",
        "s.prior_rows_12h",
        F.col("p.id").alias("play_id"),
        F.col("p.ms_played").alias("play_ms_played"),
        F.col("p.track_id").alias("play_track_id"),
        F.col("p.is_skipped").alias("play_is_skipped"),
        F.col("p.played_at").alias("play_played_at"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    detail_rows
    .groupBy("play_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.countDistinct("play_track_id").alias("distinct_play_track_ids"),
    )
)

result = (
    rollup_base
    .select(
        "play_id",
        "n_rows",
        "distinct_play_track_ids",
        F.round(F.col("n_rows") / F.nullif(F.col("distinct_play_track_ids"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("n_rows_per_distinct_play_track_ids"),
        F.abs(F.col("distinct_play_track_ids") - 6).alias("distinct_play_track_ids_distance"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_play_track_ids").desc(), "play_id")
    .limit(20)
)
```

```sql
        FIRST_VALUE(claimed_amount) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY status, adjuster_id ORDER BY claimed_amount NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_claimed_amount,
```

```sql
    FROM order_items
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("prev_from").isNull() | (~F.col("risk_tier").eqNullSafe(F.col("prev_tier"))))
)
dim_merchant_risk = risk_changes.select(
    "merchant_id",
    "risk_tier",

    F.lead("valid_from", 1, "9999-12-31 00:00:00").over(w_risk).alias("valid_to"),
)

r = dim_merchant_risk.alias("r")

        & (F.col("a.auth_ts") < F.col("r.valid_to")),
```

```sql
        a.site_id,
        a.read_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_7d,
        SUM(b.kwh) AS prior_kwh_7d

      ON b.site_id = a.site_id
     AND b.read_at < a.read_at
     AND b.read_at >= a.read_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at
),
site_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg prior_rows_7d per site_id
    SELECT site_id, AVG(prior_rows_7d) AS avg_prior_rows_7d
    FROM matched
    GROUP BY site_id
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_prior_rows_7d,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_7d - g.avg_prior_rows_7d, 2) AS prior_rows_7d_minus_avg
    FROM matched s
    JOIN site_id_stats g ON g.site_id = s.site_id
    WHERE s.prior_rows_7d > g.avg_prior_rows_7d
),
site_id_stats_2 AS (
    -- Median prior_rows_7d_minus_avg per site_id
    SELECT site_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(prior_rows_7d_minus_avg, 0.5) AS median_prior_rows_7d_minus_avg
    FROM vs_group
    GROUP BY site_id
),
vs_group_2 AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_prior_rows_7d_minus_avg,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_7d_minus_avg - g.median_prior_rows_7d_minus_avg, 2) AS prior_rows_7d_minus_avg_minus_median
    FROM vs_group s
    JOIN site_id_stats_2 g ON g.site_id = s.site_id
    WHERE s.prior_rows_7d_minus_avg >= g.median_prior_rows_7d_minus_avg
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    site_id,
    read_at,
    prior_rows_7d,
    avg_prior_rows_7d,
    prior_rows_7d_minus_avg,
    median_prior_rows_7d_minus_avg,
    GREATEST(prior_rows_7d, prior_rows_7d_minus_avg) AS greatest_prior_rows_7d_prior_rows_7d_minus_avg
FROM vs_group_2
```

```python
w_holder_id_by_start_date = Window.partitionBy("holder_id").orderBy("start_date", "id")

        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("holder_id").orderBy(F.col("start_date").desc(), "id")).alias("start_date_rank"),
        F.nth_value("start_date", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("holder_id").orderBy(F.col("start_date").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_start_date_3"),
```

```sql
detail_rows_events AS (
```

```sql
    WINDOW w_artist_id AS (PARTITION BY artist_id), w_artist_id_release_date_year AS (PARTITION BY artist_id, YEAR(release_date) ORDER BY duration_sec DESC), w_artist_id_by_bpm AS (PARTITION BY artist_id ORDER BY bpm, id)
),
ranked AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY duration_sec_vs_artist_id_avg DESC, id) AS duration_sec_vs_artist_id_avg_tercile,
        MAX(first_duration_sec) OVER w_release_date_month AS release_date_month_max_first_duration_sec,
        ROUND(artist_id_max_bpm / NULLIF(SUM(artist_id_max_bpm) OVER w_release_date_month, 0), 4) AS artist_id_max_bpm_share_of_release_date_month
    FROM windowed
    WINDOW w_release_date_month AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', release_date))
)

    ROUND(duration_sec / NULLIF(duration_sec_dense_rank, 0), 3) AS duration_sec_per_duration_sec_dense_rank
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared_tracks = (
    df_tracks
    .filter(F.col("duration_sec") < 409)
    .select(
        "id",
        "artist_id",
        "duration_sec",
        "release_date",
        "bpm",
        "moods",
        F.date_format(F.col("release_date"), "MMM yyyy").alias("release_date_label"),
    )
)

w_artist_id = Window.partitionBy("artist_id")
w_artist_id_release_date_year = Window.partitionBy("artist_id", F.year("release_date")).orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc())
w_artist_id_by_bpm = Window.partitionBy("artist_id").orderBy("bpm", "id")
windowed = (
    prepared_tracks
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("bpm").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")).alias("artist_id_max_bpm"),
        F.round(F.col("duration_sec") / F.nullif(F.sum("duration_sec").over(w_artist_id), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("duration_sec_share_of_artist_id"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_artist_id_release_date_year), 3).alias("duration_sec_percent_rank"),
        F.nth_value("bpm", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id").orderBy("bpm", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_bpm"),
        F.round(F.col("bpm") / F.nullif(F.sum("bpm").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("bpm_share_of_artist_id"),
        F.round(F.col("duration_sec") - F.avg("duration_sec").over(w_artist_id), 2).alias("duration_sec_vs_artist_id_avg"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")).alias("rows_in_artist_id"),
        F.first("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id").orderBy("bpm", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_duration_sec"),
        F.lag("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc(), "id")).alias("prev_duration_sec"),
        F.min("bpm").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")).alias("artist_id_min_bpm"),
        F.lead("bpm").over(w_artist_id_by_bpm).alias("next_bpm"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc())).alias("duration_sec_dense_rank"),
    )
)

w_release_date_month = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "release_date"))
ranked = (
    windowed
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_vs_artist_id_avg").desc(), "id")).alias("duration_sec_vs_artist_id_avg_tercile"),
        F.max("first_duration_sec").over(w_release_date_month).alias("release_date_month_max_first_duration_sec"),
        F.round(F.col("artist_id_max_bpm") / F.nullif(F.sum("artist_id_max_bpm").over(w_release_date_month), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("artist_id_max_bpm_share_of_release_date_month"),
    )
)

result = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "id",
        "artist_id",
        "duration_sec",
        "bpm",
        "moods",
        "release_date_label",
        "artist_id_max_bpm",
        "duration_sec_share_of_artist_id",
        "second_bpm",
        "bpm_share_of_artist_id",
        "rows_in_artist_id",
        "first_duration_sec",
        "next_bpm",
        "duration_sec_dense_rank",
        "artist_id_max_bpm_share_of_release_date_month",
        F.lower(F.trim(F.col("release_date_label"))).alias("release_date_label_clean"),
        F.round(F.col("duration_sec") / F.nullif(F.col("duration_sec_dense_rank"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("duration_sec_per_duration_sec_dense_rank"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("second_bpm").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```sql
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
```

```python
        "played_at",
        "ms_played",

        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("played_at")).alias("played_at_month"),
    )
)

with_prev = recent_plays.withColumn("prev_played_at", F.lag("played_at").over(Window.partitionBy("track_id").orderBy("played_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_played_at").isNull() | (F.col("played_at") > F.col("prev_played_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)
```

```sql
    -- one row per check-in, plus rolling 7-day visit count
    SELECT ci.checkin_id,
           ci.member_id,
           ci.checkin_at,
           ci.duration_min,
           WIDTH_BUCKET(ci.duration_min, 0, 100, 5) AS dur_bucket,
           COUNT(*) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ci.member_id
               ORDER BY ci.checkin_at
               RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '7' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS visits_last_7d
    FROM checkins ci
),
daily AS (
    -- distinct visit days per member
    SELECT DISTINCT member_id, CAST(checkin_at AS DATE) AS visit_day
    FROM checkins
),
islands AS (
    -- consecutive days share DATE_SUB(day, rn)
    SELECT member_id,
           visit_day,
           DATE_SUB(visit_day, CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY visit_day) AS INT)) AS island_key
    FROM daily
),
best_streak AS (
    SELECT member_id, MAX(streak_len) AS best_streak
    FROM (
        SELECT member_id, island_key, COUNT(*) AS streak_len
        FROM islands
        GROUP BY member_id, island_key
    ) s
    GROUP BY member_id
),
member_stats AS (
    SELECT e.member_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_checkins,
           MAX(e.visits_last_7d) AS peak_weekly_load,
           SUM(CASE WHEN e.dur_bucket >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_visits,
           ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1e0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 4) AS share_of_checkins,
           TRANSFORM(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(e.duration_min)), (x, i) -> x + i) AS adj_durations,
           AGGREGATE(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(e.duration_min)), 0, (acc, x) -> acc + COALESCE(x, 0), acc -> acc * 2) AS double_total,
           EXISTS(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(e.duration_min)), x -> x >= 60) AS had_long_visit,
           FORALL(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(e.duration_min)), x -> x IS NULL OR x < 120) AS all_under_2h
    FROM enriched e
    GROUP BY e.member_id
)

       m.member_name,
       m.home_branch,
       ms.total_checkins,
       ms.peak_weekly_load,
       ms.long_visits,
       ms.share_of_checkins,
       bs.best_streak,
       ms.adj_durations,
       ms.double_total,
       ms.had_long_visit,
       ms.all_under_2h,
       -- NULL in the subquery poisons NOT IN ...
```

```sql
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        quality,
        LENGTH(TRIM(quality)) AS quality_len
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE TO_DATE(read_at) < DATE '2025-02-12'
),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        voltage,
        quality,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY read_at ASC, id) AS seq_no,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY read_at ASC, id) AS read_at_dense_rank,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(read_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LAG(read_at) OVER w_all_by_read_at)) / 60, 1) AS minutes_since_prev_read_at,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_read_at_month_site_id AS rows_in_read_at_month_site_id,
        ROUND(AVG(voltage) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, quality ORDER BY read_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS voltage_avg_7,
        MIN(quality_len) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(read_at), site_id) AS read_at_month_site_id_min_quality_len,
        ROUND(AVG(voltage) OVER (PARTITION BY quality, site_id ORDER BY voltage, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS voltage_avg_3,
        LAG(quality_len, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY quality, site_id ORDER BY voltage, id) AS prev2_quality_len,
        FIRST_VALUE(read_at) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, quality ORDER BY read_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_read_at,
        ROUND(quality_len / NULLIF(SUM(quality_len) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(read_at), site_id), 0), 4) AS quality_len_share_of_read_at_month_site_id,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, quality ORDER BY read_at DESC, id) AS read_at_tercile,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, quality ORDER BY read_at DESC, id) AS rn,
        LAST_VALUE(kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY quality, site_id ORDER BY voltage, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_kwh,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(quality) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(read_at), site_id)) AS distinct_quality_in_read_at_month_site_id,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY quality, site_id ORDER BY voltage), 3) AS voltage_cume_dist
    FROM valid_readings
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_readings = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.to_date(F.col("read_at")) < F.lit("2025-02-12").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("quality"))).alias("quality_len"),
    )
)

w_all_by_read_at = Window.orderBy("read_at", "id")
w_read_at_month_site_id = Window.partitionBy(F.month("read_at"), "site_id")
metrics = (
    valid_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("read_at", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy("read_at", "id")).alias("read_at_dense_rank"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("read_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("read_at").over(w_all_by_read_at))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_read_at"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_read_at_month_site_id).alias("rows_in_read_at_month_site_id"),
        F.round(F.avg("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "quality").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("voltage_avg_7"),
        F.min("quality_len").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("read_at"), "site_id")).alias("read_at_month_site_id_min_quality_len"),
        F.round(F.avg("voltage").over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "site_id").orderBy("voltage", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("voltage_avg_3"),
        F.lag("quality_len", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "site_id").orderBy("voltage", "id")).alias("prev2_quality_len"),
        F.first("read_at", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "quality").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_read_at"),
        F.round(F.col("quality_len") / F.nullif(F.sum("quality_len").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("read_at"), "site_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("quality_len_share_of_read_at_month_site_id"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "quality").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id")).alias("read_at_tercile"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("site_id", "quality").orderBy(F.col("read_at").desc(), "id")).alias("rn"),
        F.last("kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "site_id").orderBy("voltage", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_kwh"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("quality").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("read_at"), "site_id"))).alias("distinct_quality_in_read_at_month_site_id"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("quality", "site_id").orderBy("voltage")), 3).alias("voltage_cume_dist"),
    )
)

w_prev2_quality_len = Window.partitionBy("prev2_quality_len")
sequenced = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("voltage_avg_3").over(Window.partitionBy("prev2_quality_len")).alias("prev2_quality_len_sum_voltage_avg_3"),
        F.max("minutes_since_prev_read_at").over(Window.partitionBy("quality").orderBy("voltage_avg_3", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("max_minutes_since_prev_read_at_so_far"),
        F.sum("minutes_since_prev_read_at").over(w_prev2_quality_len).alias("prev2_quality_len_sum_minutes_since_prev_read_at"),
    )
)

totals = (
    sequenced
    .groupBy("prev2_quality_len")
    .agg(
        F.min("rn").alias("min_rn"),
        F.round(F.avg("quality_len_share_of_read_at_month_site_id"), 2).alias("avg_quality_len_share_of_read_at_month_site_id"),
```
